themes.label: Checkout failures and duplicate charges
themes.summary: Users report checkout and payment errors where pickup or delivery time slots expire mid-order, cards are rejected, or the app charges money that is then reversed or left pending for days. Several describe having to retry repeatedly, with some seeing multiple charges, and EBT PIN entry and "something went wrong" errors come up across both platforms and versions from 2020 to 2026.
themes.recommendation: Investigate the checkout and payment pipeline by reproducing time-slot expiry and retry flows on iOS and Android across recent app versions (v26.2x to v26.35), and audit authorization versus capture logic so retries do not create duplicate pending or settled charges, with a fix ticket for refunding affected orders.

themes.label: Grocery delivery and pickup failures
themes.summary: Users across many years report orders arriving with missing, substituted, damaged, or wrong-address items, or never arriving at all after the app shows them as delivered. Refunds are slow and require repeated phone calls or chat with customer service, and many say the support process feels scripted and dismissive. Several mention disabled or injured users who depend on delivery, and some pickup orders were cancelled or given away after payment.
themes.recommendation: Audit the order fulfillment pipeline by logging missing, substituted, and cancelled items per order and comparing them against app status changes like 'delivered' to find where the mismatch originates, then add automatic refunds for confirmed missing or undelivered items instead of requiring a support call.

themes.label: Post-update grocery app regressions
themes.summary: Users across many years and app versions describe a redesign that merged the grocery pickup and general Walmart shopping experience, making it harder to find in-stock local items, keep lists, and avoid unwanted shipped items in pickup orders. Recurring complaints include crashes and freezes, out-of-stock or inventory mismatches with what is on store shelves, and removed features like per-store availability, the ability to edit substitutions, and easy list access. Many reviewers say they have switched to competitors such as H-E-B, Target, or Instacart.
themes.recommendation: Audit the post-merge grocery flow against the pre-merge app by listing each feature removed or moved (store availability view, list access, scan and go, substitution choice, pickup-only search filter) and prioritize restoring pickup-only search and local-store inventory accuracy, verified by comparing app stock status with in-store shelf checks for a sample of items.

themes.label: Scan and Go price mismatches
themes.summary: Users report that in-store price scanning in the Walmart app often shows online-only or incorrect prices, sometimes marking items as unavailable or out of stock, and the price shown frequently differs from what the register charges. Many say Scan and Go still requires waiting in checkout or an associate re-scan, which defeats its purpose, and several contrast this with older app versions where scanning and price checks worked reliably. Complaints span iOS and Android and recur across app versions from 2021 through 2026.
themes.recommendation: Audit the in-store barcode price lookup against register prices for a sample of clearance and in-store-only items, and add a visible notice when a displayed price is online-only, with the Scan and Go checkout flow tested end to end for associate re-scan delays.

themes.label: Walmart+ delivery fees and cancellations
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say delivery orders are frequently canceled, items are missing or out of stock despite showing as available, and delivery windows slip by days. Many feel Walmart+ is not delivering its advertised value, with confusion over the $35 minimum that triggers delivery fees even for members, plus complaints about prices changing in carts and refunds taking about 10 days.
themes.recommendation: Audit the Walmart+ checkout flow to surface the $35 minimum and any delivery fee before payment, and instrument order cancellation reasons by inventory, substitution, and driver assignment to find which failure mode drives most cancellations.

themes.label: App crashes and fails to load
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report the app freezing, crashing, or hanging during shopping, especially when adding or removing cart items, loading search results, and checking out. Many say they get false "no internet" or "technical issue" errors even on strong Wi-Fi or mobile data, and several report the problem started after a recent update (versions 26.2x to 26.35 are frequently cited). Users say reinstalling, clearing cache, and restarting their phones does not fix it.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and error logs for app versions 26.24 through 26.35 segmented by Android and iOS, and investigate the cart, search, and checkout network calls that surface the "no internet" and "technical issue" messages, checking for connection-handling or timeout regressions tied to the recent releases.

themes.label: Mixed delivery accuracy and app glitches
themes.summary: Reviewers describe a split experience: some praise the app for finding store aisles and quick same-day delivery, while many others report incomplete or substituted orders, damaged produce and bread, and out-of-stock items that show as available. A recurring complaint is that the app freezes, slows at checkout, times out, or says there is no internet connection, with several reviews from recent versions (v26.25 through v26.34) and some describing it as especially hard for wheelchair users or those shopping with children.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash, timeout, and checkout-latency logs for versions v26.25 to v26.34 on Android and iOS, and prioritize fixing the connection-timeout and cart-loading failures, since they block orders for accessibility-dependent customers.

themes.label: Search results dominated by sponsored ads
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say that since recent app versions, searching returns sponsored or promoted products first, often unrelated to the exact item typed, and sometimes locks them into a single brand page with no way to see other brands. Many report repeated products cycling endlessly when scrolling results, and some say out-of-stock or past-purchase items no longer appear, pushing them toward Target, Amazon, or the website.
themes.recommendation: Audit search ranking for branded and exact-match queries (e.g., 'powerade zero', 'taco seasoning') against the sponsored-placement logic introduced in versions 26.24 to 26.34, and add a user-facing option or default that always returns organic exact-match results with sponsored items clearly separated, then ship it behind a flag and track search-to-add-to-cart rate.

themes.label: Walmart delivery and shopper quality problems
themes.summary: Users in this cluster describe recurring problems with Walmart grocery delivery and pickup, including missing or wrong items, substitutions that ignore instructions, poor produce selection, drivers delivering to wrong addresses or leaving items behind, and shoppers who do not communicate. Several also say store staff are unhelpful and that phone or chat customer service fails to resolve issues. A few reviews are mixed or praise specific shoppers, but the dominant theme is frustration with the reliability of the fulfillment process.
themes.recommendation: Audit order accuracy and substitution data for the last 6 months by store and shopper, and add a shopper-to-customer photo or chat option for flagged unavailable items, starting with a pilot in the stores with the most complaints.

reviews.t: My idea on better compensation for inconvenience
reviews.x: If a driver is incompetent to the point you have to wait 15 extra minutes which a-lot of the time it will because you want fresh deliveries not tampered items and up charged prices for substitutions because the app didnt have it listed, you should be professional and further compensate customers that deal with their mistakes, example, this driver isnt new but made a mistake and left my food on the wrong street, their job is driving they should know street signs, if not thats a risk to their safety right? My request make the people rushing poorly to pay for their mistakes. Ive had some good deliveries so i know its possible, the lack of resolving a repeated situation and still getting told, “yeah the most we can tell you is to change where you buy from (hire better or train better i should not have the inconvenience of making my already ‘express’ deliver go to a different district and take longer) for the poor service someone willingly took to fill their own stomachs and pockets. I request at a minimum 25% off or ill be sending every delivery back with the same doubts inconvenience etc. and receiving a refund as what was advertised was not fulfilled. Advertised a 40 minute wait already a lot of time to grab a couple things, do it properly. Now overall this month ive had 40 minute delivery schedules turn into 1hr 30 minute inconvenient conversations majority of people dont have time for. Thanks.

reviews.t: Double charge on two separate accounts
reviews.x: I ordered through the app like i have done numerous times in the past, they charged my card immediately and the transaction posted with more than sufficient funds. I go into my other bank account the next day and they also pulled the exact same amount from a different financial. I did have the card linked on the account but did not use it for my transaction, I confirmed through the app that my order was only ordered once. Currently unable to dispute the transaction, i spoke with a representative and she said sorry i don’t see a charge for that card, but i have the screenshots of each charge and they’re the same amount on the same day. Then she told me i should pull my cards off the website to keep them “safe” Implying that my cards are not safe on a billion dollar corporations website? Insane. I fortunately took her advice and deleted my cards, and deleted the app. Furthermore, due to Walmart’s mistake and the lack of care in fixing it, I will no longer shop here. I am now going to have to wait to dispute that transaction with my bank when it was Walmarts mistake. Not everyone has billions of dollars to back them up, and need the money that posted twice. This is awful, save the trouble and avoid walmart all together. I will also bring reporting to BBB.

reviews.t: Be Warned- They Ask for Personal Identification Information With no Explanation- See Below
reviews.x: I just deleted my app after using the Walmart app for both pick up and delivery option successfully in the past - due to a concerning event and unsuccessful resolution. Today- for the first time- a driver rushed me into probing an ID and signature for my delivery. Shame on me for not just refusing. I ordered food and DayQuil capsules- as I’m sick. I asked him 3 x why- he was rushed and did not have an answer for me. So, I went to sparky in the app, the AI BOT and asked again, first it talked about missing cat litter- which I did not order- then, after much back and forth of me clearly asking for an explanation and it clearly thinking I had a missing item I asked to speak to a live agent. The chat switched to a live agent who after much back and forth told me to “Be advised, they are not telling me which items.” - they had asked an ID for- gave a vague promise to escalate the compliant my shopper when I really wanted an Andy- then offered to discuss any missing items 🙄I deleted the app- the convoys not worth my security concerns and Walmart’s inability to address my concerns. So I’m doing for you what I should have done for myself. Standing up for your rights to refuse a rushed ask for personal identification with no explanation.

reviews.t: Be aware when ordering groceries to be delivered
reviews.x: Many times I have ordered groceries to be delivered, but there are some items that I would specifically not want substituted. There has been a point where on the Abbott showed that the product was in stock and it was one of the main reasons I needed to shop. When I tried to cancel the order completely, the app froze conveniently on my phone and I couldn’t even get to it on my computer or anything. There was some really weird wonky thing so I tried to call customer service and spoke to an AI customer service person who could not help me either. They did not have the power to cancel my order so I ended up getting a whole lot of groceries that I did not want because I was not able to sub out because of the app and this has have been several times with different problems, all conveniently pointing to me buying and purchasing things that I did not want and shopping for things that I needed not to get the main thing I needed. I would’ve gone somewhere else to shop if I knew that they were out of the main product I needed in stock. also recently ordered some fleece pajamas for my granddaughter, and when they arrived, it looks like there was either some kind of dirt or like a black mold on the front of the pajama top and collar and the tag it looked wet like it had been moistened or like the whole package had been dropped in water or something and then they just still brought it to me and it’s was stinky and dirty and then to make a return. It takes a lot of time and effort. I have to find a printer to print out the label and then have a FedEx person come pick it up from my house and previously I had someone steal it off my porch so that I never got a return

reviews.t: I’d love it so much more if…
reviews.x: Every order ends with my shoulders tensed up to my ears and a dull tension headache beginning to radiate out from behind my brow. You can just tell there’s a million data points being collected about my behavior in the app because every tap takes multiple seconds to register. So let’s say it IS loading, not just frozen in an unresponsive state, as it also frequently becomes when shopping in app. If I’m presented with no evidence that my selection was recognized then I can’t help but wonder whether I need to click on it again. So I do only to realize that it DID recognize my very first tap and is now processing the subsequent clicks in this window even though it is only now showing on my screen. It’s incredibly frustrating. I keep coming back for more though. The prices are still high vut compared to everywhere else there significantly less. I know that there’s some gnarly surveillance tech going on beneath the surface of this app as well as in store and know that there are some cut throat anti competitive practices at play that are functioning to keep prices everywhere else higher but I know not what I can do about those things. So here I am!

Walmart gives 3 options when ordering: shipping, delivery, or pickup. When you choose shipping because you don’t want local store employees to have your personal information (where you live, what you’ve purchased), Walmart will routinely violate your privacy by changing those orders to store delivery without authorization. You cannot cancel your order once they do this. Apparently they enjoy putting their customers and employees in danger this way, so this is standard practice for them. Update: on the particular order that prompted this review, I specified shipping by carrier, then immediately started a chat with an agent after the order was submitted to verify with the agent that the order was designated for shipment by carrier. (Because I’ve had this problem multiple times before.) She said it was designated to be shipped by a carrier, but warned me that this could be changed arbitrarily by Walmart without my permission. She then said I could cancel the order if an unauthorized change in fulfillment method was made. An unauthorized change was made to local store delivery and I immediately attempted to cancel, only to be told I couldn’t cancel precisely because the fulfillment method had been changed and the local store was going to deliver it now against my explicit wishes. After seeing this review, Walmart reached out and said next time I should chat with an agent to make sure my preferred shipping method was available. Which is exactly what I did. But that doesn’t matter if Walmart routinely ignores customer choices after the fact and alters terms of a sale as a matter of policy.

I was so disappointed in what I went thru today. Not only did I not get my delivery but there was all kind of misleading information that was coming up making it so much worse. I was actually tracking the driver when it came across that it delivered. Wrong it was not driver was 12 miles away. Then it kept saying it would deliver then it was going back to the store. Then it saying he was on the way came over about 10 times. Then it was delivered again. No reasonable time to pick it up because I needed some of the items for a dish I was making for an event that night. Went thru two chat bots before I demanded a real person. He handled cancellation of my order because I couldn’t even schedule it to be redelivered the next day on the app. Keep in mind the hold was still on my account for the order. He put all my items back in my cart for me to redo the whole order. So here I am at 9pm at night trying to get it redone for delivery tomorrow. No one offered to do anything extra for the mess I went thru today. I am just about to give up on delivery!

I have been disabled for a decade and a half. One of my issues is the lights at those stores. I’m autistic and those lights send me into an autistic crash out, complete with brutal migraines. I used services that went to multiple stores, and cost per trip but also charged extra for every item. When that was the only option, we paid it. Despite being disabled on a fixed income, we had no choice. Then came Covid, finally stores started offering delivery on a large scale. There are still the services I used originally but now I get some similar services free thru other services like streaming tv options. Walmart charges but they give you a lot for a little. If you order a decent amount (over $30) then the delivery fee is waived. The prices are maybe raised a little but not so much you feel it like the original services did. I order most of my groceries thru Walmart, so I got the credit card that gives me 5% cash back (it’s a Walmart OnePay card). So by the time it’s all said and done, with the amount of fresh groceries we order, I’m getting my money worth. Add to that I get a free streaming tv service and it’s the definite winner.

Every time I try to refuse substitutions on my order I get kicked out of the app. The first time it kicked me out and when I came back it placed the order without allowing me to verify whether or not there were going to be substitutions. It didn’t even allow me to do anything past that point it just ran the payment through. I had to cancel the order. I should be able to permanently refuse substitutions. Also what was wrong with the old way of removing items from the reorder list? Every time I removed something from the list now it jumped back to the top. I was removing pet food items that my dogs refused to eat and I had to remove them one at a time. Each time it jumped back to beverages at the top. The old way I went to edit and could remove multiple items at a time. You really need to have customers beta test the changes before you actually make them. This is not the first time that I have had problems trying to refuse substitutions. Get your IT people to allow me to make it permanent and hopefully that will make it the last time. At this time the app is useless to me. And if I could I wouldn’t even give it one star. It’s been a total waste of my time.

reviews.t: It’s not just convenience. It’s part of our life.
reviews.x: I don’t know how to precisely express how much a part of our life Walmart Delivery has become, but let it suffice to say everyone in our family just count on Walmart now. I can literally get anything from a footstool for a chair some curtains, some jalapeño peppers, milk, eggs, beer, or whatever I need right at the door right to the door. Everyone who has experienced this First thinks it’s a Luxury, it’s like wow somebody’s helping me, especially when you’re over your head… Working kids, whatever it may be… But then overtime it’s becomes part of your routine, and then you realize it’s an ecosystem. Many people are at the store shopping for us while we’re doing stuff and driving the things to our house while we’re doing other things. Or in our case, my husband and I had been very unwell and it was almost like having somebody who cared enough to bring us something to the door only it was included. Plus getting the monthly Paramount subscription is wonderful. Anyway, Walmart is part of our life and the delivery is part of our life and we love saying hi to our drivers that always come by. Whether we’re in California or in Arizona or visiting our grand children when we’re in Upstate New York we just always say thank you to the people who run around as part of their job so we can do our other job. Or get something for the kids to snack on at the hotel when we’re visiting. Or just get some bed rest when we’re not feeling well. Senior citizens like us really need you. Thank you.

I ordered groceries to be delivered between 2-4pm. At 4:40 I got a message that my delivery was attempted but couldn’t be delivered. The first time I called the store it rang and rang and I got a voicemail saying they were unable to come to the phone. The second time I called they said the delivery had timed out and the next available time would be 8-10pm so I rescheduled for that time. By 9:30pm I hadn’t received any kind of update that my delivery was on the way so I again called the store and they said it hadn’t been picked up yet but couldn’t tell me if it would for sure be delivered or not. I asked them to just reschedule it until the next day because I didn’t want to wait up for my groceries to not show again. At 10:30pm I got an alert in the app that the delivery was delayed and would arrive by 11:15. After I had already asked for it to be cancelled. Both times I talked to people on the phone they didn’t have any solutions for me nor offered any kind of actual help. Just basically “sorry there’s nothing we can do.” I pay for a membership so that I can order groceries when I need them and when something doesn’t go the way it is supposed to, the store should offer some kind of help or at least have better customer service then just “sorry that’s just the way it is”. Very frustrating, very poor customer service who should be helping find solutions and making a situation right. Not just once but 2x. I don’t know if the membership is worth the hassle and run around.

reviews.t: I love this app so much!!
reviews.x: I shop at Walmart quite often but I don’t like being in crowded places so I do it all online and pick it up later which is so convenient, and who doesn’t love convenience? I know many people (including myself) love convenience!! This app is very easy to navigate through, place an order for pickup, or delivery and submit. That’s all there is to it. My preference is ordering for pick up, to me that is super convenient especially, since I do not like to be in crowded grocery stores. These are the steps I take to order online and pick up later. First and foremost I make sure I’m at the Walmart location that I’m going to shop from. This is chosen on the very top of the screen where you choose if you’re wanting to order online for pick up. This is the most important step as you can easily miss this, place the order, pay, and then go to pick the order and it’s nowhere to be found… then you realize “oops I’m at the wrong location”. Take this very important step from me as, yes it has happened to me and it’s not fun! Anyhow, after making sure I have the correct location, I then choose the date and time slot that is available as per my convenience for pick up, I then place my order with all I need to buy, I pay the total owed right on the app, and lastly make sure to be at the store for pick up on the date and time slot I choose. I get to the Walmart where I placed my order, park on one of the reserved pick up parking spaces, go back into my Walmart app and it gives you step by step instructions on how to let someone know you are there to pick up your order, so I do that and I’m done. It’s literally that simple and that’s why I love this app so much!!

The app has a glitch as of Monday, September 28, 2026. It shows the option to choose pick up and delivery, but the menu does not extend to choose which delivery address, store location, or selection of the delivery or pick up timeslots. Talked to two different representatives today, September 29, 2026, and the first advised me to delete the app and reinstall it. This fix did not work. When I called Customer Service back, I was told to just use the website instead. This was not an acceptable forever solution, as the Walmart app worked on my phone two days ago (no updates or additional apps had been installed since). The representative said he could (did not say he would) send a report to the back office, notating the issues/glitch. I asked if Walmart would communicate with me about a fix for the glitch following this report, and I was told “no”. He offered this as an only solution: “Keep checking the app to see if the glitch goes away, but if it does not, then I will have to use the Web indefinitely on my device”. When I questioned this solution, the representative proceeded to hang up on me. Walmart- PLEASE FIX! You are better than this!

Over the past few weeks when I try to place an order on the app for grocery pick up, even though I am well within the timeframe, the app told me I had to place my order before the reservation expired, when I place the order, it tells me it has expired however it then charges my debit card. When I go to pick another time that’s later it still tells me it is expired and then charges my debit card again, then when I try to go back in and it tells me my original time that I requested for pick up is available I click on that time and it gives me the pop-up that says reservation expired and charges my card again. I understand that these are all just temporary holds on my account, but it is a huge inconvenience because these take several days to clear. So I currently have almost $300 of charges sitting in my pending transactions in my bank account. This is ridiculous and needs to stop. When I called Customer Service to let them know of the issue they told me to choose another store, or wait 45 minutes before attempting to place the order again for my preferred store. Now why should I have to choose another store that’s 15 minutes away when the one just two minutes from my home is where I normally shop? Do better Walmart.

Too often they don’t have the items that I need. Today I’m going to take the chance of letting them substitute items because I just had surgery and need food. I feel that some shoppers may be lazy and not look too hard. I wish they would communicate when an item is out of stock. I ordered organic bananas today because hopefully I won’t get overly ripe ones. They actually sent me mostly brown colored bananas in the past. It would be helpful to be able to leave a note under items where preferences should be asked. Some people like really ripe bananas, some like them green. I like the in-between and there is no way to specify it. Just like the avocados I’m buying. When I shop I’ll get one that is ripe, one semi-ripe, and one not ripe. This way I can eat them over a period of 4-6 days. Again, there’s no way to mention this on the order. I no longer buy eggs from here because every time they come cracked. That tells me that the shopper is slinging stuff in their car. I’d tip more if I could specific my items like the bananas and avocados, plus it’s just common courtesy to bring what the customer wants, but if the shopper doesn’t know, then we get what we get.

they constantly try to force you to sign up for that plus. you have to click no every single time you get on, when you buy something, when you are just looking. having to push no that many times is beyond excessive!

Another update offered by you today and your app is still not working! I am not able to "chat" thru your app because now it won't even let me sign in! I have been dealing with this mess for 2 days now! Fix it, please!!! Oh, and I have uninstalled and installed the app 4 times now and that has not remedied the situation. I have also signed out of the app 3 or more times and that did not help either.

When I'm right in the middle of shopping it sometimes freezes and I have to exit the app and refresh it! Again, I don't know if yall need an update or what but this app freezes if you are on it to long. I can't even shop with having to clear the app and going back to shop. Its just really annoying.....do better

The fact that Walmart won't price match their own online store and yet has the item available for pickup or delivery from that store same day is absolutely ridiculous. Now somebody has to drive this thing to my house or I've got to come back and pick it up if I want to save 10 bucks. I get free delivery with Walmart plus anyway so ok, drive it to my house, spend the money on the gas and the time for that employee that you could have saved by just price matching this thing at the register.

I tried to place an order four times over the past 48 hours just to be told on both the app and the website that my "reservation time expired", and it still took the money out of my card. I've never had this issue before, but based on some of the other reviews I've read, I'm not the only one. I asked for a store credit instead of refund since I really needed the items, but the only resolution was to just wait for up to 10 days for a refund and a $5 coupon.

My order was cancelled by Walmart's policy review team multiple times, even after waiting a week before trying again. Only 2-6 items, basic grocery items. Their clear message to paying customers who have to put up with their BS over little things: it's better to just spend your money elsewhere.

I haven't used the app or website in over 6 months so I can definitely say I'm not missing out on the W+ subscription. Decided to make a purchase through the app and no less than 3 separate items I was asked to rejoin. I'll pay the $2 shipping and save the $98 for the year. thanks but no thanks.

app wont stop sending me emails and push notifications about orders ive already received reminding me to pick them up. in app suppory told me i cannot open a support ticket and said I have to wait for the walmart system to update for the spamming to stop. ai agent refused to help me connect with human support. ai agent refused to open a support ticket or troubleshoot. the only option the ai gave me is to permanently turn off all reminders for future pick up orders to make it stop

Although going to the store itself is an awesome experience to see all the in-store deals, there's just much or more on-line with great deals to save money that can be conveniently delivered to your door when time doesn't permit you to leave home. Yes, delivered! the on-line items to choose from are vast.

reviews.t: It used to be a great app but…
reviews.x: Now the more recent changes are making shopping on this app more difficult and unpleasant. The more recent of these examples and reason for leaving this review is the fact that now every time I type something in the search bar, no matter how specifically, the first few or many results I get are not at all what I typed. I mean they might be the same type of product at least, but when I type a specific brand, or the exact product name, then that’s what should show up first right?!? And that used to work pretty flawlessly until the last few months. I know it’s not just me either because when I mentioned it and sent my BFF screen shots of it while venting my frustrations about it, she tried it and noticed it too. She hadn’t yet noticed because doesn’t use the app for browsing and ordering quite as much as I do since she has her own reliable transportation and is not disabled like I have become the last few years. If I type something in the search bar and it’s available through Walmart then that’s what should show up as my top/first search results!! Or at least something very similar that’s the same brand before any other brands if I’ve typed a brand name! This used to be the case, change it back!!

I just signed up for Walmart+, but only after the system forced me to pay a tip on an order it otherwise wouldn't let me place. I will be canceling the service as soon as my order is delivered. I detest Besos and Amazon from a retail perspective, but they have it down. Half the orders I place with Walmart get delivered to the wrong address and I have to wander the neighborhood in search of my products, despite having left specific delivery instructions on the website.

The Walmart app got stuck in a loop asking me to set location permissions, but it wouldn't allow me to select the "no thanks" button. Out of desperation, I selected "go to settings", but I couldn't find a way to change from approximate to precise location. Very frustrating.

I would like to see what the update is about never edited or added. It's always the same. another issue would be I live in Arizona, and from time to time, I have to manuall change it from Sacramento , CA back to my address. talked to customer service. was told the same thing to fix everything uninstall reinstall log out log in change device do this do that. nothing works escalated, get nothing. are they really doing or not. An email update would be great from escalated issues

an app with a poor search engine, now worse with a useless AI, aka sparky. seems no way to turn off sparky when searching. it's less than helpful and wastes my time. if you're listening Walmart, if you make your app difficult to use I can't find stuff at Walmart and will have to spend money elsewhere. .. and my reply to the developers; why isn't there an option to disable the AI, aka sparky?

I used to really like this app but now the coupon redemption is glitchy and the site is slow. then by the time I click, the whole page has reconfigured its layout and I click on the wrong thing because now a new button is underneath my finger. Then they have so many pages to go through in order to check out. I don't know why they want to turn business away by pushing all of these things I don't want. If it gets too difficult to check out, I just stop doing business with a company.

This app only works when it feels like it. Most of the time I can't even search for product information cause the screen never loads. Also when placing a pick-up order for pickup at the store, a lot of time I can't check out because the app stops working and if I do make it through that, I'll get to the store to sign in that I've arrived and the app stops working again, so picking up my groceries is a pain to do as well.

I do most delivery. Here lately.... its not been very good. I'm missing items or getting stuff i didn't order. I'll call or use the app.. it's always bring it back or I'm sorry you didn't get that item. I'm using this delivery service that I pay for and can't get anyone to help. but I keep using. lol.

The app is a little buggy. Restarting the app doesn't help. The navigation inside the app is poor at best. reviews.t: Fix the app, don’t ask me to DM you on IG, just fix it for all.

reviews.t: I am bed ridden because of an accident.
reviews.x: This takes longer than I thought. I had a stroke 2 years ago, then I was in a bad car accident. At this point I can not drive. I was sent to a trauma hospital per air med. Our only child live over 1000 miles away. My husband does not know how to use a computer. I was laid up in a hospital for several months, so I lost a good bit of my hair. I went to the hospital as soon as I could after my stroke, but the doctor on call didn’t know anything. She wanted the nurses to check me for COVID. When the nurse wheeled me to my car she whispered to me, that I needed to go to another hospital. If I would have been treated correctly, I could have received an injection that would have made all my symptoms go away. My Dad took this really bad and he told me that I would die in a car accident. She was not a regular physician that covers ER. She was contracted from the Shoemaker group. She never came in the exam room to check me out. She stayed in the doorway with her mask on. When we entered the ER there was no one to help us. It was the worse care I could have received.

reviews.x: I wish I could see things and compare them as I would in the store. Like, I want to see every option for a product that is on Walmart’s shelves and not have some “third party sellers” sprinkle in their ridiculous prices. It just gets in the way. The TPS options should only come up if Walmart doesn’t sell it, and it should be more obvious that it’s not a Walmart seller. Also, I wish it would remind me when I’ve left the app and not completely sent my order. Sorry, but I’m a forgetful middle-aged mom. We need all the help we can get, and our grocery store should be the first ones to want to jump in and help. And don’t even get me started about the fact that I’m forced to pay for my groceries in the store via the app if I want to use tap to pay. I almost took you down to 3 stars for that, but I don’t want the app people to be judged for a stupid Walmart policy. Hoping this will get to the people in charge though, because we all know it’s something you can do. You just want to force us to use your payment options Oh, and get people with a brain to choose your produce. Like, seriously. Moldy strawberries? Cilantro that looks like it needs Viagra? Mushy tomatoes, but then rock hard avocados that take 3 days to ripen? It’s not rocket science. Now the good stuff. I love the convenience of Walmart+. In Home delivery is an absolute Godsend. I would love it if there were a way to give a shout out to an in home delivery driver when they go above and beyond. I had a day where I forgot I had a delivery coming and I couldn’t get home to get the groceries until hours later. I asked the driver to go into my home with my ridiculous dogs by throwing them cheese until they loved him (at my instruction), then going in and putting my groceries away. That was WAY above and beyond, and very appreciated! I’d love to be able to tip him but not have all of the In-Home drivers expect tips.

reviews.t: I cannot say enough good things
reviews.x: I cannot say enough good things about Walmart Home Delivery. I order with complete confidence, knowing my groceries will arrive at my door within the promised delivery window. The convenience of this service is incredible, especially for seniors or anyone who finds shopping difficult. One unexpected benefit is that I actually save money. I’ve discovered several Walmart store-brand products that I’ve tried and now buy regularly because they offer excellent quality at a lower price. Another advantage is that I no longer feel the need to overstock my refrigerator. Instead of buying a week’s worth of groceries, I place smaller orders two or three times a week. This means I always have fresh food on hand, waste less, and buy only what I need. I think this service is so valuable that I gave a Walmart+ membership to a friend as a Christmas gift because I knew she would truly benefit from it. It has made grocery shopping easier, more convenient, and less stressful, and I highly recommend it.

I was only adding $11 & $6 pieces and my total was much higher than what I was counting in my little head. So, I looked further and found all the pesky vendors that charged me, Walmarts customer, a shipping fee), sometimes almost as high as the item), and removed each item with a third party shipping fee from my shopping list. And boy did that change my total. I’m telling you, you have to look so closely at every single thing you buy, including the grocery store. But, back to Walmart and my experience with their APP today… I worked with computers in my high tech career. I have been retired for a long time and although it is convenient to be able to order online, the first time something goes wrong, whether it’s software error or user error, I’m so mad that the joy of shopping has left my body. My experience tonight was a good one. Thank you, Jeanne Kurtz

All the while I’d been trying to contact customer service so I could get my money back and try to understand what happened. I was hung up on twice, was on hold for 10 minutes and then disconnected. And the final day I sat on hold for over an hour to talk to somebody higher up than the person that I was talking to.. All of that and they rescheduled my delivery again and sent a message to the store saying that what they did was not OK. So at the end of it, I was out two payments until they were reimbursed 7 to 10 days later.. I had spent way too much time on the phone for something that should’ve been taken care of right away. I was out my groceries for three days and I finally got them at the end of the 3rd day. By the way, I’m disabled and in a wheelchair so I depend on the delivery of my groceries.

signed up for app got charged on two different credit cards. called customer service several times. Every time I have been told I would receive refund. one time I was given a ticket number and told that notes were put in file and sent to all departments. Tried to call back again to check on ticket number and no one even knew what that was. Another person gave me phone number for "billing' and said they could help me. Called that number and got recording to call customer service. Still no refund.

Easy, quick shopping and good prices! I really like the shopping list option. I can add items and quantities early, as I know I will need them, and then when I'm ready to order, I can just add those items to my cart! In the meantime, those items aren't sitting in my cart. I can order other items that I need immediately without disturbing that list. Brilliant! Thank you for including this option!

For the past three weeks, the same staple food items have consistently shown as out of stock. I check the app daily to place a delivery order. I've uninstalled and reinstalled the app twice, signed in and out multiple times, contacted customer service, and couldn't reach the store by phone. After signing out overnight once, the items briefly showed in stock, but the problem returned. This appears to be an ongoing issue. Please provide a solution so I can order online for delivery my only option

reviews.t: WalMart is IMO getting more and more dated by the year. Slow responses, problematic issues, a waste.
reviews.x: System seems to adjust timeframes it gives you to reserve a slot for pickup then it changes it even if you checkout in the mentioned timeframe like it just did to me. So ie). My pick up time order had to be complete and checked out by 10:30a i order to get on the 1-2p pick up. After about 12 attempts it continued to say i was past my reserve time and had to select another. It even adjusted it from 10:30a to 10:33a and still will not allow the initial pick up time frame i requested which was from 1-2p now because of system i am forced to select the next time frame an hour later than what i preferred and was inside the correct timeframe to remain in that time slot. I will be seeking out other grocery stores to shop with that will not force me to keep pushing my pick up time back because their system cannot keep up with the many sudden changes that can occur when placing large orders like these. Not really a fan anymore like i used to be. App just doesnt perform the way im used to it performing.

App is buggy and slow. I have had so many issues with ordering online, both pickup and delivery. The system glitches so badly that even customer service reps can't intervene to fix the stuck order. This leaves you with no groceries and no way to use the funds until the hold is released up to ten days later. The most WM will offer is $15 promo code which is insulting when all of your money is tied up. Would be great for disabled people if not an absolute gamble to whether you get food or not. 👎

Removal of shipping option is a deal-breaker. I don't need my items same-day and I don't need to feel guilty about having to tip. I also am not going to bother with work-arounds in order to spend my money on your own app. There needs to be a "Paid delivery" icon on items when shopping on-line. I don't appreciate realizing that my order requires a shipping fee and possible tips only when I go to the cart to pay.

I have actively tried to replace Amazon with this app a couple of times. the problem is the shipping. Things take literally weeks to get here. Shipping prices are unreliable and inconsistent. And shipping information does not get updated to allow for reliable prediction of package arrival. Edit: Just got notification that my order will not arrive on time. Guess that nicely illustrates my point.

App is just too busy. A simple order typically turns into an unspeakable ordeal. You have to navigate through different sellers, some of which show the same products at different prices, some charge for shipping while others don't. Took me 3 days to add a new credit card, kept getting a system error before I finally had to uninstall and reinstall the app. Use it sparingly, only when I feel like having a migraine.

The app is pretty straightforward. I use it to find things in the store (because it tells what aisle they're in if available in-store), as well as to order online. When searching for products in the app, there's a lot of info available, including reviews and shipping or pick-up options. I've never had any issues with the app or the delivery of items.

The interface is continually changing and is now to the point that 70% of the screen is filled with merchandise and services they are trying to push when trying to fill my cart from my existing lists. I finally cancelled my membership after nearly 10 years because this was the last straw after the added fees on top of the membership and other service issues. The drivers were great, hopefully they are delivering for others around town.

NOTE: I changed my rating from 3 to 5 stars because now (7-27-26) you can do all the things I complained about in my original review. The app isn't perfect – what is?! 😃 – but you can do just about everything you'd want to do. It can be a little difficult finding your way around because it can do so much, but with some trial and error, its features are there for the user. Maybe we need a "Walmart App for Dummies" book! 😃 [Click on Edit History to see old review.]

This app is difficult to manage especially when it comes to the "lists." On my personal acct it says I have 4 lists but I can't access all of them only my "favorites" & one other that I know I created. I'm attempting to sort through items because I have my favorites (all items I buy from Walmart), items I buy weekly, & what I buy monthly. Trying to organize them so they're easily accessible to me is time consuming, frustrating & almost impossible. Thinking of deleting the app, please resolve.

App can get a bit wonky and there are too many scalpers sellers listed with the Walmart website. There should be a distinction of a Walmart Store specific items omand who is a reseller and filters to check the two. Other than that, the prices are still great and there are many options for payment(all if you qualify however).

It never let's me check in at the store! Never!!! We have been doing pick up since it started and never had these issues before. We pickup weekly and in the last 2-3 months we have been able to check in only like 3 times. It says we do not have an order for pickup ready, when we do. Me & my wife both have redone the app, restarted our phones, etc but none of that helps. We then have to call when we get and half the time they don't pick up the phone.So we have to flag down an employee.

Good job with the app. The app is fast, smooth, and provides quick and direct search results. It is easy to use. Checkout is very fast and easy. Prices are competitive! Not thrilled about the pop ups, that's a turn off. Amzon is going to start having some serious competition!

On this particular shopping endeavor, the app kept freezing and trying to start over, but other than that appreciate the wealth of information for each product and now "Walmart cash" (new info to me)--which apparently is also available in store with QR code...(from the goog: " a digital rewards and rebate currency in the Walmart app that lets you earn back promotional credit on specific items. You can use this balance to pay for future orders or cash it out'). Appreciate the savings!!

So far I enjoy using the walmart app I like that I can have my groceries and other items delivered or pick them up as needed convenient for my family! I also like all of the benefits you get from being apart of the subscription, the saved information like if you gotta a warranty it saves in your app so you don't need the paper anymore. Definitely recommend!

I love this app, usually helps make my life so much easier. However, as a Walmart + member, I use my Fuel savings a lot. You keep moving how to find the code. this last change made it impossible, almost, to find. I was standing at the pump for 5 minutes just trying to locate it since our pumps do not have the QR to scan.

The shipping option has disappeared from the top of the page on the app. You can't even use filter to shop for shipped items. Now you gotta put things in the cart to see if it offers shipping. Why?? Who came up with that?? Send them back to the drawing board! This is more time consuming for consumers who are specifically shopping for items that can be shipped to avoid the $35 min purchase if all they need is one item.

When I use ebt card and there's an extra cost, they charge it to my debit card instead of the ebt. I'm low income and charging my debit card doesn't help. The worst of the app issues the last few weeks, are that it shows an entire section "out of stock." For example the ENTIRE freezer section was "out of stock." Every. single. item. Went to the store, uh everything is just fine. Two weeks later it's the entire dairy section, fresh produce. Won't even deliver my prescription.

overall not worth the subscription and you are 100% better off just doing your own shopping. they go for quantity of orders over quality and I have yet to receive a correct order from them. substitutions aside, you will be charged for items the driver misplaced that you end up not getting. the refund process is easy but seemingly by design like they know they arent going to get the order right. dont trust them for important meals or anything beyond the most simple of tasks. Terrible experiences

App used to be extremely reliable up until lately. I've noticed there are items listed as in-stock. However, when I add them for pick up the item cannot be found. I recently noticed today that the app was forcing me to connect with the Walmart wifi for scan and go when in the past this wasn't an issue. I don't feel comfortable connecting to a public wifi.

Most things are out of stock and It doesn't tell you that it's out of stock until you try to buy it. . Also, the Walmart+ thing that appears whenever you start the app is very easy to mistap, the problem isn't just that though, it's the fact that they don't ask for confirmation and just immediately activate the Walmart+ and can cause you hundreds of dollars very quickly. other than that, it's one of the few that ships to my address so it's still better than many shopping apps imo

Everything is confusing now, & payments aren't functioning properly anymore. Completely different UI, & it's not intuitive like it was before the update. I miss the sidebar & just being able to use the app itself @ - @" I use Walmart every week since the Pandemic. The EBT button to see your balance so Walmart knows who to charge what rarely works right. The you can still add to your order almost never works properly if at all. And picking substitutes also rarely works leaving me without .

Each time I attempt to make a purchase using the app, Walmart ALWAYS attempts to charge my debit card. I only use the app when I get my UHC otc benefits. Initially it was a great way to avoid the lines etc and worked without issues for a a couple years. I realize that changes are necessary to promote growth, however, just because you are holding my banking information doesn't mean you need to use it when there's more than enough money for the purchase available on my otc card (or EBT)!!!!!!

When they say they update the app regularly, it is no joke. Each month there is at least three/four updates (dang near weekly). Data wise, the updates are never less than 50mb (the last one close to 100mb). So, if you don't have unlimited data, the updates will eat up what you do have. I am about to ditch the app, and use the browser instead.

there is a bug in the app after the July 21 update. I use this app almost daily. Now when I go to "my items" to add something I need, all the items show out of stock unless I click on the specific item. that's the only way I can add to cart now. Android user. please fix as this is a huge inconvenience.

many issues with no products and selectors not choosing the preferred substitutions instead unavailable but if you go inside the store to find unavailable items there they are on the shelfs !! you Bring it to management, attention and the classic tailspin response is. Oh, they must have just got a truck, which is cleanly not the case !! it's cleanly laziness !!

so many times I can't check out error after error, embarrassing for a company of this size lose my time slot so if I don't get the items early in the day I don't get them at all cause no one stocks your shelves for opd to pick you use exceptions to stock your shelves item by item and they don't have time to stock every customers items so people lose out in store and online with substitutions or nothing.

It's mid 2026. I have Walmart+ and have used the app and website for about 3 years now to order delivery, pickup and shipping. When I still lived in Portland OR, the Shoppers would pick bad produce, Not the App. The shoppers would help themselves to items I PAID for, Not the App. The App is Great, it's helpful. You can use it to price check items in store, you can search which isle items are in store. Users need to READ, don't blame Walmart afterwards for delivery fee's! 🙄 Laziness Everywhere!

the new ai sparky assistant completey ruins my search bar I absolutely can't stand it and now I can't scroll for any more items than what sparky gives out and now I can't see other product suggestions. there should be a turn off button for sparky. not to mention I made a purchase months back for $500 of groceries for delivery and they never delivered and couldn't find my order in the system at all and I never got my refund. Walmart is absolute trash now more than it ever was.

If this order arrives as scheduled it will have been an exceptional experience. I tried to order last night but it was difficult for a variety of reasons. The App or the AI behind it was able to analyze the situation and this morning, when I tried again, all the glitches were already fixed, I could order with incredible ease, the right products, the right address, the same prices and it was SO easy. I was really grateful. Now just hoping the gifts arrive promptly and are as good as they look!

I am incredibly dissatisfied with your Walmart+ service. I have had far too many shipment orders canceled, and never offered any compensation for the inconvenience. I think it is entirely irresponsible for you to regularly advertise products you don't have in stock, and I'm having a hard time seeing the value in my subscription if I always end up having to order from other stores. I am strongly considering canceling my subscription and finding alternatives.

it is a challenge to order online for pick up, the system tries to overcharge you, I had to wait for a while and reopen the app to be able to pay the real price. Beware!!! I don't have Instagram so there is no way for me to DM any details, screenshots of the evidence.

quickly turned into the worst shopping app I've ever used. order history no longer functions. you can still order all the slop you want, but when they forget items and still claim to have delivered them, which happens on most orders anymore, there's no way to request a refund for missing items. everything else in the app functions perfectly, but conveniently for Walmart, customers have no way to request a refund, which is usually necessary due to their complete disregard for customer service.

I've been a Walmart+ subscriber since 2023, I originally got it for free but after leaving decided it was good enough to pay for the services. However like many apps I've used, updates have made the app worse over time. Added an totally unneeded AI assistant and Tiktok-like videos! Now has problems loading making it hard to tap what you want and end up in another menu. You'll have at least one total crash using the thing daily. What did y'all do to this app?

Three times this month I've had fraudulent charges from Walmart on my bank accout (via app) and no history of purchase. One on my old card, two on my new card. The purchases happened at the exact same time as a legitimate purchase. I have 2 factor turned on and without them showing in purchase history, I KNOW my account isn't compromised so it's Walmart that is. The first purchase my bank did reverse but I'm not certain they'll reverse the latest 2 so I'm very possibly out over $90.

Walmart+ customer service is the worst and they dare to compare themselves to Amazon. Scan&Go to use your phone and pay for your items, but you still have to wait in line to actually pay which defeats the purpose of the feature. the app lags constantly, some content doesn't load properly and you can easily miss some offers. Update: The survey link didn't work.

never shopping online again. Absolutely HORRIBLE app. I had 53 photos ready for checkout, kept selecting the right size I wanted and it kept switching to different sizes and duplicates. I went through it all and finally got it right after quadruple checking! Went to checkout and it showed "available walmarts near me for pick-up". I select my nearest walmart, I finalize and it suddenly says, the store is unavailable and it removed ALL my photos and my cart was EMPTY! what a ridiculous app!!!!

The substitution choice @ checkout was not working in the app. I had to go into the "looking for items" for each item & select the substitution that way. What normally takes minutes, took way too long this time! I checked with customer services, & they were unable to fix it.

the app doesn't show the screen right when choosing substitutions. They are always saying they are out of items and substitute it for something more expensive and it's funny because I will go there right after delivery and find the same item I wanted on the shelf every single time. it's a scam to get more money from me. Such a waste of money getting the Walmart plus membership when the app takes longer than just going to the store myself. I want a refund on my yearly subscription. 🤬 SCAM SCAM

App is flawed and often wont find your item either by scanning or searching by name when trying to find a previous purchase. HUGE PROBLEM is the InHome delivery add on not allowing returns to be picked up anymore. They continue to deliver items broken or poor quality (eggs and produce, respectively) and expect me to drive the items back to the store for a return and shop new ones! Absolutely ridiculous. If I have to do this myself what is the point of delivery???

i do like it of course. how☝️🙄ever! b'cuz i share the app with my sister, it's not that EZ to navigate to certain settings like; "how to change the name of the pick up person" & i also don't receive the map of the delivery driver on MY phone if my sister's not home & i am! it really needs to be much more convenient & user friendly to find settings like these! please! & the app keeps crashing as well! TY!

with newest update, its extremely frustrating to have to constantly click pick up, or it wants to ship it. The previous version was better and easier to navigate. Lately pick up is an hour wait after your selected time, or if they cant fulfill it due to staffing issues, they just cancel your order. They dont allow you to reschedule for a different date and time.

it's nice having delivery but when they don't deliver until the next day after waiting and receiving messages that your order is on the way and not showing it gets upsetting. So it happened yet again today...I hate having to wait until tomorrow and reorder it all... that's what happened last time anyway. I've paused my account thinking about canceling it.

Crashes constantly. Also, when I hop between apps to compare prices, look up nutritional information, do any sort of research, or any of the multitude of reasons you might want to switch to another app even for a moment, it goes back to the home page, losing my place while I'm looking at search results for products. It's so difficult to use this app and do ANYTHING else. I've also come across multiple products that don't have nutritional information in the product listing. Should be illegal!

I hate that this app price matches with Amazon.. amazon will write a company owning a product that's selling for cheaper on Walmart app and they now to it. It's hard to use this app knowing this. no competition for prices unless you shop in person. I also don't like the big check and support that paramount pictures gets from my purchases. I do enjoy getting bags and not boxes. .less waste .

I have had the Walmart app for 6 years, never a problem. Now the app is horrible. It takes forever to add something to my cart. Takes forever to search for an item, or even sign off. I have disconnected my internet and connected it back, uninstall my Walmart app and installed it back. Nothing, no problems with other apps. I have cleared the cache. I've done all of this several times, it still doesn't work right.

Walmart is a very frustrating place to order from especially if you have to rely only on delivery. I have never gotten an order that every item I ordered was in it. most time multiple items are unavailable and then it takes the better part of 10 days to get that money back which really blows my mind. they also make it very hard to return something. if you can't take it to the store and don't have a printer, that item is yours forever. their express is the highest price with longest dlvy time.

I'm updating my previously 5-star review to a 1 star. I order from this app all the time. I've had almost ten orders canceled this month and last month because they items were out of stock. The in store scanner is often times not able to display a price, so you have to ask an employee who is never happy to be approached for any reason. Customer service will deliver false information to get rid of you. AI customer support chat and phone operator....

growing really weary of this online purchasing. It used to be you could order an item, pay for it and be done. Now you find yourself checking boxes for things you really don't want (like subscriptions), and then having to call them the next day and cancel the order everything seems to be about selling up now. Give us a break and our money.

App is ok overall, but here's 3 things I feel need attn. 1st, in scrolling for items, there could be/should be "back to the top" button to help save time. 2nd, STOP listing the same item 3,5,20,etc times(would reduce scrolling time& the # of pages to go thru& maybe negate "back to top" button.) 3rd, at checkout, in the substitutions: ALLOW THE CUSTOMER to select HOW MANY of the substituted item we receive/want. I might be more open to a suggested sub if I wasn't forced to try more than 1.

I've noticed recently when you go to choose your substitutions on the app, it won't let you pick it from the suggestions, if you do it adds to cart instead of substitutions. If you search for a substitute part of the app covers where it says update and you have to scroll back and forth until you can click on it. Also, today the app was telling me I could still add to my order even though the window time was up 2 hours ago. what's with that???

Can no longer order for both delivery & pickup in the same order. Confusing & arduous. I buy less Works again on Nokia. Earlier: Use Wm shipping, pickup, delivery, since 2015. Waiting for delivery, App is confusing, too circular, ad-filled. Prefer notification by txt & email. NEED DARK MODE & LARGER PRINT, PICTURES: Severe accessibility issue for aging, sensitive eyes! Walmart Online doesn't go to Wallet settings. App is better for some things like that. Just too small & too bright.

the app is awful, it crashes all the time. especially annoying when I'm in the middle of selecting my substitution items for my pick up, it crashes and I have to start all over again. extremely inefficient design when you have to click on the down arrow for each item to say you don't want to replace it... that option should be available without having to click the down arrow and waste even more time.

I love the convenience, but sometimes they're out of stuff. several times I've created a whole menu around, say a roast chicken and that will be the only item they're out of . if Walmart could inform me prior to delivery of the things that they're out of that would be great. But oftentimes, it comes down to the wire, and you have a house full of all the things to make Dinner except the main course. Walmart has been wonderful about refunding for any damaged produce. i've used the serv for 4 years

Used to be great, now it's GARBAGE! A few months ago I was injured and a friend told me to use this, it was a life saver. Now half my order is always missing even though I was charged for everything. When I put in for a refund and I select the missing items they refund me for the items I did receive instead. This last delivery was done by the drivers 10yr old daughter, not the obese adult driver and once again half the order wasn't there. Once again the Ai refunded the wrong items.

This app never worked perfectly ( it was slow and constantly saying "no Internet connection" when there was) but since the latest updates it is completely UNUSABLE. It keeps crashing and if it manages not to immediately crash it lags and won't show results. PLEASE fix this, it's not the least bit helpful as it currently is!

I absolutely despise this app. first of all it's so glitchy it's almost unusable. it shudders and drags and grinds all the time, especially if you're trying to rush to get an order in. then there's the matter of just tryin to shop on it. you can type in exactly the item you're looking for and wm will show you 20 other products first. you have to wade thru them all to find what you're looking for. and if the product you're looking for is out of stock, they just won't show it, so you don't know

Selecting "in-store" no longer works. It now mostly just lists things that have to be ordered. When I select this, I should see ONLY items that are in stock at my selected store. That's the way it used to work. You respond with text showing a link that isn't clickable and the text can't be copied... Now, as of 07/16/2026; I can no longer change my selected store.

the website is really messed up. For example, I always order delivery. Somehow, they want me to pick it up! Many of the items I ordered were marked "out of stock." And I am talking about milk, butter, lemons, etc. Nothing exotic! So if, and when my order is delivered, it will be a surprise to see what I get. Surely, I am not the only one having trouble.

most of the time it's simple and straight forward all around great app! tonight it was glitching being really slow. The shoppers are usually amazing and get exactly what you order! Right down to the specific brand! They usually deliver on time or earlier than you expect! No complaints here so far! I've been using it here and other states for almost 2 years now.

It's nice to get delivery. The app can be unusable at times. Constantly freezing, closing, not showing search results. You eventually find your own work arounds, for example the app would not let me select the substitutions. The only way for me to select them was to close, then open the app, then select the price per unit.

The app is insanely complicated and confusing. When you shop and add things to the cart it sorts it into delivery, shipping and pickup. You can't just pick one. And it wont let you check out for just the shipped items or only the pick up items. When you check out all these ads pop up for every step. The shipping costs won't be displayed until the very last so you have to check almost all the way out then see the shipping, decide if you are ok with it then cancel the order. Too complicated.

App straight up lies. When you search for an item, on the preview page before going further into the specific item it states "Free shipping, arrives in 3+days" but when you click that item there is no free shipping, it costs $1.99 to ship. Others of the same item all show free shipping on the preview page and then have a shipping charge. That is called lying. And that is straight up BS from a company so large.

Absolutely terrible since recent updates. Glitches constantly and will not allow me to add new payment methods. I needed groceries so bad I literally opened a new Walmart plus account to order. They've gotten me to sign up for Walmart plus and Walmart in home so I can get "free shipping and delivery" and they removed the shipping option... if that item can be delivered, you either pay $6.99 delivery fee (for orders under $35) or you have to place a larger order. I'm canceling after 5 years.

had to use someone elses phone number to make my account work, it won't let me verify my own number. It will let me sign in without a number but I have to have a verified number that is not mine in order to place any orders. EXTREMLY INCONVIENIENT AND AN UNESSICARY WASTE OF TIME TO PLACE AN ORDER. I gues on the plus side it makes it hard to spend money on this app and I will be purchasing a lot less stuff... their loss i guess.

Makes you "verify you're not a robot" by wasting your time making you touch the screen for THIRTY seconds before refusing to load anything else. Restarting the app only forces you to "verify" again and gets you nowhere but closer to losing your mind. Random crashes when changing locations and throwing in online-only items when I'm just trying to check the availability of something at a specific store aren't very pleasant either.

HORRIBLE... App is constantly crashing, won't load and ever since the subway delivery feature was added its only gotten worse. Takes over an hour just yo try and build a cart on the app because the app keeps crashing. It will randomly log you out and when you log back in your cart is empty. Glitches so bad it won't add items to your cart and the app just closes out on it's own. Has been like this for 2 weeks now.

This app really needs an upgrade! Every time I search for something it keeps showing me the same thing over and over and I have to keep swiping through it fast until it finally catches up and starts showing other products. I would think for a huge corporate company that they could have a decent app. Update - I'm so sick of this app! It never works right! 😡

Now you've hidden save & share links‼️ If you have an issue with a purchased item and you send a message to the seller, there is no record of the message, even after seeing the "message sent" window. I returned to see if I received a reply, and there is not even a place where it shows my sent messages‼ I purchased a computer, and not being able to contact the seller is pathetic. It's as if you could care less after the sale. We're now no longer allowed to review a product after a certain period.

The app used to work smoothly, but unfortunately for the past couple of months, after I have it open for 2-3 minutes it messes up. It can't stay connected to the internet. There is nothing wrong with my internet and I've made sure to keep the app updated. What should be simple online shopping ends up taking me multiple attempts throughout the day. I can place 1 or 2 things into the cart, then I have to close the app, wait 30 minutes or longer and repeat.

Customer service doesn't really resolve the issues.. Sure, they're friendly and apologetic, but most times it's never resolved....😞 And, I recently learned that delivery drivers see the 'tip' before they take an order for delivery. Plus, they can see the 'tips' you've given/deleted on previous orders.. I shouldn't be Required to tip for a service provided from a Multi-million dollar Company that I've already paid for an account to help me. Walmart needs to Pay for Delivery Drivers.! Do Better.

This app is an exercise in patience & futility. When I go to check out, I get an error saying EVERYTHING is out of stock. Really? Your store is COMPLETELY out of EVERY dryer sheet & toothpaste?! Editing substitutions is rage inducing--the app defaults to the MOST expensive & won't let you change it. Trying to navigate when 3 different pages of the site are overlapping is like trying to play 3 pinball games at once. Do better. You're a multi billion dollar company--this shouldn't be an issue.

I used to order my items and have them shipped from Bentonville. I would place an order for over $35 and I did not have to pay for shipping. Then I saw that I could sign up with Walmart+ and I could get things delivered from the store for free. (Or what I thought was going to be free!) When I signed up for Walmart+, since I'm 76, I did not see the microscopic print that said that I had to order $35 or more to get free delivery! Of course, Walmart+ plus free delivery was in very large print, but to deceive people, they put the $35 minimum in such a small print that most people overlook it. When I started to order things, I would choose a time when it would say zero delivery fee. That was a flat out lie!!!!!!!!! So after making several orders, I noticed, that on one order, I was being charged for more than I should be paying and I called the store about it. The woman in Customer Service started looking at my order and found that I was being charged $6.95 on the order (she was not aware of the deception either). This is an intentional deception on the part of Walmart! When I talked to Customer Service about the delivery, I was told, “The delivery driving service was a separate company from Walmart!” That also is a flat out lie! reviews.t: A Lifesaver for Busy Families – Thank You, Walmart!
reviews.x: My online shopping experience with Walmart has been wonderful. I absolutely love earning Walmart Cash on eligible items and being able to save it for future purchases. It really helps stretch my budget. As a mom of 11 who works long hours, having the convenience of ordering online and getting my groceries and household items delivered has been a true blessing. Sometimes I simply don’t have the time to shop in-store, so this service makes life so much easier. I also love the newer delivery benefit that gives me 50% off deliveries. That has been a huge help, and I truly appreciate Walmart for offering it. Overall, I’ve had a great experience with my deliveries. My drivers have been kind and have always delivered my orders. There was one time a driver accidentally went to the wrong place, but I caught him just in time, and everything worked out. I know carrying heavy items up apartment stairs isn’t always easy, especially for delivery drivers. When I have large orders with cases of drinks or other heavy items, I have my kids - or my son, if he’s home - help bring everything inside, especially if it’s a woman making the delivery. And yes, I always make sure to tip my drivers because I appreciate the work they do. Thank you, Walmart, for making shopping more convenient and affordable for families like mine. Your online services have truly been a blessing, and I appreciate everything you do.

reviews.t: NO QUITE THERE YET BUT OKAY
reviews.x: The process can be annoyed because it lets you know after you pay that something is not available. They do not allow you to change anything because everything has been processed. They don’t reach out to you by phone to let you know something is not going to be there. If they did, it would allow a customer to make changes to something else. The refund process is annoying because it does not put money back on your card in the bank. Came out you have to wait several days or up to a week dependent on how your Bank and Walmart process. The substitution is a pain. It automatically makes you have sub substitutions unless you choose it. It should be the other way around.. Customer should be allowed to state they want substitutions otherwise none would be made. Also if you go back in adjuster order and then process it if you did not correct the substitution it automatically default original order. The good point about the Services. It is pretty useful when if you work long hours or do not have time to shop. Delivery service is pretty good as well. It just needs to work on the app as far as products not being there in substitutions other than that I still use it. Oh in one great thing is their customer service. They tried their best and they do good job and helping you out. AI is not so annoying as most others are, but they have live people that you can talk to and that is the best part. Do not go all into AI Walmart. Keep live people. They do a much better job.

Using this app, it took me an hour and half to order my groceries that I had already put in my cart the night before. There was a delay with every touch and glitches. When I'd choose my substitutions I had to get lucky and touch a certain area for it to allow me to pick that item instead of going into it and adding it to my cart. reviews.t: Easy ordering but deliveries need improvement
reviews.x: I love the convenience of placing an order for a future date and adding items as I go. So I gave 4 stars for the errors. Another reason I don’t like the app as much now is the 2 hour window. As a self employed person I work on a tight schedule and I like the 1 hr much more. However I understand that in places that it’s difficult to get to or far away those folks should get a 2 hr window adjusted by Walmart through a text message and email but not all of us. I literary live between 2 Walmarts each less than 10 minutes away. I’m just pressed for time always.

Hard to order if you can't keep the app open.

reviews.t: Stop storing purchase and credit card data
