reviews.x: Stop storing credit card data that links kiosks to Walmart account, ripe for digital theft, I am filing a 1.5 million dollar lawsuit based on Walmart failure to remedy situation, resulting in denied access to my Walmart plus account based on it being hacked on January 14, 4 calls and empty promises to delete all account information including my phone number so that I may have access to my Walmart plus based on a contractual agreement that I paid for, will also be seeking class action status for anyone who was denied access to Walmart plus despite having paid for membership, yet was talked in circles or had customer service telephone reps remedy account access or account information issues including Walmart collecting debit card and credit card information where kiosk utilize stored bank information without authorization and identify or allow unauthorized users to skim data that was unlawfully collected simply because someone shopped at Walmart in the past. For information contact Omar Ochoa Law firm in McAllen Texas to seek damages from Walmart if your information was collected, compromised, or access to Walmart plus account was denied based on Walmarts kiosk collection practices.

This app is so glitchy! Items I put in my cart online will disappear without notifying me why, and if I don't review my cart carefully before checkout, I won't get the items. This has happened so times I've lost count. And I can't get it to deliver my prescription because it either won't let me change the store to where the script is, or it's not eligible for delivery in ANY of the times I select. This app is just not reliable other than finding items when you're in the store.

reviews.t: Most of the time it’s great
reviews.x: This service has been very helpful for me being that I currently don’t have a vehicle. I appreciate that. However there are flaws. Sometimes my order gets pushed back and back and then sometimes it ends up coming the next day. This has happened several different times. There have been times that I am missing items but have paid for. I have reached out to customer service in regards to this and they have been helpful but it is such a process to do this. Also if I order something from the deli and I need it sliced thin there is no way to do it and I need lunch meat. I need it sliced thin because I have some issues with my teeth and can’t chew it if it is too thick. I have tried multiple times in hopes that it would be at least on the thinner side but it’s not. My store has only recently added the chat with shopper service so maybe I can finally have it sliced thin. I’m sure some people will say either don’t order it or go to the store my self. Well we like sandwiches sometimes and I have already stated I don’t have a car. Most of the drivers and very nice. Thank you for your time.

The app works well, really nice for same day orders, but it tends to semi-crash on me quite a bit. The loading windows take a while and pages will crash and then bring you back to the main shopping page, at least it keeps my items in my cart, so that's definitely a plus. Also the pop-ups for whatever offer is going on, tends to mess with the app a bit too.

As a long haul truck driver , I've been using the Walmart shopping app and having my groceries delivered to my truck. When I select 'In-Store' as a filter, that's what I want to see. your app makes it far too easy to accidentally place an order for something that needs to be shipped. I am unable to cancel that item immediately or at all. Consequently, there are items being shipped to hotels and truck stops with no one to receive them and no way for me to get a refund.

Tried to place a walmart delivery order for the first time. The time slot was already 2 hours, which is kind of ridiculous to plan around, but then it was delayed so we spent even longer waiting for this stupid order. Then, I got a text saying it was delayed again and I had to either reschedule or change to pick up. Tried to change to pickup and it said that I actually couldn't do that. So I just canceled the whole thing. Garbage service. Don't rely on this at all, you will be disappointed.

Slow, Unorganized I'm a Walmart+. it's so super frustrating to organize myself when I'm trying to a full grocery shop on the app. I don't go into the store because my anxiety. But the amount of time I spend trying to find wht I need on this app is a panic attack. Than organizing my "Cart" is even more crazy. it's 2026 let's find a way to put snacks in one column, meat in the other. so I can see what I've got.

It’s so convenient for me bc right now I don’t have a car and being able to have all my items delivered the same day is great, I love the ease of the app, I think anyone would be able to navigate it easily, and it’s really designed well, there’s not a lot of crashes or issues with the app that I encounter, I use it at least once or twice per week for ordering everyday household items, clothes, food, electronics, decorative items, plants, pet supplies and much more, I am a Walmart+ member and it comes with a lot of really good perks. I definitely recommend getting this app and using it for several different purposes. So far so good, if anything ever went missing or I wasn’t satisfied Walmart has always replaced my money as well. I really don’t have anything bad to say about this service, customer service is always helpful, prices are pretty low considering inflation today and it’s one of my most preferred apps to order most products from.

I appreciate Walmart delivery so much! I don’t think I could shop in the store anymore as it’s become difficult to walk due to autoimmune issues. They shop for me then load it up and deliver it to my door! What more could I ask for? After a hospital stay I could hardly pick up the groceries to put them inside, they helped me get them in so at least I could pick up the cold items and leave the rest for my fiancée to pick up for me. Yall have been great, this is one of the best services Walmart offers. You do get extra benefits too with your paid membership. Burger King offers a free whopper once a month, there are even free movie streaming services to take advantage of. Walmart even sells top tier items like Michael Kors, Sketchers, etc…if you are looking for more specific high end items. I don’t know how I lived all the years prior without the delivery service,but I wasn’t disabled then. Now that I am, I don’t think I could ever shop in store. Also if you are disabled or on food stamps you may qualify for 1/2 off the membership fee. A great savings! Thank you Walmart, it’s been a great shopping experience ever since I joined.

reviews.t: Very disappointed on functionality of the Walmart app For disable, visually impaired users
reviews.x: This app is very frustrating. Every time I tried to shop for items, and that is very disappointing for me because I am a visually impaired, and I reside by myself due to the fact that I recently moved to another town to go to college. So I have no family and Friends to depend on for my essentials, so I desperately depend on the Walmart app for this assistance but every time it takes me about two hours to place a simple order, which is very frustrating to me, because either the app glitches or doesn’t function at all. In my opinion, it doesn’t work well with assistive technology, such as voice and talk back and any other screen readers that visually and paired or blind users may need to complete their order and it’s not just me. Maybe other people with disabilities, depend on the functionality of the app to work correctly with assist of technology. Sometimes I do not even think it’s worth paying a membership fee and at times. I am almost tempted to switch over to other solutions such as using Kroger because this app is so frustrating. And sometimes it’s not even worth the time. Sometimes I don’t even receive my order on time, or at all, until the next day or sometimes I do not receive all of my items, or even worse the drivers leave my items outside on the ground of my apartment building, which causes a blind person like me to search everywhere, only to find my items or outside, exposed rain on the ground, which is insulting hurtful. I wish you guys will fix this prob

Recently I was very sick with a horrible wet cough & cold. I literally couldn’t drive Advils very dizzy & on the verge of standing up. I looked on the Walmart website and found both of the Mucinex products I wanted/needed. While going through the checkout process online, I decided to check and see if there were any Mucinex coupons. I did find one, but it was printable. I was unable to get to through Walmart’s main number for this process as they are only open from 8 to 5 M – F…. I tried to call my local Walmart pharmacy from which I was ordering. Either no answer or please hold and then eventually disconnected. So I placed the order for the full price, but I did join the Walmart plus assist program and that will take a small amount off the groceries that I do buy when I’m there in person. I just wish there was a way I could fax it to the pharmacy for them to provide away from me to get the printable coupon with them before the driver does (essentially).

I have to say that Walmart is a constant in my life as they have so many things to help me as I’m in my apartment at 59 in a wheelchair full-time and stop driving three years ago. The Delivery of so many products at the lowest price possible is what keeps me coming back. The only bone I have to pick with is since I’ve been handicapped in a chair full-time for the past 3-4 years, I need assistance with returns from time to time. I just moved into my own independent living apartment three months ago and needed so many items. Two of the items I’ve purchased Cutler reset and a broom and dust pan set needed to go back I called about it and they told me I would have to go into the store and so unfortunately that’s not serving me. I believe that my voice will help many people, as long as I am able to keep advocating . Our world needs to realize that being handi- capable doesn’t mean that you’re not able to do everything you were able to do before, Within reason, in your chair,.If there are ways to make it more enjoyable, comfortable, and possible, imagine how many more people with assisted devices would be out in the world, enjoying everyday life like so many able-bodied people. Thank you so very much.

reviews.t: Love to shop online for home delivery-App has too many bugs
reviews.x: Mom of 6 and shopping online and having groceries delivered makes life a little easier. The APP had too many delays, lags and bugs. Doing a large order I often have to close app and reopen to complete an order, frustrated. I will click on an item to add more than one and app will lag and I end with 5 of something though I only wanted 2. Checking out timeframe will sometime be missed and have to schedule for a later time due to lagging and app issues. Sometime app gets “overloaded” and shuts down by itself. Shopping online for groceries can be exhausting after finally get an order to go through, then I’ll get multiple items unavailable or issues with substitutions. Though I can go to the store after delivery, and the the “unavailable” items. One order a while back had 19 unavailable or substitutes. That were in stock as the shopper was still in the store. I went to the store myself and found the suppose unavailable items, Cancelled my order and addressed with a manager. Seems to be something they are aware of but not much control when they source to spark. Often missing items in my order to have to spend time getting a refund or chat support. Pay for a annual service for sub par service often

I enjoy Walmart+ and the convenience of home delivery. It’s easy and reliable. And I enjoy free shipping and delivery. It’s nice to be able to get things fast when I need them. The only improvement I would suggest is the Pharmacy portion of the app. I would like more flexibility and functionality in the app for Pharmacy. I’d like control to remove prescriptions that should no longer be on my app and the ability to cancel a prescription order if I need to. It would also be nice to be able to easily move all of my relevant medications from one Walmart to another in one bulk action. I have several medications and having to wait until it’s time to refill and remembering to transfer each one separately is a nightmare. I recently switched from one Walmart Pharmacy to another after moving across town but I’m not enjoying the services at the new pharmacy. But it’s so overwhelming to try and transfer back. Please upgrade the pharmacy portion of the Walmart app to provide more flexibility and control over my own medications.

Every time I place a delivery… something is always unavailable, orders are always wrong, and my orders do not get delivered when supposed to. Communication and customer service is bad. Every order I have placed for 9-11pm never gets delivered… if I am not able to place an order until later in the day at least it could be delivered when it says it’s supposed to I sit and wait for my orders to deliver every time I’m waiting for them and it just says preparing so then my groceries are just sitting in the back somewhere because it says everything is shopped? I wait for my orders to be delivered. I count on my orders to be delivered just for them to not be delivered and I’m not getting no type of compensation. It’s just absolutely ridiculous every single time I place an order it’s always something wrong. I don’t have transportation like that. I count on Walmart delivery and they are not helpful. I purchased groceries to prepare dinner tonight and my order has not been delivered tonight and I waited for my groceries to be delivered so I can make dinner and eat dinner, but it wasn’t even delivered tonight so I just missed dinner because of Walmart and their poor delivery services. It has become a pattern. I need compensation. I will speak to whoever I need to about this issue.

I can order what I want from the comfort of my home. What I don’t like is all the payment options that were added. I no longer use PP unless I am ordering from a company that will only take PP, and I have not experienced this in years. I will be canceling it when I can get it touch. Please DO NOT CHANGE MY DEFAULT CC. I Pay everything on one card and setup to auto draft on due date and I can check my app daily. Too much hacking going on these days. I had an issue with the One Pay, didn’t receive the card or bill and got a call about late payment. It took me a while to get straightened out. I now have the new card but haven’t activated yet. My other card had been hacked when I placed my last order from you, and you put my payment on One Pay and I didn’t notice. Customer Service was hard to deal with. The new number doesn’t match either of the options you were showing. I will write them down and try to call. You have 2 different numbers and the last digits don’t match either that you have. I am thinking about canceling. I waited on hold for about 30 minutes. Thanks

Absolutely awful service! This app rarely allow SNAP payments to be charged. Instead, it tries to charge my credit card or my insurance benefit card. Every month I have to call in and they keep trying to get me to do all of their work telling me to try this and try that etc. I should not have to try anything. The site should work easily and effortlessly. they are not paying me to do the work of fixing their site. I have been trying for almost 2 months to put in a basic food delivery. This time it worked, but I still had to figure out how to get snap to used instead of my credit card. Three years ago when I had the service it worked perfectly. I rejoined this year and have had the service for about six months. It’s terrible, terrible terrible and they refused to fix it even though I have called a dozen times over the last few months and still it doesn’t work right ever. Never never sign up for their so-called free delivery service! Another thing is that you have to buy $35 worth of goods before you get free food delivery. Even Whole Foods only makes you buy $25 before free food delivery. Walmart does not want your business. Trust me they want your money, but they don’t want to work for it. I will never again sign up for the service and I suggest anyone reading this review to think twice before they do.

support is unhelpful, they don't read or understand your request when you literally type it out. If you need to go back to an item you ordered, yea right. they don't even link your receipts to the item. it's an order summary where you can't go back. Amazon even does that. it's an unnecessary frustration.

reviews.t: Store needs better management on items available and NOT available !
reviews.x: I can only imagine how hard it must be to try and keep track of items that are available and not available to customers shopping online through the app BUT… if this is going to be an option then someone needs to step up to the plate and do a better job… at least at the store in Oakwood Georgia!! While trying to place a fairly large online order for our Easter dinner.. we became very frustrated with with ALL the items that were shown as “not available”!! Sooooo many it was crazy!! So we decided to cancel our order and just go into the store and shop to see just what WAS available. Upon walking into the store, right off the bat there lo and behold were two of the items that did not show as available online or in store!! To make a long story short we were able to get everything we could not get online because it would not let us… in store!! Including the right sizes in the grandchildren’s shoes and all clothing for church on Easter Sunday!! Happy we were!! But WHY did it say so many items were not available in the store period?? And this happens soooooo many times! But usually we just cross it off the list and get what we can and go to another store to purchase what we need there. So Walmart is missing out on probably millions of dollars all because who ever is doing their inventory is not keeping up with it like they should! It’s a shame.. and it’s an inconvenience to us that’s for sure with having to go to another store when more than likely they really do have it! Just saying… do better Walmart!! End of rant! lol

I avoided joining Walmart + for a while. But they had a half off sale to join Walmart+ so I did it. Placing orders online is easy for pick up or delivery. I love the ability to go to the store and scan my items from the app and pay in the app. The only thing that I don’t like is that I still have to go to a checkout to scan the barcode on my phone to complete the checkout process. But it takes me 5 seconds at the checkout so as long as there is no line, it’s no big deal. But I feel like the people behind me in line think I’m stealing everything since I am at the checkout for a few seconds and never scan a product. It would be nice to avoid the checkout all together and just walk out the door and really get people thinking I am stealing. Love the ability to check prices, look at customer reviews, save favorite items for easy ordering. And I’m sure there are many other features of this app that I’m not using yet.

reviews.t: Always updating, but never know what in the world they updated.
reviews.x: In Walmart’s defense, the app is a great way of getting groceries if you’re simply not able to get out of the house. I have a few problems with the app, though. Firstly, it is always slow It feels buggy and has forceclosed on me a lot. Secondly, I know this is an unpopular opinion, but for those of us who are light sensitive. A dark mode would be greatly appreciated. I’ve managed to get a plug-in on my web browser, but there’s nothing for apps. So unless the app creator themselves put a dark mode on as an option to opt in or opt out of your kind of SOL If you need that. Accessibility is always gonna win you points with people it also establishes trust with your consumer. Thirdly, this is probably a really big ask but one thing I would really love to see in the app is being able to filter out ingredients. We do not want in our foods, drinks, our medicines and What have you. I bought medicine a month ago. It had an ingredient that made me very sick that I never would’ve thought that he would ever have been there. It didn’t used to be, but they’re just putting it in everything now so the medicine I needed and the doctor told me to go by I couldn’t use. I didn’t realize until after I bought it luckily Walmart has a 90 day return policy for everything except electronics that one’s 30 days. Ultimately, I do think Walmart is getting some things right then other things I think that y’all still got a long way to go. I think they are good but you could be better much better. There is always room for improvement.

I hate Walmart and the app. You have to update the app every time you use it so if you choose to use it every day, then you have to update it every day or it won’t work. However, when you do update it it still doesn’t do well. It takes so long to load, it still freezes and moves extremely slow at check out time so you can miss your time slot. So if you have a big order and you don’t have time, you’re going to have to break that order up, not to mention the new policy of spending $35 and up just for them to deliver half of your items, almost every time, about 90% of the time. You can no longer take things out of your cart anymore after check out. I’ve been using door dash more because believe it or not sometimes they have better prices most of the times they have deals and you don’t have to deal with not getting your things and you’re also able to purchase from more than one store without having additional delivery cost if you have dash pass. I’m sure the great ratings that the app gets is from paid clientele or customers not all but at least half because there’s no way that the app has a rating of four.

people now a days are in a tight spot with money, there should not be a minimum requirement on what do spend before getting a charge this ridiculous amount on being below a certain amount of you cart. and all this money walmarts get and charges for silly things walmart still hasn’t even invested in tap to pay , what sense does that make when you’re a multi billion dollar company and you don’t even have tap to pay??? not to mention you barley have any cashiers cuz you want the community to do the work for you by ringing up their own stuff with out any type of discount for doing it and taking away jobs from the people. while the CEO lives lavishly you just have made it more convenient for you to stay rich and forcing people to spend extra money that they might not have to get what they need because they may have forgotten especially for the single mothers with multiple kids just trying to get in and get out but forgot that one thing she really went there for and taking money out of there kids mouth for later because of you high minimum charge and the fee for not reaching it.

reviews.t: Ghetto bakery workers canceled cake order 13 hours before event
reviews.x: I put in an order at the Georgia Avenue bakery for a custom birthday cake on March 11th to be picked up March 15 at 8 am in the morning I get a text message at 7 PM March 14 the night before saying that my order was canceled I called the store numerous times customer service deli bakery. No one answered my calls. No one called me prior to to tell me anything about my cake order. I was very, very highly upset that I was not even able to get anyone on the phone. They left me no grace to get another cake order customized for my child else where Their service is absolutely horrible. Do not ever and I will not ever order another cake from any Walmart agency you guys really really drop the ball and I have not been given an apology nor was I able to get a customizable cake for my daughter because you canceled 12 hours before I was supposed to pick it up. I am highly disgusted and I will make sure that I will tell all of my friends and family never to order a cake from Walmart Services again what made this situation so ugly was that they meticulously canceled my order at a time that they knew that they were closing so if I called, no one would answer the fact that no one even called me to give me an explanation as to why my order was canceled. I am still confused as to why my order was canceled. I still don’t know. No one called me. Their service is terrible. walmart needs to fire everybody in that department.

reviews.t: App is ok to order but lacks in delivery and pickup
reviews.x: It’s easy enough to order your items but when it comes to getting/tracking your delivery it leaves a lot to be desired. My last order the app informed me someone was on the way to the store to get my order, and then at the store picking up my order. Then it mysteriously skipped to some unexpressed delay advising the order would be delivered long after the store had closed, to eventually advising it would not complete and that I needed to reschedule or cancel the order. Similarly, when you choose a pickup option, it allows you to check in but after that you are at the mercy of the store as to when or if you will get your order. I have gotten it reasonably fast to having to wait over an hour on multiple occasions with no expectation or announcements about delays or progress. Moreover, while I patiently waited I witnessed multiple people get out and harass the staff in order to get their apps sooner. The app has no way to address any of this and no satisfactory customer service options for resolution. You can call the store but most of the time you are forwarded to a full mailbox. I expect better from such a large and known company.

The location in Tawas City, MI. was one of the worst locations I have ever been in. Since new management and a complete renovation of the store have taken place it has become a great deal better. I have to say that many of the delivery drivers are very bad at delivering to the wrong location and not giving you things you ordered. One example was a thick cut ribeye steak we ordered that you can only guess it was not delivered and probably because their dinner. I would also like to suggest that the Walmart App include a “NOTE” section on the checkout page so customers can request special things, such as; thick or thin sliced luncheon meats or cheeses or a large or small cut of beef, pork etc, or around a 12 lb. turkey instead of the most expensive one they can find which some customers might not want. I ask this because some customers cannot go into the store to shop for these sort of item requests because of disabilities and rely upon delivery to get their items. I cannot believe after all this time this simple addition was not implemented. Other than that I enjoy shopping from Walmart and having my orders delivered because my wife and myself are both disabled and Walmart makes our shopping experience so much better and easier for us to receive our grocery and non-grocery items.

If you use this as your regular grocery delivery, the app constantly crashes and is very slow, especially if you have a larger order. The substitution system needs major work- if the driver doesn’t care to help you, you’re screwed. If you happen to get a nice driver, which is very lucky, you could get good communication and substitution options. However, the app is so glitchy that even if you are answering immediately, it will be super slow, likely crash, and I imagine it is incredibly frustrating on the side of the shopper/drivers as well. For a company this large, an app should not still be this glitchy in the same places after several years. I only use it because it is so much cheaper to get groceries this way, and Walmart is not very close to me. Also, you used to be able to easily switch from adding an item to your cart to ship or to be delivered (like from a shopper at the store). It is now almost impossible to do that unless the item isn’t available at your local store. I hate this app, and it’s just getting worse.

I use the Walmart app to keep track of what I need when I go to the store. I add items to the cart as I run out of the item at home. One thing I would like to see updated is the ability to use the scan and go feature with my current cart in the Walmart app. I just got back from Walmart and it was a longer trip than it needed to be. I have to go to my cart in the app to see what I need. Then I get the item and have to exit my cart to enter the scan and go setting, scan my item, then exit scan and go to go back to my cart to see what the next item is that I need. It would be nice to have the scan and go feature integrated into the cart so I can see my cart, scan the item and move on to the next item. Another observation is that while viewing my cart, in the store, on the store WiFi, the cart resets and takes me back to the top of the cart while I’m looking at the next item in the cart. This happens every. Single. Time. I would like this to be updated so I can just open my cart and see all the items without it reloading and going back to the top.

I don’t drive and I can’t always get out to the store so having Walmart+ has been an absolute blessing. Being able to order groceries and have them delivered is a huge help because our local transportation has a carry limit and I can’t always get what I need for our house unless I set up multiple trips throughout the week and that’s not always possible. Having and using Walmart+ has also helped save money when shopping for groceries. They also have excellent customer support and have been extremely helpful and kind when we’ve had to use their services. We’ve bought and used protection plans with different products which are extremely helpful. I cannot exaggerate that having protection plans are extremely beneficial. We bought a system for my cousin’s son and he dropped it. The protection plan completely covered a replacement for the system. There are two things I’ve not liked though. One is some items aren’t available through the app. It’s not that they’re out of stock it’s just they aren’t listed through the app or website, most likely because they aren’t sponsored. The second I’ve noticed a lot of items are way more expensive than they are in store and it’s partially due to price gouging, partly due to third parties buying and reselling and partly because they add minimal to extreme shipping and handling fees to make more money. Things are already expensive but the price gouging makes it near impossible to get some items. It would be great if they could possibly fix the price gouging and the unavailable items. Other than that Walmart+ has been a huge lifesaver and I’ve recommended it to several family members and friends who have a harder time getting to a store or also can’t drive.

I used to be able to order just 2/3 groceries as needed with no fee. Now I have to order $35 or be charged $7! I do not have transportation so I rely on delivery, but I'm also very low income so I don't always have enough to make a $35 order. When I make a big order to prevent that from happening no one wants to deliver! Go back to no minimum for delivery. I'm already paying a Walmart + membership!!!!

The Walmart app has become my go-to shopping tool, and in 2026, it’s honestly one of the best retail apps out there. It makes everyday shopping incredibly convenient and smart. I love how seamlessly it handles everything from browsing millions of products to ordering groceries for same-day delivery or curbside pickup - it’s fast, reliable, and the prices are always competitive. The in-store features are fantastic too: store maps help me navigate quickly, the scanner lets me check prices on the spot, and the in-store savings tools highlight Rollbacks and clearance deals right when I’m walking the aisles. What really sets it apart now is the AI integration. Sparky, the AI-powered shopping assistant, is super helpful - it remembers my usual purchases, suggests cheaper alternatives or bundles, warns me when staples are running low, and even helps with event planning or reordering. Paired with the recent enhancements (like better natural language search and personalized recommendations), it genuinely feels like having a thoughtful shopping companion in my pocket. Walmart Pay makes checkout touch-free and quick, the lists feature keeps everything organized, and extras like virtual try-on for glasses or AR furniture preview add nice touches for bigger decisions. The app runs smoothly on my phone, rarely glitches, and notifications about deals or order status are timely without being overwhelming. If you’re looking for an all-in-one app that saves time and money while covering groceries, household essentials, tech, and more, I highly recommend the Walmart app. It’s made my life noticeably easier - definitely deserves 5 stars! 🚀🛒

I have been a Walmart + member since Feb of 2025 and have been so pleased with my shopping experience I dont shop anywhere else. I also get my groceries delivered and it’s been a blessing to say the least. I am retired and decided to sell my car for several reasons and that’s what prompted me to become a Walmart + member to begin with. I was so happy with Walmart delivery that I sold my car 3 months later. Now I can now shop to my hearts content day or night, I can get the best deals by scrolling and finding them. It’s a true shopping experience for me and no worries about parking , weather or crowds. I get that some people can’t give up their shopping to others but I find the delivery drivers to be the very best people and they need this job. I like to know I am a part of helping hard working people by having deliveries to me. I know this may not be for everyone but I hope if your decisions are pending on your shopping experiences that this helps.

I’ll be honest with you… Since Covid, I love being able to order groceries online and have them delivered. Especially with my busy schedule, this is so convenient for me. My Only problem is SOME of the shoppers. Sometimes I can get great shoppers who communicate well and are very helpful. Then there are the others who are complete trash. I’ve had shoppers who have bought their own persona things on MY DIME! I’ve also had horrible shoppers who don’t communicate at all and dont even ask if there is something they can substitute or if you would like something else or just don’t get my products at all. I always tip extra to those shoppers who communicate well and are very helpful. I want you great shoppers to know I do recognize your efforts and you are appreciated. Not sure who’s responsible for the shoppers, because I know they have to answer to someone (somebody is signing off your paychecks), but there needs to be recognition for the shoppers who do their job correctly and reprimanding for the ones who don’t.

Ordered tires for my car through the app. The app asked for year and model of car and gave me tires that are supposedly the size for my car. I get to thr store and they were the wrong size. I asked if i can have tires available at the store installed instead but they said even with my previous appointment, i have to wait hours. So i did not take it. 2nd try: Ordered tires online again with the right size. Item delayed and appointment cancelled by app. It was a pain having the delayed tires cancelled/refunded. The store clerk did not refund/cancel the order. The 800 number customer support was AI and had no human to talk to did not cancel the delayed order. I had to complain on an instgram comment to have my order cancelled. 3rd try: ordered online and checked the box that shows only tires that are currently available in store. Well after paying i discovered that they have to be shipped again when app says available in store for installation. Items were delayed again and appontment canelled at 6am on day on installation. I went to my 8am cancelled appointment. I was extrmely frustrated. I told the store clerk to just install whatever tires they had in store and i was just goint to wait. He said we cannot do that. So i go home again with no tires installed driving on my severely worn out tires. If anything happens and i get in an accident because of walmarts broken system, i swear im gonna be calling an attorney. Their tire center, app, customer service is soooo severely bad.

reviews.t: Mini features not accessible with screen reader
reviews.x: When I find a product I think I like, if it is available in a number of colors, The button choices do not specify the color for mini items. The buttons say things like color A, color B, color A1, etc. that may be a fault of the seller, Walmart should recognize this fault and make efforts to fix it. VoiceOver on my iPhone also does not recognize the three little round buttons arranged vertically on the right side of a product window. There are a number of other features that do not work for those of us who use screen readers. Considering how huge Walmart is as a corporation, I would think that they would make more of an effort to ensure that their app is accessible to everyone. Their app developers should hire vision impaired people who use screen readers to test the app and submit feedback on features that need correcting. Kind of think of it, every single app developer ought to do that and they don’t. Otherwise, I guess the Walmart app is OK, but a lot of the time, it doesn’t work inside their stores when my husband is trying to locate something.

reviews.t: Walmart and the delivery people, there when I need them most
reviews.x: 4 weeks ago I had a total knee replacement and those of you who’ve had one, know, you have to have someone who will help you for the long recovery. I have my daughter and son-in-law taking care of those things I can’t do for awhile and I also have Walmart. It may sound corny but I consider Walmart a partner in my recovery because I was able to purchase the things I needed before my surgery like an ice machine, pillows, K-tape, a cane and walker and have them delivered right to my door. And now after surgery, some wonderful Walmart employees are delivering my dog and cat food, pajamas, protein powders and whatever else I need to feel better. I don’t often see the young men and women who come to my door with my orders but I read all of your names and thank you personally in my heart for helping me. This is a hard winter and sometimes I’ll catch a quick glance of your cars as you pull away in the cold and ice. I feel so much gratitude for the hard work you do. Thank you all so much.

The app is decent & is actually very helpful if you need to find a section of a store you aren't familiar with. However, the shopping part is HORRIBLE. They rarely follow the delivery instructions, they rarely find all of my order, the last 3 times I ordered fruit it was rotten when I received it, and a couple of times my bread has been crushed because they laid the heavy items on top of it.

I normally use Preezee gift cards when shopping at Walmart. It’s never given me any issues and my experience has always been fine until I encounter the Walmart Supercenter #3566 in Aurora CO on Hampden Ave. First the cashier tells me my $400 dollar order cannot accept any gift cards because of previous fraudulent use, and to register it on the Walmart app. After doing so, the gift cards only worked once with a smaller order. I come back to get groceries ahead of a forecasted snow storm, and suddenly the card and the app doesn’t work. So I yet again have to pay out of pocket whilst having legitimate Walmart money on THEIR app. I call customer service and they tell me my card indeed exists with the remaining money and that it’s the specific store that’s the issue. For some reason, the card only worked for a delivery purchase which I get a refund issued for. So now I am to believe that only delivery orders are functional. YET when I placed a delivery order today, my expect 8am delivery was delayed for 4 hours before I canceled and was still charged. Please by all means save yourself the nightmare that is Walmart itself, this particular store, and their stupid app. They will rob you until you have nothing left.

This is my first time to order from Walmart online. The app was easy enough to navigate once I found my way out of the pick-up reservation-scheduling menu, which took me quite some time. I was trying to place my order while working attending a gas station and every time I got an item added to my cart I would get 1-3 customers which made it difficult to place my order and now I can only consider this as difficult as having to physically shop with so many other people shopping in the store simultaneously just like it used to be done so, since this is my first time, I am not sure that this was any more convenient than just physically going to the store myself. Especially since I gave up yesterday so wasn’t even able to place my order for pick up and upon reattempting today was now unable to pick my groceries up until tomorrow. Which I guess will just have to do. Thank you for providing the ability to opt to shop this way so I can try this again to determine if my experience was just a fluke or if I’m going to be bombarded or deftly navigating in virtual reality as it used to be physically.

reviews.t: Love the Sam’s Club App? You’ll Hate This One!
reviews.x: If you do not have alcohol, the Sam’s Club app will allow you to scan all of your items pay for them, and walk out of the store without standing in line. This is a a feature notably absent from the Walmart app. If you think scanning in store means you don’t have to stand in line you are wrong. You still have to stand in line and scan your phone at a checkout kiosk! If you buy produce, that is sold by weight, scan the produce in the produce section, and then scan a barcode that the digital scanner provides. You cannot weigh it at the check out kiosk. Also, as an added bonus, you might randomly be targeted for ID check“ which requires an attendant to come and look at your drivers license and verify that you are indeed the person who owns the phone that was not used to pay for the transaction. Yes, you’ve still got to swipe a debit card. After successfully, completing your transaction, you are invited to rate the app. If you press number one, like I did, you were asked to write a review if you are doing this as you exit the store and the attendant asks to see your receipt. You will only be able to comment that the digital receipt is on your phone and is currently obscured by the Walmart app asking for me to rate it and write a review. If you are lucky, like I was, the attendant will smile sadly, shake his head, and wave you through the door.

Belonging to Walmart’s plan for customers has made my life so much easier. Ordering needed supplies for ourselves and our pets has never been easier. My husband and I are both disabled and if I need something from groceries to clothes, to almost anything, all I need to do is pull up my Walmart app and add my needs to my cart. Delivery is fast, and usually always correct without any necessary substitutions. You can do this without joining the premium plan and get the same quality, but there are benefits to having the premium plan. For one you don’t pay a delivery fee. Under either plan option you also have the option of not tipping, but I always tip because I find the service well worth the small gratuity I give the driver. The tip is for the driver and not Walmart. There are other benefits to having the premium plan which far outweigh the cost, so I am going to give Walmart a much needed 10+ stars for all they do for me. They take the worry, energy and time, out of the equation for me. If you want your life to have less stress and hassle, join Walmart’s premium plan for customers or just download the Walmart app and get to relaxing with your needs met by the use of your fingers doing the work while your savings of gas, time and your energy stays with you. I promise you won’t be sorry.

Lately I have been seeing numerous feeds on my facebook account with regard to Spark drivers and how they feel about their job. It’s alarming to say the least. These people are so disgruntled with both Walmart and the customer. After I have finished using this year of Walmart plus I won’t be renewing because of all of the terrible comments I’ve seen these drivers post. It makes me nervous to think that these people are coming to my home to bring food that goes into my families mouths and they are so disgruntled. I pay for the Walmart plus service, and the tips that these drivers expect is outrageous. When you total up how much the Walmart plus service is in addition to how much you pay in tips per order the service all the sudden becomes quite expensive when you look at the monthly total. I’m a nurse and single mom, so it has been helpful in times of need to order online and have a delivery option. However the comments the spark drivers so freely put out there are very disrespectful and condescending to the customer. Somebody needs to be monitoring these sites, the comments make your service unappealing and give a feeling of potential danger from a customer perspective. Maybe there needs to be better pay for them, I’m not sure what the solution is.

I looked online to see if this item was in stock. It said it was. I went to the store to pick it up and couldnt find the item. I pushed the button to call an associate to come help me find it. He looked and saw that it was available, but then looked for it and said they dont have it. I told him that it said there were several available. He said they dont have website was wrong. I asked for a manager. Be said the manager was off today. I asked for a supervisor. He said there was no supervisor at work today. I asked him to get someone else. Two people arrived and looked and said they item is out of stock. I said I drove here from Mobile because the website said it was available. They said the website is always wrong. The lady said that she orders stuff all the time for her mother and it is never available. The man looked up another store and said it is available there and that I should go pick it up there. I said how do you know it is available. He said it says right here on the website. I said it also says there are several available here, so how do I know if it is really available at a store 1.5 hours away. He said, you should probably call first. Brilliant, amazing, customer service.

Every time I use my bank account it never lets me place my order, on top of that every time I place an order and it comes in a batch order I’m always missing 1-4 items in my orders it never fails. On top of that I spend hundreds to thousands of dollars with Walmart yearly and they wanna hold on to my money. I have received over 20 expired items from this Walmart in Weatherford ok and it’s absolutely ridiculous. Half the time my items are unavailable and or substituted for more expensive items. Then they want to increase my monthly membership. No matter what I can’t win and customer service is an absolute joke whenever I contact them they say I have to wait for refund that it almost makes it not even worth the time or money to shop. I will probably start taking myself to the city to buy in bulk with better prices cause Walmart is not doing any justice at least not this Walmart in Weatherford. Absolute joke, terrible quality products, expired meats, condiments, chips are stale, produce is wilted and moldy, milk is always 1 day till expiration or past its expiration , I don’t even know why I shop here. I pay for the service to be convenient but it is now an inconvenience, I usually have to request refund on products and go to my local grocery where they also never have anything. So then I am double inconvenienced. Walmart you are a nightmare

reviews.t: Use delivery from storefront to doorstep minimum of *2 or more weekly
reviews.x: I have nothing to say but great things about Walmart delivery however, majority of their delivery people do not speak English so at times there’s a language barrier in and of itself. For example, I put in petite French nail tips for my daughter stocking and instead I got petite French nail tips with black and gold lines and bedazzles. It’s little things like that that if you don’t put a substitution in, they put it in for you and demographically speaking without sounding in the least bit racist cause I’m not Hispanic people have a primarily different aesthetically pleasing to the eye nail then do Anglo-Saxon white housewife or that at a preteen so new to this site you’re looking to make your life easier and you come to the right place however in the substitution category, you need to be very clear in place what exactly your substitutions are or you can end up with some pretty wild things!!! Price point between Walmart versus Kroger’s Walmart versus Ft city Walmart versus 🎯 or simply any of theircompetitors is par for the course! You can’t compare savings of apppes and oranges when it comes to their prices and their competitors! Just be ever so very careful and cautious of listing what your substitute choices may be or you’re possibly going to be let down and if you’re like me - you’ll prolly not return these one off or 5 items !!!

On a whim, I purchased the Walmart plus subscription, and it has changed my life. I don’t say that lightly. I wish I had kept track of how much time having this service has saved me. Not only has it saved me the time of having to drive to the store and shop and drive everything back to my house unload it and put it away, but it has kept me on my budget. I don’t browse like I do in the store so I buy what I have on my list and that’s it. The convenience of sitting on my couch or sitting at work and placing a grocery order and not just groceries but anything else I could possibly need at the press of a button. It is the best thing ever. I will tell you this, TIP, YOUR DRIVERS WELL! I am seeing that I have the same driver frequently and when I asked, they said that they will take a order for a house they remember and you definitely get better treatment. Many many times the driver is also the person shopping for the food, they are doing you a great service, you are getting the delivery for free, tip them well. As for the Walmart app itself, it is extraordinarily fantastic to use. It never glitches, it’s easy to find things, if an item isn’t available in the store, they can usually have it to me later later that day or within the next day or two. Honestly, this app is worth its weight in gold. Again, I know Walmart gets a bad rep and I completely understand that, but the benefit of this is far too great for me to hold any grudges.

We’ve had multiple conversations with the Walmart chat group about this app and how outdated it is and how it always crashes, especially when trying to choose no substitutions. It’s been going on for over a year possibly too at this point and nothing has been done to fix it. They also needs to be an option to delete your entire cart instead of deleting each item one by one and it takes two minutes to delete one item and you have to wait while it bugs out. Walmart also needs to do better with their barcode scanning as a lot of items that we want they always say are not available. Once shopping is started. We take the items back because we cannot choose no substitutions and we hardly get the text message to update item. That same day the item that we wanted was actually available. They just tried to upsell us on another product. It can sometimes take longer to order online than it is to shop in the store.

reviews.t: Worst app I’ve ever used & also costs you money in tipping that you don’t even realize.
reviews.x: I wish it was good because I use it daily. It can’t be used in-store because it constantly refreshes as you’re trying to view what you have in your cart. It’s so frustrating that you finally just give up because you can’t even look at what you have in the app. When you’re not in-store (home or wherever) and you try to place a delivery or pickup order and a separate shipping order, it constantly moves your cart items from delivery/pickup to shipping and vice versa, if the item is eligible for both methods. You fix everything the way you want it and go to check out, and find that they have once again moved your cart items around. One of the WORST things about this app is that if you place an order for delivery and you base your shopper’s tip on a percentage of the order, the tip does not decrease if some of the items become unavailable while the shopper is shopping. Example: your order is for $50 groceries=10% tip ($5). Your shopper tells you 2 items were unavailable, bringing your grocery total to $40. But the tip remains $5. It should have remained 10% and therefore be $4, not $5. I absolutely HATE this app.

reviews.t: I have had Walmart+ for years but recently they have done nothing but disappoint.
reviews.x: I rely on Walmart+ for grocery delivery due to being disabled I am not able to go and so my shopping in store. Recently I have had an incline in the amount of missing items from my orders. I have reached out to customer support on multiple occasions and have been told have no fear you will be refunded for your missing items. Recently Walmart has not refunded the full amount of my missing items and has asked me to settle for less than the actual amount. To be told that they understand my frustration but then to be offered coupons instead of the cash value of the missing items. I will be letting everyone I know they should stop using Walmart+ because they do not value you as a customer and think that they can offer coupons of a lesser value to try and make me stop pushing the matter. This last order had over $200 worth of missing groceries 26 missing items and when I brought it to their attention I was treated like I didn’t matter and was only partially refunded and offered coupons for the remaining amount. As a woman with a disability that causes me to not be able to grocery shop for myself then to be treated like I am stupig and offered coupons for the remaining amount so in order to get my whole refund I am expected to spend more of my money with this company. Walmart used to genuinely care about its customers but as time has gone on they have proven that making a dollar at the expense of their customers doesn’t bother them. I will be thinking long and hard before I continue to pay for this service when I can use other services that care more about their customers.

At first, I thought this app was great. However, you’re getting charged more for your money. Especially if you’re using SNAP. They charge you the passive tax and that does not get charged on SNAP. When I sit there and talk to a representative about it they’re saying that’s allowed and I turned them in because that’s not allowed. So if you have anyone elderly on assistance, or a disabled person you better off trying to get a ride to go because you get additional charges to get the food brought to you, on top of double the amount of the food that you’re buying. They’re also charging bottle deposit tax on SNAP and they’re not supposed to. It’s not even worth going shopping online and having it delivered to you. You better off getting shipped stuff through the trucks like usual. Then when you’re paying for stuff for express and you need to add a set time you’re paying that additional money to get it delayed and you would’ve just gotten your stuff at the free time which is either 11 to one so on so forth. So don’t even bother with the express. Try the express and the person waited till night time to do my shopping when the order was supposed to be at my house in 10 minutes to start the shopping and claimed half the stuff wasn’t there but yet it was.

As you can see, I am not happy with this app at all and I’m about to go in because I’m fed up and starting to get impatient and if I go to the store itself it won’t be nice. I ordered an IPhone 13 on the 4th and it was supposed to be shipped on the 5th by 10p.m they made it clear. The next day on the 5th they sent a text saying that the order was delayed until the 6th but there was no specific reason why my order was delayed and I’m pretty sure there wasn’t a good enough reason! I’ve been looking forward to receiving my phone but Walmart keeps playing with my emotions! My phone was therefore not shipped on the 6th because y’all lied! I even called up there looking for my package and they said it was still scheduled to be shipped on the 6th. Did I receive my order?? Heck no! Am I about to call up there again and go off?? Heck yes! It’s the 7th and I still haven’t received my phone so I need that right now! The review therefore will change once I receive my order that I was promised on the 5th-6th. I DON’T HAVE TIME FOR YOU WALMART. THE STORE IS LITERALLY 40 MINUTES AWAY FROM WHERE I LIVE! WHAT’S THE HOLD UP, BRUHH?????? Y’all don’t ever have to worry about me ordering there no more!

After not receiving an order of Christmas lights that was supposed to last weekend, and now I’m not receiving a box of cat litter. I was supposed to have delivered by today, and having to call and babysit and waste precious valuable time that I will never get back for each of these dilemmas, I’m warning everyone to stay away from Walmart, plus. There They are nothing but a bunch of conniving bait and switch con artists. And add insult to injury, you first have to go through an AI ( AUTHENTIC IMBECILE) robot before you can talk to a live person (in the Philippines, of course). Only to have them jerk you around. I’ve had to call twice since last week and babysit and document because I didn’t get two orders. I was promised by two certain days. Instead, they tell me oh will issue you a refund for both. That’s not the friggin point! At this point, I am totally convinced you cannot get anything you order from them anymore! Two items in less than a week is totally unacceptable. And if I wouldn’t called overseas, I would still be hanging out in the cold in a black hole until eternity! Totally screwed. I’ve had enough of them, and I am canceling my membership next July. I never had Walmart plus in my life before this past July, so I will be able to live without them. It’s just not worth the BS anymore! I’ll take my business elsewhere.. Even if I have to pay a couple bucks more, at least I know I’ll get what the hell I ordered it! Like the old saying goes, you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: Walmart Plus is not worth it don’t waste your money
reviews.x: The second time I used the service, I scheduled a delivery time and it hadn’t shown up so I looked at the status and not only did they change my delivery time to the next day in the evening. You would think they would do first thing in the morning if they couldn’t get it there that night, but no, they changed it to evening. So then I clicked track because there was a track option and it should be delivered. So it showed delivered and scheduled to be delivered the next day at the same time. So at this time, I have no clue if I’m going to be getting my orders today or not! Customer service was no help at all. And when I voiced my opinion that so far Walmart plus has not been very good instead of apologizing and seeing what they could do to make it right he asked if I wanted to be transferred over to cancel the service. Lol, I was very surprised about that but not really because many companies nowadays just don’t care anymore. I guess Walmart is one of them! Oh, and even though you pay for the service, you have to tip the driver so really you’re not saving anything by paying for this service you’re actually paying for it twice or more depending on how often you use it. I definitely will not be renewing that is for sure. I can get my lazy self up and drive to the store and pick it up there.

I’ve been at Walmart + member for quite some time. It is very convenient for me to use to have my items delivered to me due to my work schedule. But it has been more bad than good. Either drivers are inconsistent and deliver to the wrong address, don’t follow directions and put the delivery where I did not request, or not at all considerate, my delivery actually has been stolen before by a driver. In reference to the shoppers. I believe they are Walmart employees who could care less about choosing items wisely, they choose fruit that is either moldy, rotten or not something anyone would want to eat, and it’s the same for the produce. They have been plenty of times that I have had to get refunded due to the fact the items purchased or disgusting, you can never chat with a shopper because they clearly don’t want to, and they don’t listen when it comes to my replacements, water that I have purchased in the gallons have been received by me where the entire top part is smashed in and when I try to pull it out, it starts leaking. From Walmart to be a multi billion dollar company and for me to pay for a service that has been extremely subpar 90% of the time and but for the fact, my work schedule is very busy so I really believe they should look into the people that are doing the shopping, they should be doing it properly, young kids doing the shopping and they’re just picking whatever is extremely offensive and inappropriate. Drivers who they don’t check out so they just kind of do what they want because they feel like they can. And every month I pay as a Walmart plus member to receive this terrible, horrendous, disrespectful, and inappropriate behavior.

reviews.t: Prices will always keep me coming back!
reviews.x: People need to relax and plan their shopping strategy. Sometimes when your delivery order is a little off, it’s because people make mistakes. Sometimes AI or S/H has issues with your order. However, when a large is 90 to 95% correct, then Walmart is doing a good job. If a few of your items get smashed or broken, again, it’s human, training, or a manufacturer error. Mistakes happen! No one likes to read your negative comments! Let’s K.I.S.S. Keep it stupidly simple. The world is full of negativity everywhere. Walmart does their absolute best to cater to peoples needs and desires. Enjoy the lower prices and greatly discounted sales. Remember that a smile and a positive attitude may cause the situation to be better for you. The staff will light up to you with just a smile. Acknowledging them by the name on their nameplate or by asking them their name, it can help make sure that you are taken care of positively. It’s the simplest way to have a 100% experience. You control the narrative.

reviews.t: App Too Slow. Freezes A lot! Takes long time to place grocery orders.
reviews.x: App is too slow. Kinda buggy. Times out quite a bit. Freezes a lot. Doesn’t refresh quickly. I have super fast Wi-Fi and run many many devices thru out home all day long without lag issues. But Walmart app is always problematic on ALL my devices including computer connected directly to Ethernet. Whether at home or on the go, Walmart app is a drag! When ordering groceries, doesn’t matter if you have list ready to go and only need to select and place order, it can easily take an hour or longer just to place order. Not good! Walmart, please do better and fix your app!! Another huge complaint: Walmart grocery delivery drivers I get are 99.9% Spanish (non-English speaking) drivers and they never read delivery instructions even when I put the text in Spanish. So as a result I have delivery problems 99.9% of the time. This is discouraging when deciding whether or not to place a Walmart grocery order - I always ask myself if I’m in the mood to deal with another delivery headache. Because these drivers don’t speak English, they turn off the messaging and phone so you cannot communicate with them at all about order issues or prewarn them about delivery instructions. Walmart, this can easily be fixed by instructing ALL drivers to NOT turn off messaging/calls and to look at delivery instructions/notes and get clarity beforehand! It will result in a better experience for BOTH your customers and delivery drivers as your drivers can get higher tips and thus generating more business back to Walmart. Seems logical, doesn’t it?!

Walmart Plus delivery has been a God-send. I love shopping with the app BUT some returns have to be taken back to the store. **ONE APP FLAW: APP DOES NOT ALLOW YOU TO SELECT SPECIFIC SUBSTITUTIONS. There's an opt to have Subs turned on/off BUT you CANNOT leave it turned off and select 1 or 5 items to be sub'd out of 100+ items & it defaults to "ON" so you have to make sure to turn it off or pay double at times. WALMART PLUS NEEDS TO TAKE A LESSON FROM THE TARGET APP WHERE SUBS ARE CONCERNED!

I placed an order on the website for pickup at the nearest Walmart store. Order process was time consuming because although I had pickup at store selected, search results didn't filter out items not available today at that store. I had to keep going to the shopping cart and deleting items that would be delivered to store tomorrow, then finding substitute items. Store is open til 11pm. Finished placing order at around 6pm. It took a long time to accomplish because of above difficulties. After making payment, I immediately got notified they had to cancel the order and it would take 10 days to process my refund. Not nice. I had to resubmit the entire order for pickup tomorrow morning which is very inconvenient for me. And of course, I had to pay for it again, after having already paid. It is obnoxious to charge me and keep my money for 10 days when you know I'm having to pay for all the items a second time. Everything about this process has been unsatisfactory, when it's supposed to be convenient.

reviews.t: Technical & Customer & Account Support Beyond the App
reviews.x: The Walmart App is user-friendly, but it can be frustrating when you need technical or account support that is not listed on the App. It's often difficult to reach a live agent for technical, customer, or account issues. Do not close or delete your account, as this will prevent you from opening a new one or reopening the old one. You will need to create a new account with a different email address and phone number. If you attempt to open another account using your old email address, you will also need a new phone number. You cannot use a new email associated with your original phone number to create a new account, and technical support cannot make this change. Walmart technical support says this is for security reasons and gives you the runaround when you do finally get through to them. This is one of the first apps I’ve used where you cannot update your phone number or email unless you create a new account with a different phone number. If you only have one phone number, you're out of luck because you cannot open an account with your previous phone number ever. Consideration needs to be made in fixing this problem. You cannot access grocery pickup or the store pickup without an account.

via the Walmart App, I typically place one grocery order for delivery each month. The Walmart App is awesome - from placing my order, to text updates, to getting my delivery, and the follow-up communications. I recently used the app to order 4 tires and the installation appointment, and pre-pay. I am 100% happy with how easy the app made the entire process!! A nice “bonus” is the ability to check on my service while they have my car. They use text for communications, and let me know when car was ready. Another thing the app is excellent for is using the scanning feature as I shop in person!! Many of this apps features are appreciated by me, because it accommodates my Special Needs! One symptom of my Sensory processing disorder is that multiple competing sounds drive me into anxiety or even panic attacks. Therefore, the text and message communications within the app, and how well it updates me, is very important!! Thank you so much for such a fabulous WORKING app!

reviews.t: It's a mediocre experience that has made improvements.
reviews.x: The fruits and vegetables are getting better. There are plenty of breads, bakery goods, boxed foods, and canned goods. They have almond milk, yeah. There are some positive margins in the TV area. The shoes are cheaply made. The clothing is a hit-or-miss situation, meaning you can occasionally find a gem among the sweaters, tops, or holiday pants and skirts. Please carry more of Sophia Vergara’s collections. The pharmacy is excellent, and that whole section offers a very nice array of cosmetics to choose from. The Seasonal area offers staple items. The auto department offers competitive pricing on a variety of items. The book and video selections could use improvement, especially the books. The jewelry area primarily features lab-created diamonds, and the selection needs improvement. Everything is essentially last year's selections, and it has been that way for a few years. Their fashion jewelry is unappealing, uninspiring, and of poor quality. That's my review.

reviews.t: Worked fine for years… now completely nonfunctional
reviews.x: I used to love this app. The ability to make a shopping list for delivery and curbside pickup was extremely useful. Then, one day, after updating the app, the search function completely broke. I can still view the cart, but any time I try to select the search bar, my phone crashes- not just the app crashing and taking me to the home screen, the entire screen goes black, shows a loading icon, then takes it back to my Lock Screen. It still does this after multiple “bug fix” updates, after deleting and redownloading the app, after logging out and back in to my Walmart + account. I assume this is a compatibility issue where something about the fact I’m using an iPhone XR makes the app completely inoperable, but that’s absurd, given that this app is basically just the same as the website you can access on a computer. It’s incredibly frustrating that something I used to be able to conveniently do from my phone, I now have to go back and forth between my fridge and computer to do, in an incredibly frustrating hassle. It’s one thing to fill an app with features people don’t need or want; it’s another thing entirely to have the apps primary function completely break. I can’t in good faith recommend this app to anyone.

reviews.t: No Customer Service within online grocery order
reviews.x: I tried doing a split tender payment, using my food stamp card (EBT) for part of the total and my debit card for the rest. When it tried to charge the cards on the final payment page, it kept sending back an error message saying “your payment card cannot be processed, try another payment type.” I triple checked my balance and PIN and everything and there were no errors. It should’ve charged just fine, yet it didn’t. I literally had to call my sister and ask to borrow 30 bucks bc it’s the end of the month and hello- if I’m using food stamps that means I’m low income and don’t have anything extra at the end of the month. I will say this is the 1st time this has happened and I do this often so it was an exception but my complaint is that I had no recourse once it did happen! Walmart, you need to have a customer service option in situations like this! At the least, a customer service chat w/ a live agent. This corporation is big enough that you have the money to come up with solutions for any eventual tech glitch. The fact that you didn’t have a customer service option to help me fix this while it was happening, is UNACCEPTABLE for a corp of your size.

reviews.t: The app is good, the lack of product… F-
reviews.x: So tired of the constant lack of product. Get your purchasing people together and teach them how to keep their shelves stocked on items that constantly sold. It should be easier to keep track with purchases, especially in today’s time with everything being so computerized. People did better jobs when they did it manually counting by hand. The app even shows that I have purchased an item 5 times when in truth, I have attempted 5 different times but only received the item once because it’s been out of stock the other 4 times. The option to have items shipped is a joke also. It’s extremely limited and how your people make their decisions on what items are shippable and what isn’t, must be a flip of a coin. No jelly in a plastic jar but a jar of pickles in a glass container is fine. By the way, the paper bag it was shipped in did nothing to protect that glass jar. It was busted on my porch as it dropped by the professional delivery driver. Maybe they should be trained on packaging too!!Hueytown, AL is a joke all the way around.

We absolutely love using Walmart plus and the Walmart app to do our grocery/Walmart shopping. It saves us money in the long one because we are not buying as many and pulse items and helps to stick to our grocery budget into our grocery list and it also helps us not run out of things that are Staples in our household with the subscribe option. It’s also really useful if we forget something and need something to be purchased and don’t have time to go do it ourselves we can have it delivered within an hour and that has proven to be a very useful option! I also like that they offer a place for a driver tip and then they allow you to adjust the driver tip based on the service. There’s been a couple of times where the service has been so incredibly above and beyond that I’ve Gone and doubled the tip that I wanted to give the driver and having that option is something I really love. I also love that we can get our other household Staples like toilet paper and garbage bags and even lawn care things delivered. I’m more than one occasion. We’ve used it for staple clothing like underwear, socks, or sheets or pillowcases or other household goods like that. It’s definitely worth every penny and if they start allowing us to use our Wic benefits online, I will be a lifetime subscriber!

App has improved remarkably in the last few years. It's still not perfect but good enough... I have started ordering my groceries and either having them delivered or pick them up curbside. The app keeps up with everything, including returns, and pharmacy orders so that I don't ever have to set foot in the godforsaken store anymore. I can't possibly ask for more!! lol

Update 10/2025 still crashing multiple times while making order. Update 7/2025 app keeps crashing and it's worse than normal. 2 grocery order has taken an hour because it keeps slowing down, freezing then crashing.. So glad I pay monthly for this rubbish 😡 ...... The app lags and then crashed if ypu push it. Scroll. Wait. Click. Wait. Scroll. Wait. Add to cart. Wait. Scroll again. Freeze. Crash. Do it again. Reinstall app. Different device. Same results.

I don't have a problem with the store per se but the app. I'm a Walmart plus member and every time I go to use the scan and go future it keeps freezing the app. it is a PITA and SO not worth the price of the membership. I can use Amazon and get free shipping. I don't need to go through Walmart and since I cannot use the one feature that made the membership worthwhile, I'll be cancelling my membership which is a real bummer because I really liked being able to scan and go.

It seems that the older I get, the harder it is just to get around. Not to mention the less I look forward to things I used to do without even thinking about them. One such thing is eternal foraging and gathering of shopping for groceries. As a widower now in his senior years, there are just other things I would rather be doing. That’s why I am a huge fan of the “Walmart +”program and how it greatly removes the aggravation of going to the market. Did I mention that I have something of a disability that makes walking a challenge? Well I do and the mere fact that I can get most everything I may want or need through my phone, tablet, or laptop leaves no doubt in my mind that we are living in a glorious era indeed! There are a few issues that I have but I won’t drag them out here. Suffice to say that Walmart has, what I believe, is a great and good service that you just might want to consider. How could you not want to save time, money, and effort all in the comfort of… wherever ? I didn’t think did and you’re welcome! Enjoy and all the best!

ITS NOT MY PHONE OR ANYTHING WRONG WITH MY APP. The slowest app on this Earth. I almost dread it when it's time for shopping. After 200 hours of waiting for items to add/load. I can finally purchase and be done. I depend on affordable delivery but I'm considering paying a little more to avoid the headache. shipping/delivery/ app support. Always efficient and kind. Walmart, you make millions of dollars. PLEASE fix your app. AGAIN, IT'S NOT ANYTHING TO DO WITH MY PHONE.

I really need my items delivered especially groceries. That’s the reason I started home delivery. I had injury and could not drive. The service was excellent at that time(5 Years ago). Now not as good. Some times you get your complete order and other times driver would leave at another location and would tell me to just order again! There were times when the delivery person would actually just throw bags at your door causing eggs broken, bread smashed and liquids leaking! I would request items to be replaced and that’s when they informed me to bring back to store to get refunded………..reason I started ordering was can not drive!!! I lost money! I eventually started call 800 number and told them my issues. They would refund but took a long time. And a lot of my time! I realize it’s the driver’s or packer’s faults but Walmart didn’t seem to care. I’m saying this because some people Really Do Need delivery services. And not All delivery persons have been like this, some go out of their way to treat your items as they were their own! Just needed to take this platform to voice my real concerns…….and yes I do need your delivery service!

I've been having issues with getting my deliveries and shipments, somehow or another the delivery guys and shipping guys are delivering my packages to the wrong address and I don't know how or why when they go to google maps they're somewhere else but not my house not even my street, when I call Walmart none of the agents can help me, I don't understand why this is happening because when I google my address I see my address, other delivery companies find my correct address why can't the Walmart delivery guys find my address I'm not in the Country I'm in a town, small town but I get delivery here all the time and I have In home delivery and those drivers find my address why can't the other delivery guys find it, I need help is there another number to call someone from Corporate office please I need help some of my orders are vitamins and Diabetic protein drinks things I really need, but someone else is getting my orders, if my packages were delivered to the right street address and building even if not correct apartment number my neighbors would bring it to me, I need help I try to call/text these drivers they don't answer or respond to my calls or text what's the use of having this option if the drivers don't answer my calls or text please help me somebody please

reviews.t: 1 of the worst apps in large retail stores
reviews.x: 1. VERY OFTEN, when I look up a simple grocery item these crazy prices come up such as $132 for a single frozen bag of pierogies. 2. OFTEN, I cannot find the great value version of a product but can see all of the “sponsored” products. Maybe your shopping app isn’t a hood place to allow sponsors.
