It’s not a benefit for your shoppers. Most of the time these products have aminisl amount of reviews, if they do have reviews they are not favorable, or there are no reviews. 3. Most times, you can’t find a very common product in stock my daughter in college wanted tuna fish yesterday and the products she found on this app were not available in her lubbock store. I had to go into the app today and place an order for her just because I knew exactly what to type in the search engine, 4. When I order products for delivery, other than “home story” delivery, Walmart sends drivers in circles and they ALWAYS end up bringing my items back to the store unless the driver reads the notes of me detailing how to reach my home. I have talked to customer service more than 10 times and the issue continues to exist. I can see the drivers passing by my house over and over and sometimes I’m lucky enough to stand in the street and stop them, 5. They need it easier to find items; more keyword ms to every item.

reviews.t: Wanted it to be good but…
reviews.x: i’ve been using this app for years now and i’m a frequent walmart shopper. i just recently got walmart+ back because i usually never have time to shop in person. this app is incredibly glitchy and it’s very frustrating. the app CONSTANTLY freezes. if you’re actually in walmart shopping and you have a list, it’s gonna keep refreshing on its own and it’s so annoying. Also when i order pickup/ delivery, i will spend 10 minutes choosing my substitution preferences, then the second i click update, the app either glitches out and closes, says try again, or doesn’t save them. even with full service, and connected to high speed wifi! Also if the app doesn’t have pre chosen substitutions, if you try to search one yourself and add it, it doesn’t save and i have to readd the same item like four times to get it to stay. Very glitchy and i hate that walmart is the cheapest easily accessible grocery store because i would not use this app if it weren’t. It also doesn’t help that because im a frequent shopper, my orders are often wrong/ missing items but that’s a store issue not an app issue. i just feel like if im paying to use this app to the fullest i should get the fullest quality.

I ordered a set of 4 tires from Walmart online the last weekend before this past weekend. The tires were supposed to arrive on Tuesday and they were scheduled to be put on the next day. As it would be, the tires did not arrive until the next day. I was told that although the tires were not going to arrive until that evening the early morning crew would have the tires checked in and available. Again, I was told that the tires were not checked in at 9 am but received notice online that the tires wee at the store. Finally got notice from the Columbus Store#1311 that the tires were received and I was given the next in line to get my tires on. As the tires were being placed I was informed one of the tires was incorrect. I had to go back into the store and take the incorrect tire to the service desk for a refund. That was inconvenient and unprofessional. I'm not sure why the tires weren't checked before they were sent out. Additionally, I just preferred the tires again and in the app it said I was not able to get that tire installed!!! Outrageous!!!

A few years ago, I reluctantly made the switch to Walmart. Previously, I felt like their quality wasn’t as good as the local grocery stores. What ultimately made the switch happen for me was how easy it is to re-order my groceries, how much money I save because I’m not in the store grabbing things I don’t need, but here was the real kicker... For two weeks I did three grocery carts side-by-side to see what the cost of my groceries would be at the three places. The first week Walmart was almost $100 less expensive. The second week I compared to thinking it must be a fluke, while not as close to the triple digits, it was close to $70 difference, and I haven’t looked back since. PS- I love the little number that shows me how many hours I saved by having somebody else shop and deliver the groceries to my house. In a weird way, it makes me feel good that I was able to reclaim that time back in my life by letting such a simple thing go (by getting help with it instead of doing it myself). It’s like my own little self-care scorecard! Ha!

I’ve had several instance lately of using the shipping option on the Walmart app either it takes more days than promised to get my product or missing items or even the store manager lying to me and telling me they didn’t have enough people to ship orders but they had plenty of people to deliver the same orders which I waited three days recently for a shipped order but in those three days I had orders delivered from the same store so they had people for that but not the shipping. I believe it’s because you’re not tipping these people if you don’t meet them at the door and there’s nowhere on app to tip them. The store manager of the Cambridge store needs to be fired for being incompetent I even had an order where I ordered two items. They shipped the one, but said they didn’t have anybody to ship the second part of the order that makes no sense at all I ordered a case of pop and a bag of grass seeds. They deliver the pop, but they said they didn’t have anybody to deliver the grass seeds. Why did it not be developed by the same person I’ve been a Walmart customer for a long time, but I’m really considering using another store from now on and not shop at Walmart at all. There’s plenty of stores who deliver now.

reviews.t: This review is about Sparta, Illinois Walmart and buying Online for delivery of fresh Food.
reviews.x: About every 10 days I have to purchase groceries for the house just like anybody else in the world. Unfortunately I am disabled, and not able to bring my groceries in the house, or even go pick them up. I have the most respect for the delivery people that do my deliveries for me, they are wonderful people, and always help me in anyway that I need. unfortunately, it is the app that I am unhappy with, and unable to get certain items for absolutely no reason that makes sense to me. There are many Items that are marked unavailable for delivery or shipping but I can go pick them up from curbside delivery. unfortunately I am unable to go in person anyhow, so the items that are unavailable are ones that aren’t too heavy not low on stock. It just don’t make any sense. I’ve called Walmart about it and they always tell me that there’s plenty of them in stock. The items range from frozen items to even soda. It just blocks me on the app. Tried it on other devices, I even tried to have my sister order from her online Account, and it still didn’t work. It has to be a glitch in the app that nobody feels like fixing because I have called corporate, and I have called Sparta Walmart.. It is very frustrating and unfortunately I am an able to get it unless I have somebody go to the store for me. Please reach out to me if there is anybody that actually cares from corporate Walmart. Thanks.

I just became a Walmart+ member and decided to use the Scan “and Go” service on my phone. During my first 3 attempts to use the service, my cart was “flagged” to have an associate recheck the items scanned on my phone. The whole process of getting an associate and rechecking my phone took seriously longer than just scanning the items myself at the register. The Walmart rep I spoke with advised me to just use the traditional method to scan at the register. Seems like they were just as frustrated as I was. What a complete failure of a service. Scan…. Stop-Wait-Rescan…. then Go. 🤷🏻‍♂️ Just tried the delivery service and this was a major disaster. Received all kind of delayed conflicting timeline updates from processing to delivery. 3 hours past the schedule. Honestly, I could have picked it up quicker than this service. So, I do NOT recommend Scan and NO Go and Walmart’s delivery service. It sure how this fractured service is even being promoted. Epic fail for me.

July 2025 update *it keeps crashing* Use Walmart app often to do price comparisons and to place pick-up orders. The process is straight forward, no issues with what I order on the app or my pickup order. I dislike people complaining about the app/pickup services, as both are privileges, that many can't access. If Walmart gets your orders wrong or disappoints, go inside shopping. "Was disappointed in service, will shop inside"-review, keeps others informed, while taking control of what you can.

This is the worst app I've ever dealt with. Between the crashing and constant "technical issue" and "no internet" pop-ups, it is a huge pain. And the same thing has happened when I lived in a different state with different phones and different, very reliable ISPs, so the issue is definitely not on my end. You'd think with the amount of money Walmart makes, they could afford to offer a better, more reliable app, but I guess the executives only care about their own profits.

I tried to get help with my order and I spoke with someone named Richard who claimed to be a manager and just like the staff in store he was rude and I could barely understand him. I had been trying to place a delivery order and the site kept denying it as I’m explaining this to him he says something about but you’re already in store I say something about if I could go in store I would but that’s the convenience of the app and paying for a membership right he then asked me why am I in the store placing a order for pick up anyways when I could just walk around and get it myself atp I’m annoyed cause I never said I was in store you’ve been being rude and keep dismissing me so I explain I’m not in store but I would like his information to report him he’s like that’s great whatever and starts talking to someone in the background mutes the phone without a hold on I’ll brb or anything when he comes back he’s basically like he’s done and don’t care I ask for his employee number or if he can get me over to someone higher to assist me the proper way he kept being rude and dismissing me then Tells me to hang up and call again if I want help and he hangs up on me normally Walmart is the last store id go to but since my truck broke down and my kids need food I said let’s try it worst decision ever the service online is way worse than in store and everyone needs work but the audacity of u to barely speak English and be so rude to work customer service with no care about the customer to dismiss someone who’s just looking for help is disgusting

I used to enjoy the app for local, same day shopping. It's less helpful for that lately. I can't load the app without having W+ and other ads shoved in my face, and now when I click the In Store filter toggle to see if I can pick up an item same day, I get dozens of results for shipping only. What's the point of the filter? Also, Walmart-unrelated to the app-I liked your stores a LOT better before the big remodel. I hate the new arrangement. Your competitors are getting more of my business since

UPDATE: WHY apologize that I'm having "issues" and tell me to contact you, INSTEAD OF just saying that it doesn't matter if you pay for membership, you still have to pay $6.99 fee if order is under $35! One of the main reasons I wanted it-canceled my membership. ORIGINAL: Why is there STILL a $6.99 charge for orders under $35 even if you pay for the WALMART+ Subscription? Walmart+ isn't worth it!

I enjoy the convenience of the Walmart shopping app. I especially like being able to create my grocery list. I would prefer if when I create an item to add to the list, once I go to find the item, it would be helpful if I could choose more than 1 product instead of having to add it again to my list… for example mini pies. I have to add each time to be able to choose multiple flavors of mini pie. I also abhor the fact that while scrolling my list to see if I added everything I need, I am asked to review the process and cannot exit from the review, it breaks up my thought process. This request should be held until either reaching the end of the list, or after moving items to a sh shopping cart. , Please, Please, stop asking me to ‘tell you what I think” when I am using the shopping list feature. This can be so many other places, or at the end of my list. When I am scrolling thru to see if I remembered everything, and I am required to complete a review to move on, it interrupts my train of thought.

Update: After writing my previous review below, I received a response to delete the app and reinstall. This did not remedy the problem. I add items as I need them. Some are weekly, some are not, but I still keep them in my cart. The more I scroll down my list, I now have to delete items because I can’t get down far enough to see items towards the bottom before the app starts buffering/reloading and restarting me at the top of the list. This can get very frustrating when I’m on a time limit and the app slows me down. The app works great for location for items I’m purchasing, but whenever I’m shopping at Walmart and just using items in my cart for a shopping list, I can’t keep it from reloading when I’m in the store, so I can’t actually see what I need to purchase. I scroll down my list.. it starts reloading (buffering). This only happens when I’m in the store and it didn’t used to happen. I keep the app up to date on updates.

I’ve been using the Walmart app to schedule grocery pick up since I am pregnant and have a hard time physically going into stores to do our weekly shopping for a while now. Usually I really love it, but I’ve run into an issue with the app. If you order anything from the deli section - like lunch meat for example - you will not be able to customize how your lunch meat is sliced. There is no option to let them know how you want it to be cut so you’ll end up with whatever your store defaults to, which is usually a thicker slice. I’m a little picky and do not like thick slices for sandwiches. I even called my Walmart at 10am to request that they slice it differently. My pick up time was between 4-5pm that day and I had a cutoff time of 1pm to make any changes to my order. The employee was nice and took down my request to give to the deli counter, and told me he wasn’t sure if they’d take my request at the counter. They did not take my request, and I still ended up with thick slices of deli meat. If we could make customizations in the app for the deli counter, I would have no complaints at all!!

This app is absolutely awful. I would even say that it’s quite possibly THE worst store app I’ve ever used. To start with you won’t get very far shopping online before the app crashes for no reason several times. Then when you reopen it and add or remove items you will continue to have to fight with the app because error messages saying you can’t add this item or that the item failed to add will have you wondering why you don’t just start shopping at Target. Then when you finally are ready to checkout after 3-4 hours of utter nonsense and contemplating hurting yourself, the app shuts down again for no reason. After that when it’s all said and done and you place the order the shopper never fails to tell you half the items are suddenly unavailable. When the delivery arrives the items they did have somehow got broken or leaked out or best of all disappeared altogether! So you head to the EXCELLENT app to do a simple return. You are promptly refunded for the missing items. That part was easy an goes smoothly so you think. Only the next time you go to place an online order with the Walmart plus subscription you pay money for. You get a message stating that because you have made too many returns you now can only make all purchases IN STORE!!!! As if it was your fault the shoppers aren’t good at their job. Delete the app. Shop at target or aldi or literally anywhere else. I’d starve to death before dealing with them again.

I want to like this app, but Walmart’s app developers make it very difficult to do so. Almost every time a new feature is added, it makes the app more difficult to use, not easier. The latest problem is the shopping cart. It automatically reloads the list every 10-20 seconds, presumably to make sure the available time slots displayed are still accurate. This is an extremely sloppy design/implementation. There is no reason you need to interrupt the user experience by forcing frequent refreshes. This is just lazy coding. The same thing could have easily been taken care of in the background. As it sits now, it is almost impossible to review the contents of your cart without it reloading on you if you have more than a handful of items added. Sometimes I need to use the cart as my shopping list for in person shopping when I can’t get a pickup time slot that works. With the current behavior of the cart, it often leaves me swearing under my breath in absolute frustration.

reviews.t: Pls bring back GV Speculoos Creamer
reviews.x: GV Speculoos Creamer was the best thing that ever happened to us. We thought things were looking up for us. We thought we had found “The One”. Slowly we started seeing less of you. At first we thought it was just an off shopping day, but there was no denying the disappointment we felt as we put ol french vanilla in the cart. Next we were told “the truck hadn’t come in yet” or that “it hadn’t been stocked yet”. We convinced ourselves that we were overthinking. We laughed it off. It wasn’t that serious. We were not anticipating this kind of despair from a chance encounter. We soon found ourselves tracking…checking the app for movement, updates, fulfillment. And then it happened. It was back. Emotions were intense as we casually (frantically) stalked to the location we first met. The relief was immediate. We spent the entire week together. Every morning was magic…and then it was over. We can’t bear to accept that we weren’t that serious, but we refuse to accept that we were a seasonal fling. We still look for you. We still make excuses for your secretive departure. Did the most perfect addition to ever grace my lips belong to someone else? We’ll never know..but we still look for you in she shadows of the empty space.

This location gets worse year by year. Management either cannot or just don’t care about scheduling the work force to meet demand and/or train the employees for their jobs. I had an 08:00 A.M appointment to replace 4 tires, upon arriving at 07:50 A.M. the associate waiting on me was complaining about her schedule with no help in the service department except her and 2 service techs. The service waiting room already had customers standing around waiting for service. My vehicle wasn’t pulled in until 09:04 and then sit another 12 minutes before it was raised for tire and wheel removal. Long story short, myself and another customer that tires replaced left the location between 10:38 and myself at 10:57. During which every customer was told that the 11 year old printer had stopped working and she couldn’t get management to help her get the printer back in service. This location would be a great spot for a Super Center for a company that cares about service, customer satisfaction and the training of their employees in lieu of just hiring a body that only cares about a pay check and what time they get off work. I am willing to bet that the Walmart company never follows up on any reviews or complaints, good or bad. If they did we the customers would see a difference in customer and employee attitudes.

The stock information for in store products has been wrong on multiple occasions. The isle information is sometimes wrong. I don't see a way to leave a review on a product I decided to return. The review interface says I have no products to review! I do like using it to pay when I forget my wallet at stores that don't accept tap yet! when the isle information is correct it saves me walking around looking for items. So 2 ⭐ instead of 1!

I’m older and am not sure if I understand the procedure to correctly order delivery from Walmart. I sent in an order last evening for delivery today and signed up for Walmart plus. Today I see there are items not available. It asked if I wanted to reorder? Okay. I wanted to reorder. Turns out that I wasn’t signup for Walmart plus! Was I charged the annual $98 fee? Will I be charged a delivery fee for today’s order? Another issue. Why am I asked to give a tip to the delivery driver? First of all, I don’t know if the delivery person will do a good job. So I select no tip. Then I see that I’m not signed up for Walmart plus and go back to that issue. When I returned to my order, the tip was back in my order. I think customers would be better served to tip according to the service received instead of tipping before the service is rendered. I know our society is based on tipping and I have no problem with tipping a worker for good service. I’m probably a bigger tipper than the average customer but please don’t make it seem as though I’m expected to tip prior to seeing what I’m tipping for.

reviews.t: Say what you will about Wal Mart
reviews.x: This is the most affordable store in the country, currently, as far as full service grocery and health and beauty aides. Access to healthy, fresh food is a big issue for people in my socioeconomic circle, and we value it no less than Whole Foods shoppers, despite the commonly accepted stigma about Wal Mart shoppers. This company makes it possible for me to purchase necessary items for my son and have them delivered to him rather than having to spend gas money to drive them to him. Signing up for the delivery is a must, and it also enables me to get the things I need without having to worry about having a ptsd episode in a crowded store. And even when I do, nobody at Wal Mart judges me or makes me feel guilty or embarrassed, even when I’ve had to hide in the bathroom for twenty minutes or more to calm myself, there’s always a smiling understanding person who is non-judgemental to prevent any misunderstandings or further stress on me, and that’s invaluable. So while I wasn’t always a huge fan of Wal mart or the people who shop there, I think it’s becoming more and more of a mixed bag due to the state of the economy. You have my vote, Wal Mart, thank you.

cancelled my order IMMEDIATELY after purchasing. was like $150 & was cancelled due to “suspicious activity” when all i did was add a new card. i connected with an agent over chat & they said that i can reorder in 24 hours but i wont get the refund until 10 business days. i said i cant reorder until i get the money back & i have a newborn baby & ordered essentials. i dont just have disposable money laying around. when i told him that he didnt respond to me for 10 minutes & when i said “hello?” he said “yes im here” & then didnt say anything again for 5 more minutes & then Ai started talking to me asking me questions. when i tried to reconnect it said that i couldn’t chat anymore & had to call in the morning. he literally waited until 2 am when the chats would be automatically disconnected. terrible. my newborn is sleeping & i need to sleep too & i could have been using that time to do so but instead had me sitting there waiting & i also said that as well. i would give this 0 stars if i could but unfortunately i have to give 1. please do better. especially for new moms that need essentials for their babies & don’t have a car. i will never be ordering from here again.

reviews.t: Store options limited and app is going crazy
reviews.x: The app is glitching a lot and I can’t add things to cart for some reason. It just says more buying options. Please fix You need to open up the option for people to shop elsewhere. Not limited based on their address.. and your app needs to be updated and we should be able to make purchases in store for the same item. That is also online for the lower costing price. Especially if it is Walmart. It’s very frustrating when I can buy something that’s right in front of me and instead of doing that I have to buy it online in order to get the cheaper price. If all other stores can price match their own stores, I don’t understand why your store doesn’t. I especially hate the fact that I can’t order from different stores that have what I need usually versus the stores near me and the people that don’t actually go and look for the things that I have requested, and I end up having a whole bunch of unavailable. Then my fresh fruit ends up being not so fresh fruit because the limited amount of good stuff that’s in the store that I can’t get because your app won’t let me choose a different store. Because of my address. Walmart, you need to get it together.

Edit: Happened again, their solution? Give them your email or phone number so you can use their wifi and they get to use your data. Awful fix. Sick of having to get a cart full of groceries only to waste my time and not be able to pay for them. I just left. Was about to pay for my groceries and walmart app went down for the whole store. Couldnt even pay for anything and i had a cart full and didnt have any other means to pay. The time when i really needed it, it failed me.

There are a few things that would make the Walmart shopping app so much better: the ability to choose and lock your searches to Walmart retailer, the ability to search an entire group of products, e.g., all furniture from better homes and gardens (there are too many clicks to get to this; it’s embedded about three clicks inside the furniture category. Just let me select furniture and give me filters Immediately). The ability to look at everything in your cart at once and see whether it is shipping, pick up, or delivery in the item text under each thing in the cart instead of grouping it by shipping method. Seeing the toggle for the entire order for some reason isn’t helpful. The Walmart app is very slow; also when looking at an item, the product description is far below similar items, suggested and sponsored items. I want to see the description and specs right under the item I am viewing. There’s too much scrolling down. We appreciate that you have to pay for this service with sponsored items, but it’s too much. We can’t see what we are actually buying without having to go through all this

reviews.t: Just an opinion about the search bar!
reviews.x: For some reason, I get frustrated when the search bar does not delete automatically after entering an item to search! It’s probably just me, but when I’m ready to type in another item; I have to tap on the search bar then tap the X to clear the search bar just to type in the next item. It’s just a few extra steps that’s not needed in my opinion and possibly could be easily corrected by your technical design IT staff. But other than that, the Walmart + experience online shopping and home delivery program is very good and needed by us disabled people. And I have to give an exceptional job to the two supercenters that I use, with one in Russellville, Kentucky and the other in Springfield, Tennessee! You all have a good program going here so keep up the good work and this old, broken down disabled Cop thanks you very much! And one more thing this is the first time I ever wrote a review about an app so that is saying a lot!!!!

App kept glitching on me and I had to close and reopen at least 4 times for it to catch up. Then when I was selecting my substitutions it would randomly jump to a different item. For example I would type in “onion” and while scrolling through the onion options it would jump to Doritos causing me to have to exit the screen and tap “search” again and then retype the item (onion) - then hurry to select the back-up option before it did it again. Most importantly, having to reselect ALL of your substitutions anytime you leave the “checkout” screen is a bust! If my order was the size of my regular grocery hauls I wouldn’t have placed this order today. I usually split my monthly groceries between Vons and Ralph’s (apps) with Vons being my primary, but this month I got rid of Ralph’s and tried making WalMart my primary. It took me twice as long because of the above issues. Will definitely continue to use the app and shop here, but PLEASE DO BETTER! (I did not have multiple other apps running, I was on high speed wifi and I was not being impatient- which is why I finished the order and wrote a review! 🙂). Hope this is helpful!

I place a order for p/u, part of which had to be shipped. My credit card company denied the sale & contacted me to confirm that I was really placing two orders to the same place at the same time. I confirmed that it was mine & okay to the credit card company, after which they said to just run it through again & it would be approved. However, Walmart would not rerun it & just kept showing the original decline. I called the store & a very nice lady told me that they cannot do anything with the payment part, but gave me the phone number for the corporate office. Their answering computer insisted that I enter my order number, which I didn’t have because the order did not go through. When I changed my request wording to ask for help with getting an order placed, it told me that I could place the order on line. It refused to give me a human representative until I could give it the information it requested, which of course, was not possible. I feel very disrespected & not valued as a customer. I have been using WalMart less over the last year or so, & now feel that I don’t need to plan on buying from them much if any in the future. After the way I was treated as if I am less valuable than your answering machine, I’m sure you won’t really care, but wanted to let you know what happened in my relationship with your company, just in case there is a human who might still care.

reviews.t: what a nightmare check out system every freaking time.
reviews.x: must you have to have your own wallet system? It’s clearly not the superior one because I have the hardest time every time the idea it seems like it’s supposed to be easy and without fail every time I am left with a headache and most of the time the store is worse, and the worker usually has even more of a harder time understanding than idea which is a real treat. When the features I finally do figure out they’ve been tell me with complete confidence that I am wrong even though they obviously have no idea what they’re doing and know that because they are in fact wrong now at home I still have quite the problem. I sign up for all of your cars thinking I’ll make it easier, but somehow I still have to switch between the apps and it makes it a nightmare. And don’t even think about using a gift card because that a real treat. I’m trying to do that. It’s 2025 everybody else you your gift card no problem. What is the issue? What is the issue with the payment system my God? I needed a car seat delivered quickly to my house right now and I just spent two hours because of the payment system. And I remember now why I hate going to Walmart right now Jesus fix it.

While browsing, if there's an item I want to look at, I'll click on the item, but when I go back to my search, it starts back at the top of the page. There are only so many times I'll scroll to find where I left off before giving up and looking elsewhere for the item I want to purchase. Also, the pin location for my house is in my neighbor's yard, so I've had packages misdelivered because I can't adjust the pin in the Walmart app. Google maps shows the correct location, so IDK what to do.

Store is great , great young workers , the old ones are rude and obnoxious and my thing is why do they hire security guards or loss prevention wich I’m pretty sure to my knowledge as being a business owner the store should have great insurance policy for loss , stolen, broken merchandise I would like to see instead of pain, loss prevention or a security guard. That’s just a waste of money higher. Younger teenagers and younger adults and also higher teenagers and younger adults with special needs a lot of big stores are doing it Kroger is doing it , meijers is doing it and aldi Is doing it I believe everybody deserves a chance in life, I think it would be a great idea and it would be better for the payroll, no use of hiring loss prevention or security guards just a waste of money and a waste of resources when you can build for the future by having the youth more involved remember, it’s all about the future that how you will sustain growth, no offense to the older people who are 40 and up I just believe with the name Wallmart lingers more with the youth and more technology, but overall it’s a great store with great prices I just wish they can stop being in the 90s early 2000s mindset hiring security guards and loss prevention wasting resources when the money can go to technology and to the youth I believe that the older people have had in advantage by earning their status into getting Social Security more quick quicker than the youth would Wallmart it’s time for a change let the change be the new future God bless

Update: The app let's you shop for items that are unavailable. Example, for some items, it will not even label it low in stock so you can be prepared, if the item becomes unavailable. Old: I tried to ship an item that is available for shipping and gift eligible, but the app wasn't working properly. So, when I went to view cart to select "item is a gift" so I can complete my purchase, the app kept defaulting a a pick up order that I already placed.

when you're looking at products, they charge you a different price for ordering online. but they're showing you the in-store price, so when you are interested in the item, they switch the price to an 'online price' this is bait and switch and I wish Walmart could get SUED for wasting my time. Walmart and Amazon must be in cahoots because I need the real pricing UPFRONT. not on the next page. sometimes Amazon doesn't even show a price until you press the item . stop the greed already.

I wish they'd stop putting unnecessary updates into this app. Can no longer just add items from your frequent purchases because they've replaced the "add item" button with "subscribe". Too many changes added lately and it takes twice as long to place an order. Please just leave well enough alone.. it was fine before and now it's not. I get tired of these stupid cumbersome updates they keep adding & just go order from the Meijer grocery pickup instead..

reviews.t: They May Randomly Close Your Account with Zero Explanation
reviews.x: I started my Walmart + membership on a free trial a couple weeks ago but have yet to use it. I went on there today and it says “This account has been closed. Please refer to the email we sent you.” They never sent an email. Apparently they will close your account and blacklist you randomly without notice. Based on others experiences, one sure way to get blacklisted is if you return too many items. I haven’t shopped at Walmart in many years, so that can’t be it. After looking at their policies more closely, it specifies that it will close your account if you use their free trial more than once. I can’t remember if I had a free trial with Walmart years ago or not. THEY offered me the free trial when I logged in. This company has always been a joke and that’s why I’ve chosen not to spend my money with them for all these years. Turns out they are still a joke. They have my credit card number on file and are supposed to charge me in a couple of weeks, yet they can’t even send an email letting me know my account has been closed. Slimy business practices with poor communication. Just look around online - lots of interesting stories out there. Spend your money with companies that deserve it. Walmart is not it. Good luck!

Love shopping with the app but it now takes FOREVER to shop because the app no longer retains my substitution preferences (usually, I shop from my favorites section and just click them into cart and they keep my substitution preferences in memory week to week). Now, when I shop from my favorite items list it takes forever to keep re-adding substitutions, only to have them disappear again. They are no longer automatically there when I shop from the saved area of favorite things Ive purchased -AND if I chose new substitutions and place the order…the subs are missing when I go back into the order. Later, I get an email asking me to chose preferences for substitutions. The other thing is, I cannot use the custom tip during order. I can enter a custom amount but there is no “ok” or “save” or whatever button. Also, it should not default to a tip or to a set percentage or, to any tip at all. I should select the tip section myself. I can only imagine someone trying to pinch pennies only to find out that the app chose to both add a tip and a higher default % of tip. That said, it also no longer lets me edit my tip during the week as I update/add to my order or if I go in to make a custom tip…no option to edit. THIS was the only place I could find to enter this info - no app developer link to report problems anywhere.

I ordered delivery from Walmart after 9 deliveries from Payless resulted in 9 major headaches! Payless gives you ‘store credit’ on missing/damaged items whereas here you actually get your money back as a refund. I’ve had a much better experience with Walmart! I do wish that you had a better option on unavailable items. The ham hocks I ordered weren’t available, and there was only one option as a replacement as neck bones. I would have bought a whole ham though. If you could add a “search” option in the unavailable section, it would allow us to select something different if we choose. Neck bones don’t have the rind on them & that’s what I need for flavoring in making ham & beans. Also, a “Tip” was originally created for services rendered & THAT should still be in force, not included automatically in the transaction & as a part of their hourly wage. You should at least hold the tip until after delivery in case it wasn’t satisfactory. Plus, collecting the tip at purchase is based on % of what’s ordered, so when $10 of items aren’t available/delivered, it should also change the tip! One driver delivered EVERY canned item I ordered as badly dented cans. The only other down side is paying a delivery fee & then having unavailable/damaged items. Because you still need those items - you’ve already paid in good faith for them to be delivered, yet, since you don’t have them, what? Order another $35 worth of stuff, pay ‘another’ delivery fee annnd another tip? That’s not quite fair. Even on the substitute items… I just got a notice that my 10 lbs of potatoes ($5.64) aren’t available, & had chosen the 2 - 5lb potatoes for $6.46 as replacement. Great customer service would have offered those 2 - 5lb bags for the same price - they’re the same brand. Overall, I’ve had a great experience with Walmart. My fingers are crossed that potatoes are available - I didn’t get them on my last order either! :(

I spent an hour on the Walmart app today trying to order a few things that I needed and for some very irritating reason some of my items kept switching themselves from shipping to pickup! 2 of the food items that had been accepted for shipping moved to pickup automatically after I added a candy item for shipping! Say what?!?! After I deleted the candy item from my cart, those same 2 food items that had moved to pickup moved themselves back to shipping! Say what?!? So I can't add candy to my cart for shipping unless I'm made to pickup my other 2 items? After waisting alot of my time trying to figure out how to get all my items shipped to me, the app ended up allowing the two food items and the candy to ship only if I was picking up an item as well. So I found the cheapest item for $.50 to pick up in order to have what I really wanted shipped to me. I was then able to check out and pay for the order. Needless to say I won't be picking up the $.50 item. I've been ordering online for the past 30 some odd years and this is the most rediculous, inconvenient and irritating ordering process I have ever had to deal with.

This is in regards to something I find very able to control and unnecessary to view head on twice now with no guessing about it. I have always in order to help- (totally by my own belief and never asked to do by an associate) got on the opposite side of my quad cab to bring products across to make room for the next items being brought in the truck, as a courtesy and the last couple of purchases the way items at times are tossed, handled with no concern will in the future be reported in detail!

I like your delivery system. I like all the communication. I like that your communication sounds enthusiastic about receiving my order and delivering it to me. There’s just one that I don’t like and that’s the one where you tell me my cart is ready; only I determine when my car is ready; and when it’s ready, I submit my order. Also, I can’t tell you how many times I have ordered home delivery, probably over 20 times. Every time I have said no substitutions. It seems like the app should know that and I should not have to mark no substitutions every time I order. also, I enjoy your sweet promo. But do those promo codes have to be so long? 10 characters is a lot when a person is working on just one device. And now I have added my prescriptions to be delivered. Wow! It was very easy to do because I was already getting my prescriptions filled at Walmart so there wasn’t much to do to connect my groceries and my prescriptions. Thank You!

A few weeks ago I ended up with a flat tire and needed a new one. I had excellent service in the automotive department at Jacksonville, IL Walmart. However, when it was time to pay…there was an issue. I was paying with my Walmart pay app….which I still had a large sum on an online gift card that I wanted to use for this purchase. I often pay this way at the self checkouts. However, it wasn’t working right in the automotive department. I ran it a different way and it didn’t give me an option as to which card to use. It ended up charging my debit card instead. A “coach” Adam was already back there helping with another situation and overheard what happened. He was AMAZING and nice and decided he would do what he could to help. He didn’t have the answer, but we went to the front to customer service and he assured me he would sort it out. They guided him with how to handle it and he figured it out. My daughter and I stayed patient and friendly, knowing it was out of their control what had happened. I felt like I was holding him up, but he was so kind about the situation. Keep up the great work Adam! Thank you so much for your kind customer service and excellent leadership.

Why do the delivery drivers always drive around for half hour to hour past expected delivery time before they call and get directions? It’s extremely frustrating watching them drive in circles around neighborhood and then go far away and come back. When try to contact driver no one ever answers. I have ordered things through Walmart app many of times. The idea of it is very good and convenient when they actually come through. There are delivery drivers that say they attempted to deliver but never even tried to contact me and then suddenly I was suppose to pick up item which makes pointless to even order. On other occasions my orders have cancelled on me or something becomes temporarily unavailable and then I’m suppose to wait for refund or hold on money from bank for charge. Which I’m waiting right now. The last order I made from them an item became unavailable and then I’m delivery driver left my order on community mailboxes in the area across a river. It was gone by time I got to it. I selected option leave at my door not wherever anyone feels like putting my stuff. There delivery service is unreliable and I’m not sure having Walmart+ is worth it if gonna have constant issues where I can’t receive my orders that I’m paying ahead for.

The store itself is safe and clean. The variety and quality of items is probably a little less than a Walmart in a better area. The biggest problem is that a third of the items in the store are behind glass cases, and it is a struggle to find an employee to open them. That makes the shopping take very long and it is a pain. Overall, it is OK.

reviews.t: It’s good but watch thieves on delivery
reviews.x: I have had Walmart plus for years and gotten deliveries, I also spark myself. Of lately, since they allow uber drivers to deliver, iv been having things missing from orders. It’ll show it was scanned and included in order, paid for etc but more than half my stuff from last 5 orders have been missing. Crucial items too like meat for supper causing me to have to drive to town after paying for delivery. I enjoy the idea but even after I have called to let them know Iv had someone steal stuff(Iv even gotten it on video of someone handing my loin to someone else in car once and this person STILL drives for spark) and Walmart never does anything. Like I said Iv named people out and told them I have video proof and they still drive for spark. It makes other spark drivers look bad. I am honest and don’t steal but Iv noticed tips have completely 360, like no one is tipping even driving 20 miles to their house and shopping for their stuff. I am honest but the thieves ruin it for us honest ones too.

I don’t like to write negative reviews, but I’m really frustrated right now. This review isn’t re a specific item, but it’s about the system itself. I’ve had this issue before, but not quite this bad. I just purchased an on-line order of several items. The items I chose all said they were available to be shipped. When I got to the checkout phase, one of the items said it was being removed from my cart because it was unavailable. Ok, I’ve had that happen before with this very same item (eye drops) so a little weird, but not a big deal. So then I get to the very end of the check out phase …. And all of a sudden more than half of my items are unavailable. It was like 3/4 of my entire order was unavailable. What the heck is going on??? I don’t understand at all!!! These items aren’t unique things either, they’re like common things. Common things that seemed to be available the whole time I was shopping. I’ve thought about getting a plus membership in the past, but what would be the point when you can’t even order the normal things you’d like to purchase, like body lotion, toothpaste, q-tips, etc. I don’t know where Walmart has their warehouses, but it gives the impression that they’re somewhat empty???

reviews.t: Sluggish, inconsistent response, buggy, doesn’t accept changes, can’t feedback Walmart shopper
reviews.x: Overall I think the app is OK. Seems to fairly well represent the in-store availability of items that I purchase for Walmart+ shopping. The issues I run across are in that appears to be bugs and features. For example, when wanting order multiple items, I can’t just type in the quantity, I have to use + or -. Well, the app is really slow to recognize the taps and I often end up with more or less than what I actually wanted in my cart and then have to adjust, and then again after I think I successfully edited it but, oh, I didn’t. As for delivery, I can’t actually set a custom tip for my delivery driver even though there is an option to set a custom tip, you can fill in the field and yet it does nothing, whatever the last automatic tip percentage selected was is what appears in the total. Then there is the actual Walmart shopper themselves, there should be some way to rate and make comments on the Walmart shopper, who has nothing to do with the delivery driver, because that is a Walmart employee. And I do not believe, for one second, that every single time I order a dairy product that the Walmart shoppers just happen to give me the open dairy that I can’t do anything with other than throw it away. I’ve had to get refunds on milk, heavy whipped cream, pudding, and yogurt in every order I’ve done. And every time it’s been on dairy products that are clearly open and leaking with both dried on crusty dairy and leaking dairy still coming out of the container, and my favorite, a hole in the side of the container with huge globs of rice pudding stuck to the outside in mounds. It’s just gross… and no way to give feedback.

I’ve had the worst experience using this app, I tried purchasing AirPods second gen and when I tried buying them it placed the order then canceled it right away. I thought it might be my card so I tried it on a different one and the same thing happened, I call Walmart to figure out what’s happening and they say they didn’t know but they could give me a refund. When I got the refund I purched again because I assumed the item was out of stock the first time when I orderd again it supposedly came a week early but I had no package I call Walmart once again and they said they will contact the seller the seller comes back and says they never had that order number and tell me to go act Walmart again. After I do Walmart goes back and forth with the seller about 3 times then tells me they’ll contact the seller one more time and if the seller replys with no solution that they’ll give me a refund on Walmarts behalf. By this time it’s almost a week passed since my order was suppose to me delivers. I just got a email from Walmart telling me to figure it out with my bank and ask to issue the charges. I don’t liek being promised something then getting it taken away from my face especially because I spent my time that I could’ve used better trying to solve with Walmart and came to a resolution but clearly didn’t happend and I’m not sure how my bank will solve the issue for my order. I’m very disappointed.

Overall a very useful app. But changes made a couple revisions ago messed up its efficiency. When I order from the my items list it used to be simple. Click for how many of an item I wanted and move on. Now with the Subscribe option, thr majority of the time I have to go into an item and back out to add it to my cart. Also the "im on my way option" for pickup shows up to use maybe 1 out of every 5 orders.

Constant issues with the delivery service as well as the app. Rarely get whole orders, often get random/damaged items, and that's IF it even shows at the right address. Lost orders, poorly updated availability, substitutions or more often items get canceled without any attempt to substitute, promo codes given to make up or replace often don't work. Paying the additional cost of express doesn't guarantee speedy delivery. Received a sample pack with a severe allergic reaction. Avoid if possible.

Absolutely love the delivery service, however it’s a bit unnerving at times. I have had incorrect items delivered, for example cabbage instead of lettuce, yet my account will reflect I purchased lettuce. Money is held on your card, so if you have a dedicated card for just this, you can go back and try to track. Other than feeling insecure about leaving myself open to fraud somewhere in the delivery engine, the deliveries have been very quick & I’ve been pleased, but accuracy has been hit or miss, you have to grin & bare with the quality of fresh items & always be prepared for not receiving items or settling for substitutions-depending on the day or the level of commitment from the shopper to locate said item. If your relying on a stranger to do your shopping and let’s face it-in this economy no one can afford to tip as much as we we like or maybe normally do, I’m grateful for the service. Just wish the site & service was more user friendly. I couldn’t even complete the silly tutorials when I signed up to get some reward. It literally would not let me watch the ridiculous video. So….pros and cons for sure. It’s worth it for anyone that is busy with a family & needs that extra hand-so far worth it. Watch your statements & account & ALWAYS tip! 😉

I'm changing my review to three stars. In the last 4 months, I am no longer able to use the scan and go feature at my neighborhood Walmart. It requires an associate to finish the purchase, and then completely voids my shopping cart. This means that I have to remove absolutely all my groceries from their bags, and scan them a second time through the self-checkout. Now the same thing is happening at the nearest supercenter every 4th or 5th shopping trip. This needs to be fixed.

Iv paid for Walmart plus for over a year now. When I first started it was wonderful. My orders came quickly with no issues. But I the service has been consistently getting worse and worse. I made a food order of no more than $100 (not a lot considering prices) my child and I had to wait 3 days for that order- after three days.. they informed me my order was going to also be delayed in delivery.. another 3-5hours. I hate complaining.. but yesterday I tried to order diapers.. I could find any that could be here within the next 5-10 days… 5 days is a crazy wait.. I don’t have a car. So I ordered the only pack that could be here the following day at 10am… they just changed it too 10pm.. now my kid is walking around with a dress and no diaper just hoping today is they day she wants to use the potty. This is a corporation.. if Walmart is low on staff… hire more people. Y’all have the money. There is plenty of people looking for employment in our area. 3 day wait for food & 5 or more for diapers is a little much when I pay every month..

walmart plus is not worth it when you have to pay for a monthly fee, plus a tip for the driver. they also often leave things off of your order, especially when shipping from the south euclid store. they are consistently inconsistent and not worth the money if you're counting on receiving a certain item.

The app used to work until today January 1 2025 now I can't order anything. Called the 800 number and they couldn't do anything said they would fix the app they are having technical issues. When it's fixed I'll review it again if I can order my groceries again if not I'll be deleting the app altogether. I will have to use the Kroger or Meijer app to get groceries if it is not fixed soon. 4 am 1/2/2025 I see they must've fixed the app I can again order groceries. Thank you for fixing it.

Update: Since checking my notifications, I see that it did charge me through PayPal even though the incorrect card showed in the app. This is a bug also. And the amounts are different. I just hope I won’t be charged twice! Since the latest update, the app has been more buggy than usual. It is slow and keeps freezing and crashing. I had to add my alternate person 3 times and after updating my payment option to PayPal, it reverted back to my credit card after I placed the order. Thankfully, there is a way to change the card (have to go to Cancel Order and select Wrong Card as the reason) but I couldn’t use PayPal. I had to add a new card to use. Another issue I had, which might just be the service itself, is how I lost my reservation time after switching stores due to a bug with the app. I think the bug might be new though. I added an item to my cart to be shipped since it showed as unavailable from the store my husband was going to pick it up at. I found a similar item and looked at both to compare. It showed the item I had chosen as scheduled for pick up instead of shipping but still showed no availability. I selected shipping and it went right back to pick up. I selected nearby stores and it showed available at my store so I selected it but the main item screen still showed it as unavailable and wouldn’t let me choose shipping at all. So I chose another store where it was available, then switched it back to my store (the availability was updated and it showed 3 available) so I opted for pick up. But this caused me to have to choose a new reservation time for an hour later. I hope these get fixed with a new update.

Searching for items outside of the grocery store has become a nightmare. For example, I searched for a 100-piece Christmas jigsaw puzzle. The first item was one with 1,000 pieces. I had made no typos in my inquiry. The whole selection was a motley mix of puzzle sizes. Next, I looked for large-print Christmas puzzle books. Again, I received choices of many items completely unrelated to puzzle books: Bibles, novels, & jigsaw puzzles. After a half dozen searches, I went to Amazon to buy gifts.

They've removed the option to review items. Sometimes when I try to open a previous purchase in my purchase history, I just get an error page. Discrepancies with item availability - Sometimes it shows that an item is in stock on the item page, so I add it to my cart. But when I try to check out, it says out of stock. But if I remove it from my cart and reload the item's page, it still shows that it's in stock there.

reviews.t: Let’s do better Walmart if I could give negative stars I surely would
reviews.x: Was purposely removed from the at home program against my well I stated several times during the conversation that I wanted to continue to be in the Walmart at home, ignored me, deleted me from there anyways. That was last week they did not give me the items that I ordered should be no biggie right items totaled out to like $10 asked for $15 coupon because it took three hours to figure out oh she didn’t get these.. new coupon is only valid if you use food stamps. I didn’t use food stamps to pay for the express delivery so how does that work? So now my child sits at home with no milk still I will not be paying for this again almost every single order. I have to argue with somebody the customer service is rude. I’ve been lied to gaslit hung up on all today. It took three hours for them to even figure out that somebody gave me a food stamp only coupon which doesn’t make sense because I paid cash for part of the order. I will be letting food stamp administration know about this. I spend way too much money with Walmart and I have referred way too many people there to be treated the way I have been today. With still no items that I had been missing for previously despite the four hours today and the three hours last night I spent dealing with us. Even this review is refusing to send. How do they get away with this?

This app actively tries to fight your ability to shop sometimes, especially when it hides the bottom navigation bar when you are looking at a search list or a product. Being greeted with a full-page ad every time you load the app is also a hindrance when you know what you are shopping for beforehand. What kind of business strategy is it to make sure customers get too frustrated to buy from you? Just take the money! You don't need to make it so convoluted!

reviews.t: Love the app, just one big downfall.
reviews.x: All in all, the app is great and is a time saving convenience. For the most part it is relatively easy to navigate. I only have one complaint which knocks this review down 2 stars. The customer service via the app and/or customer support through the app is highly flawed. I had an order that I shopped through the app in store and had clipped and claimed a handful of items for Walmart cash back. Upon completion of the transaction, I received the cash back for only one item. The sad part here is, these were items I would not typically purchase while shopping but I was willing to give them a shot since they had cash back. I read the terms, as I always do. I tried getting assistance through the app, Walmart customer service phone number and the physical store. All to be passed around and the blame pointed in every direction with no one willing to help me get to the bottom of it. I forgive the store as their defense is highly likely that they have nothing to do with the app pertaining to cash back at store level. It seems as if it would indeed be a corporate or online department issue to resolve as the store is not responsible for dispersing cash back, the app is.

better management would be in order to keep things stocked on the shelf that people use. Always saying you’re out of something is poor management. This is especially true on items that do not go bad very quickly. While you do show occasionally on the Walmart app how many of a particular item are left that should be your clue to increase the level of inventory in that particular store. Maybe some executives should get their feet off of the desk and actually get out and actually speak to the customers and make them comfortable enough for the customer to tell them what they don’t like about Walmart. You folks always want a review but you only really want a review if it’s favorable and praises you and make sure ego blow up. Executives aren’t the ones doing the work the ones making success off the backs of the people under them that in the back of their mind, they referred to us peons and don’t tell me I’m wrong because you know in the back of your mind, that’s how you think. You might want to train your employees to be more friendly and more helpful in all of your stores not just one. The issue is that you have them working so hard that they cannot get the job done and treat the guest in your store like they really should be treated. This is because you have some executive with his feet on the desk reading a chart to determine the amount of service, when you go in the store and have to check out your own items and then show your receipt when you walk out the door. I don’t recall a W-2 from Walmart for me and having to do your job for you. Provide enough help so we don’t have to wait. Walmart needs to take on the Publix supermarket idea of helping people get the items to their car and helping them load them. It’s called service and Walmart needs to learn it.

I wanted to put an order in, but when I went to My Lists, I was missing a few. It only says I have 2 Lists, but, it does not show them, and there's nothing to click on to bring them up. One of those lists had $700 worth of items I buy regularly. Some were recipes. I even went into the purchase history, and all my purchases are gone too. This is frustrating.

Please update your app for those of us who order Delivery/Pickup from the store, to be able to chat with the shopper & include an option for the shopper to send pictures of items unavailable. It stresses me out now that my car is in the shop to rely on workers who don’t care about their job. I have children who drink milk and I use milk in a lot of my dishes and baking. You have employees stating milk is unavailable, even when substitutions are allowed. When I spoke to an agent through Walmart chat & they provided me a phone number to contact my store, speaking to the employee who went back there stated there was milk on the shelf. He would have assisted me IF I was a Pickup order but since I was a delivery order they needed to ‘Speak to their manager who was at lunch.’ And when I used to have my vehicle and used Walmart pickup, you STILL have employees stating items are unavailable. I’ll have my husband run in the store to check & the item is right there on the shelf!!! If you’re going to hire employees who don’t care about their job, at least add the option to chat with them and send pictures of unavailable items. At least instacart does it!! And if the shopper doesn’t respond to us instacart can read the history and be able to assist us customers appropriately vs just taking our word. Not only will yall start to save money from having less refunds with bad quality items, yall can actually see who cares about their job and who doesn’t & let go of incompetent employees.

For once, Walmart is actually getting it correct the app is very easy to use even when placing online orders if for some reason there is an issue with your order, they do automatic refunds and there’s pretty much no questions asked. Every time I’ve been able to make an order, it has gone through seamlessly orders are ready when I ask them or they are delivered on time. The only catch I would have for delivery orders is that they’re not on the same day. Most of the times packages may arrive multiple days, including day after day during the same week, but that has more to do with their fulfillment center versus the app. Walmart stores have become extremely crowded and for the most part kind of difficult to use so I enjoy being able to order online and get my orders that day or when I actually am going to be driving by the Walmart. The other nice thing is that I can switch Walmart especially since I work several miles away I can choose a Walmart closer to work and just pick up my order on the way home

Mostly works ok, but where is the favorites list? I heart items but there is no way to access the list without hitting the heart on a new item and opening from there. Lists tab says there's 3 lists, but there only ever 2. Beyond that, the biggest problem is the lazy people picking the order, get notified of items being out of stock, when they're not, app says in stock , before and after placing order. Had them tell me bread was out of stock once, went in the store and bread isle was full

I tried to place a large order through a walmart platform seller but walmart kept blocking it for fraud. I have an active account there and everything was the same including the shipping address, items I was purchasing, my phone #, etc. i even turned on location services in the app so that it would hopefully see that my order would ship to the same address I've received orders to before and am physically at while placing the order. The only thing that had changed from previous orders was the amount was much larger than normal and with a new payment method. Walmart's customer service is extremely quick, friendly, and knowledgable but powerless to help in this situation. There was no way to verify my identity or otherwise get them to let my transaction go through other than wait up to 2 days for an email from their fraud prevention team. So instead I went to Costco and gave them a substantial amount of money instead. I know even this significant purchase for me is peanuts to walmart but turning away people looking to spend many thousands of dollars in a single transaction seems pretty dumb to me. Thankfully one of their competitors was willing and able to assist. In the future I'll still shop walmart and continue to buy and hold shares in their company but when I want to drop a bunch of cash I probably would either shop elsewhere or in person since the app kneecaps larger purchases.

reviews.t: Pick up and delivery orders are often missing items or have wrong items
reviews.x: I’ve been reluctant to get items delivered to my house because often items are missing or wrong items delivered. Then I have to call the 800 number and tell them what I’m missing so I can get credit for it. It takes a while to get the money back into your account. When I pick up orders, items often are missing or they replace an item with another item by mistake even if you put down Do Not substitute. Then you have to get out of your car go to Customer Service wait on a big line to return the item. Then customer service tells you that the item cannot be returned because it’s not in your purchase history and you have to explain to them my pick up order had wrong items in the bag, and I want to return them and of course these items are not in my purchase history history because I never did order them or buy them. Now I only go to the store, my orders my deliveries are reduced to almost 0.

The associates are always friendly. They do a awesome job at picking out my produce. This helps me out a lot. I’m so happy that yall deliver to my home, but my last experience was not good. Walmart associates didn’t put all my items into the back of the vehicle. Thank God my granddaughter was at the house and realized as we were putting up groceries that not all my items were delivered. I called Walmart and they told me that they had my items that things got hectic and they had been overlooked. They stated that they had tried to call the driver but he didn’t answer his phone. I asked them if they were gonna send someone else out to deliver my items and was told no that they had already been marked as delivered but I could drive to the store and pick them up. I stated that this was their fault not mine and that I shouldn’t have to waste my gas to drive down there. They then stated that I could put in for a refund on the items I did not receive. I found out later that the same thing happened to my sister in law.

Started off good ended up horrible, lately I’ve been having issues with my orders. The last 3 orders to be exact. The first order they switched the drivers without notifying me and claimed that my item was dropped off, which wasn’t so I had to contact support over the phone to receive my refund that took about 5 days. The second time the app said that my groceries were delayed and that they couldn’t drop it off to me and they never hired a new driver or rescheduled my order, I had to talk to support so they can cancel my order and I can get my refund, which the refund takes days to return when I needed those groceries that day. The third order I ordered 27 items and only received 10 of my items. Why am I missing over half of my order? So I just had to get another refund for that. I’m about to be done using this app they can’t seem to get nothing right off of simple orders. If you don’t contact support they will leave you hanging to figure it out on your own. And I’m not about to keep waiting for refunds when I request for my items to come that day that I need them to come with no issues, it should be so simple you would think. There’s no reason I should have to contact customer support this much

I personally don’t recommend the delivery function to anyone. Often I am unable to contact my driver. They do not read my instructions and it results an rat race in an attempt for me to get my groceries. The last time I have tried Walmart’s delivery, the driver(s) repeatedly did not follow my instructions and it resulted in a delivery to the wrong address or a failed delivery. Walmart charged me despite this. I contacted them and ,after much trouble, got it refunded only to have my card still charged a few days later. I am a college student without a car and with limited money and time . I do not have the cash to be giving to Walmart and now I have to unfortunately wait for my bank to dispute the charge. There is no telling when they’ll get back to me about that. I feel like crying. I have been using Walmart’s delivery service for almost 2 years because I do not have a car. It is often my only option to get the supplies and groceries I need. I am tired of stress and inconsistency with this service continues to provide. That fiasco will be the final time I ever use Walmart for deliveries unless major changes are made to improve their systems. I will be taking my business to more reliable services that actually care about communication and making sure deliveries get to the proper address.

**Update, thanks for your response, but that won’t do me any good. Oh how I’d love to actually be able to speak to customer service. Unfortunately, the bots at be decided during the height of Covid lockdowns, that I was a naughty bunny and closed my online account. But of course, I can still spend THOUSANDS a year in store. You know what’s funny? I can still remember exactly what I returned during that time, nothing was out of the norm. I did, however, return the Zinus padded headboard bed, TWICE, because the legs broke, TWICE, and now, low and behold, they have been recalled for causing I believe over 200 injuries….may be time for someone to do an audit and see how many good online customers they lost during that time. My point telling you this is, if I try to contact Walmart customer service, I get the generic, please refer to your email about being banished…..blah, blah, blah….can’t even order my children’s in-store cakes online. Have to go in and bother the awesome bakery employees. Publix is opening just down the road soon, yay!!!** What is the point of having an app if it won’t open inside the store!!! Had over $5 in rebates to get and it would not open!!! Turned phone off and in, cleared cache, app Is up to date. So annoying!!!

You’re looking for a certain type of collectible say an action figure that’s a Walmart exclusive. That’s hard to find that they currently sell. The only thing that pops up is third party sellers that ask a 2 to 300% markup on average even as high as 1000% markup depending on the collectible even higher. Unlike target it shows the target price and says out of stock gives the option to notify me when it’s back in stock. and you can check directly there yourself to see what stores and what areas have it so you can pay retail through target instead of this Walmart marketplace that makes it look like it’s coming from Walmart to the uneducated consumer. there are currently several Walmart exclusives that the only thing I find on there are the third-party sellers they only advertise marketplace. They do not show their original and you can’t scan the barcode. It’s a lot different than target and I’ve been unable to get it, and I’m unwilling to spend the asking price that these sellers are asking. i’ve been in the stores and all I’ve heard from the customer service. Is they get nothing but complaints from customers about this these third-party sellers even make it look like it’s coming from Walmart. Walmart does this to compete with platforms like eBay and Mercari and in return, they’re doing their customers a disservice and it’s making less and less people want to buy at Walmart. In the last 10 years, Walmart has become what went from the five star gold standard shopping center for everything to the bottom of the barrel last place you wanna go.

reviews.t: Current Walmart app not user-friendly for blind users
reviews.x: I am a blind person who is an avid Walmart app user. Not sure if it is a recent update, but using the Walmart app to shop has become a complete frustration. I use iPhone iOS with voiceover to navigate the Walmart app. After searching for items and the results page displays, it is impossible to swipe through the items. At the end of each item, the swiping functionality stops, and a blind user has to pick up their finger to place it on the next item in order to swipe through to get the details like price, ratings, add to card, etc. You can imagine how difficult this is when you are unable to see the screen. It is completely inefficient and was not like this previously. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app to make sure that it was not an issue with my iphone 15. Not sure if there’s a disconnect between Apple’s voiceover and the Walmart app, but I am sure that this did not exist before. This is actually a deterrent from shopping on Walmart, which I have grown accustomed to and enjoy due to ease of use. Even leaving feedback after an order is placed was frustrating. Please fix the app!

reviews.t: Can’t find my address even after talking to customer support.
reviews.x: Literally every time I order something it sends the driver somewhere else even though my address is entered right. I’ve talked to customer support and they told me they fixed it but they didn’t, so instead of coming to my place they send the driver 20 minutes to the other side of town before they have to enter the address manually so that they can get here. I live like 2 minutes from Walmart, I order delivery like once every month or less if I get sick or need something delivered while I’m at work and it’s always a bad experience for the driver because of this. The interactive map that puts a pin where you live also doesn’t even work. I can’t hit accept, I can’t move it to the right spot or it says I’m too far away from my entered address even though the mark itself is not near my address at all. I’m on iPhone 15 Pro Max, so obviously there is support for my phone still. No idea why this has become such an issue. It can’t be that hard to just use maps or something so that people can actually go to my address instead of using whatever the Walmart maps is, because whatever they use is the worst map on the market hands down.

I wrote this to Walmart. I am 81 years and was traveling very late at night with my young granddaughter. I want to tell you of one of your AWESOME employees. I think her name was Winter. Very young cordial and nice. A good employee for Walmart. Last Saturday night on the 14th of September I was traveling on I45 and turned into Walmart to get gas and I hit your curb under construction. There was no lighting to light up the area and I could not see the curb and hit it and got a flat tire. Several times I tried to get hold of someone to help me on my phone. Your employee went beyond the call of duty and found someone to change/fix my tire. Such a nice man. He did not want any money but I gave him all I had in my pocket. During these times when you read so many bad things about Walmart it's good to get help by a good employee. I'm old so since I had hip surgery I use the pickup in Walmart Bryan Texas every week. And they also are very nice. You need to say thank you to one of your good employees. And Thank you for listening.

The people who deliver my groceries never speak English. I don’t speak Spanish. It’s always difficult to also get them to hand over the groceries! They stand there on their phone speaking to someone….i don’t know who or understand why they can’t just ask me my name and give me my groceries. One time, the delivery person stood in the road in front of my house, talking on his phone for 20 minutes! 20 minutes! What is the reason for this? He also couldn’t speak any English. Another issue I frequently have is that the delivery person gets lost. It’s not hard to find my house in this day and age with GPS on your phone. With the app, I can see on a map where they are in their car. One time, a delivery person entered my community through the gate and I watched him drive around in my small community on your app and then leave the community. Can’t they call me if they’re lost? I’m only one and a half miles from the Walmart! I also leave directions on how to get into my community on your app. It’s very frustrating! Walmart needs to work on these two issues: people who deliver groceries should be able to speak basic English, and also there’s no reason why they can’t get to my house.

My grocery was send to the wrong address after placing my order and specifically requested for my order to be signed for me. I was standing at my door While viewing the app. The app was showing me that my orders was delivered. But there was no order. Upon observation that there must had been a mistake I reached out to Walmart immediately to inform them that I did not receive my order and they informed me that my order was delivered and there was nothing they could do about it. I try calling the number that was listed on profile for the driver but to no avail. My husband was the one who sprung into action by circling the block only to find my groceries on someone else’s door step. So assumed the driver wrote the signature himself and left my order at the wrong address. SMH I was extremely disappointed. And the fact that Walmart just brush me off and sent me to figure it out by myself didn’t sit well with me. There was no fallow up nothing. So from then on I made my way to the store to pick up my order myself.

Idk if this will make it to the feed but I hope it does. Walmart is amazing … their products and prices…, but the PEOPLE and employees LACK training, integrity, knowledge and drive. What happened to QUALITY? And honest businesses?
