Walmart will advertise ALL these products on their site- specifying the certain location and store -  - and you ORDER these items and even choose substitutes based off of what they ADVERTISE that they have (AVAILABLE/IN STOCK/NOT IN STOCK) but then you don’t receive these items but you know what is always available and what you receive?!? WALMART BRAND PRODUCTS!!!! They will advertise a brand name which is unavailable but THRIR VERSION is always available! It’s beyond a pyramid scheme- THEN they put a HOLD on say $460 when your order is $380 total then when you have items missing or not received, your order total is say $310- so HERE THEY ARE WITH $150 of YOUR DOLLARS FOR 10 days while you’re not only without the ITEMS TGAT THEY *ADVERTISE* oh! Don’t forget the delivery charges and Walmart plus and the fact that u paid ten dollars to get it within an hour but you received HALF YOUR ORDER?! lol FALSE ADVERTISING!!!!!!! And I’m without my money (not EBT or food stamps) for a week- and the food I needed- what if this was CHRISTMAS DINNER AND YALL FORGOT AND DIDNT HAVE HALF MY ORDER /ITEMS?!

your updates lately have been simply disorienting everything. Useful data or shortcuts are being moved all over the place pick a convenient place on your main screen and leave them there so we can find them having messages come up and say and something caught your eye. we see you're still interested in something no I'm not but I can't stop you from reminding me of things I looked at, but decided not to purchase, if I was interested, I would've ordered it a brown history that's easy to search through for discounts and other useful information or price changes would be nice. Some people are looking to see if the item has gone on sale or not suggestions usually don't apply to what you're looking for anyway, finding things that are all too often out of stock or discontinued should be dropped from the search options until they are available for purchase. The pharmacy so that you can deal with your prescription updates should be in a convenient location to access easily and not be moved all over the site.

I feel like the whole purpose of downloading this app is so you don’t have to go inside the store and shop and for me I like to pick up my groceries, but I absolutely despise items that are only available for shipping or the button to add to cart isn’t even available. I want to make one purchase not two or three and Walmart likes to charge extra money just to make sure that you have the funds which doesn’t make sense to me but then they give it back to you after they get that was the actual total of your bill so my bill may be $20 but they’re gonna charge me 30 to make sure that there’s funds doesn’t really make sense to me because I feel like it that they miss out on money because all I have is $20 now I gotta wait till next payday or wait till the next time I have $30 just to order a $20 order and then still wait for the $10 to come back. Doesn’t make sense that’s another thing. I don’t like about the Walmart app and yeah, but for the most part lately, the things that I want to add to my cart have not been available to add to my cart if I want to make one big purchase all at one time I don’t have a choice but to go inside the store and get everything myself. When this is fixed, I will change my rating to five stars.

reviews.t: It intentionally makes it difficult to find items
reviews.x: Many items I know this store has would place them at the bottom of the list when typed in word for word showing item I had no interest in and some times not even remotely related. When the free trail is over, I might just skip ahead, I will end it. False advertising as it said if I sign up it would be free delivery tips included. Seriously the tips included was the salting point. Why would I want to tip a person $25 for less than an hour work? I don’t make that and I am not paying it why would anyone? Once you learn tips - to increase positive service. Means that you give it to a person out side of their pay to help encourage them to keep working with the positive attitude they presented you. Seriously $25 tip to retrieve a single item and the person didn’t smile, without the ability to take away the tip because it was forced before I even purchased the item, my favorite was two of three items weren’t found. So should not the TIPs amount be readjusted automatically? Turns out nope. It is a system that Walmart has figured out how to get more money out of your wallet, the whole thing. It is sad. Seriously I find it a darken day with Walmarts rise. If anyone knew the actual potential for destruction Walmart has they would systematically start using other stores. Sorry to rant, just seeing and trying to use this delivery service of theirs reminds me why I am not suppose to shop there. It is blatant in your face mind control, they pull out all the stops and I bet it gets better the more you use it.

This was a highly unusual pickup. In the rain! I cannot log in on app and indicate parking spot. I ask Will as he finished another delivery, in the rain, to please check me in as app not working. A bit later he tells me they cannot locate one of my totes can I return in a half hour or so? I go to the local grocer and acquire the few items that were not available on Wmt order. Cell rings. They found the tote..can I return…so I go back but now cannot log in on app as it shows I have no order. I walk up to the glass doors the delivery staff uses and tap on glass. As I am explaining to a young man, I observe that deer in the headlights look. Another young lady glances and walks the other way. Then a young man speaks up and says no worry we found the tote will bring your order out shortly. Within a minute or two out comes Ben with the full order. We load it up and he is polite, courteous, efficient, and kind. I asked if he was a manager because HE WAS ACTING LIKE ONE! BEN said No maam. I said HE SHOULD BE! He had a great attitude. He is a young man that should be recognized and raised up! Please give these two kudos and a raise and/or promotion. I am a little old white lady (that till three years ago was actively employed in the banking industry) so I can recognize someone with potential. Both Ben and Will have that potential! Please acknowledge them! They are terrific employees with excellent attitudes. I asked for their names because I definitely wanted to recognize them👌 Mab Stl

Due to mobility issues, I utilize the curbside pickup service you offer and am so thankful for it. Today, however, we placed a delivery order. Cleta was our shopper/driver for & her communication via chat was FABULOUS! There were zero bananas left and she sent me a photo of the empty stand. A few other items were unavailable and she informed me of those as well. She sent me a photo of the fresh corn that was left (it was picked over and did not look good). I declined, but asked if I could substitute frozen ears of corn. She said she’d try and then wrote that the system would not allow it. I told her no worries. Seriously… top notch communication! On her way to drop off our order, Cleta stopped at another store in town and bought (and paid) for four ears of corn! Her customer service was EXEMPLARY! I tried to chat back with her, but it was closed. I was able to modify her tip, but would have loved to thank her personally. Cleta, your very considerate and unexpected act of kindness has truly restored my faith in humanity. Thank you so much!

I really like Walmart prices and the quality of Walmart products. The delivery service is great! I also really like the Walmart membership because I can order online almost anything that a Walmart store has with free shipping. Plus the Neighborhood Walmart is so much closer to my location. What I don’t like about ordering from the app is I’m unable to give specific instructions regarding the produce, such as “please select a firm, med ripe tomato,” or “select a small head of cabbage”or “please select latest expiration date “ on fresh meat, dairy etc. The Kroger app offers a space on each item for the customer to give any specific instructions. Only a few times I was disappointed with the produce from a Walmart delivery, especially when I ordered a head of cabbage and the one I got was at least 10-12 inches in diameter. It spoiled before I had time to eat the whole thing. lol. Overall, since I got the Walmart membership, I’ve switched grocery shopping from Kroger to Walmart. I can deal with most of my objections, but I do hope the app will be updated soon. Thanks Walmart!

reviews.t: Wrong groceries that I paid for
reviews.x: The person who delivered my groceries did not knock on my door I did not receive a receipt. The groceries in the bag were wrong I did not receive eggs and they added things that I didn’t have on my list especially the monster pops. They messed that up they messed the pizza rolls up I ordered two bags I got one bag of the little ones so I am very disappointed with the service you guys need to do something about that I called you guys you did not answer the phone so I’m very very need to give me my deposit back because I’m not gonna do this anymore if you can’t get the first order straight then why why I order you guys get. I have a broken ankle and that is the reason why I couldn’t go in I had a heart surgery done and that to me on the receipt nothing and my bags are halfway empty I’m put out I’m. I will be talking to a manager tomorrow because I didn’t even get $75 worth of groceries and I thought I had ordered $136 and then it was $113 I’m like I didn’t even get that much and I don’t want these popsicles so I put them in my freezer so when my nurse comes tomorrowI’m gonna have her take them back to your store there’s a lot of things that I did not get poor poor management I’m very disappointed with your service it will not happen no more

As I finished my weekly shopping yesterday at the Wake Village, Texas store as I was exiting the store, right in the walk way an employee by the name of Donovan was about to walk inside, I stopped him and asked if he would be able to help me unload my case of water for me, he smiled and said yes ma’am I would be happy to help you, I was parked in one of the handicap spots, as I have been deemed disabled. I am an almost 68 year old woman who has had a rough almost 2 years with my health, lifting is not acceptable due to open heart surgery. This young man , loaded all my groceries in my car with kindness and care, I introduced myself and offered to pay him a nice tip, he said , no ma’am that isn’t necessary, I enjoyed helping you. Anytime I am working if you need anything let me know, he went above helping me, to be so young his manners and care he showed touched me deeply, I got in my car and cried. It was hard asking for help and I have always prided myself helping others because it’s the right way to be. I hope the store manager recognizes this exceptional young man . Thank you so much Donovan . Martha McDonald

reviews.t: Consideration goes a long way for shopper and consumer
reviews.x: So I haven’t been in Walmart for a minute. I arrived at 11:40. I only needed a couple of items. I was wondering what time they close now because things do change alot. there was one item in the hair department I struggled finding but an employee was nice enough to help me find it. As I was walking to the registers I grabbed one item and another employee says to me they wouldn’t let me check out. I asked why don’t she said they where closing. Then I heard an intercom’s announcement that the store was closed. As I reached the check out the had the entrance blocked with a cart and a rope. Then the lady looks at me and says we’re closed. It was two minutes after 11 I could have pulled out my phone and use my Walmart app and did scan and pay, but considering I was only two minutes late and I only had five items I figured why should I spend my money there? I feel really bad for anyone who is out of town and unfamiliar with there practice or times. The practice can really work both ways. They don’t have to be considerate and I don’t have to spend my money where I’m not valued. I was rushing and I don’t remember everything but I won’t return to shop with people who don’t want my business.

When doing the online grocery ordering, I get a text telling me I have items that have been substituted. I go to the app to see what the substitution is so I can approve it or not. Lately, it will tell me what item is out of stock but it shows me that the same item is being substituted. The price or size might be different, but the picture and item description I’m shown is the same as the out of stock item. I have no idea what I’m approving. When I pick up my groceries, the substituted item might just be a different brand or size but sometimes, it’s a completely different item. For example, I ordered blackberries for a recipe. It told me they were out of stock but I was getting a substitution and showed me a picture of blackberries, so I approved it and ended up getting raspberries as the substitution. Totally different item and a problem for the recipe. This is happening all the time now. I used to be able to see what substitution I was getting, but now, it’s always a surprise. Why has this changed? I always have to ask the person who brings my groceries to the car to dig through the bags and to check and see what substitution I was given.

Walmart deactivated my account today because I have been given subpar produce and subpar substitution with limited times to reject the substitutions. When I receive bad produce, I call the Walmart Customer Service and they refund my account. I would be more than happy to return this horrible produce back to the store, I wish they would take the return because they need to see what kind of produce there employees are sending out to their customers. I have received expired products, especially when I am ordering gluten-free products. The last incident which I believe why I got deactivate it is because I ordered waffle fries, and they sent me some plain nasty fries which they have done on several occasions, and my children will not eat them because they are very nasty which I would prefer no fries at all these fries each time have been taken to my job and put in the freezer for anyone to eat there are now three bags of these in my work freezer and I work in a warehouse of men so that tells you something. There was also bag of burgers where I have ordered a box of very good gourmet burgers, well seasoned, and they have given me some plain, unseasoned ground beef burgers as a substitution instead of another kind of well season gourmet burgers I was in the shower when that text came in. It was about maybe 10 minutes or less when I went to reject the substitutions they said the time had ran out, even though it was several hours before I was going to receive, my order. So now I can no longer use Walmart delivery and my Walmart plus that I paid for because of the subpar service that I receive from their employees. WOW

It’s Walmart. So it’s Walmart level service and Walmart level quality. Don’t get ahead of yourself and think it’s going to be top rated or A+ service. For what it is, it’s acceptable. The worst part is attempting to resolve any issues via their chat option. Just make sure you have lots of time to waste and don’t mind repeating yourself should the app glitch and you lose all of your progress through the 10 levels of customer service robots answering the matter. Patience. Time. And more patience. That’s all I can say. The app itself is fairly user friendly and manageable, but the random glitches in their system can leave you disappointed or even confused. Just keep an eye on them or they will double charge, forget your items, or worse, charge you and make you fight to resolve the matter. Guess it’s all you can expect from this company. Truthfully I would head for targets app if you have the luxury of choosing if not just be patient cautious and never let them tell you they can’t do anything to help you. The app actually allows you more options to get your issues resolved but again Walmart level service and Walmart level expectations. Target will simply answer you, help you, and send you on your way. And their app never seems to glitch.

reviews.t: Scan and go with self check-out
reviews.x: First time I’ve encountered this, and I don’t normally rate, but am going to rate this portion based on this experience, as there should be a better way of handling this portion of the “experience.” If a customer is utilizing scan and go and the only registers for self checkout aisles in the entirety of the store are marked as 15 items or less, what is the point of scan and go? I walked up to the the self checkout register and only had to weigh two zucchini’s to finish my order, when an employee came up and stated that this checkout is for 15 items or less. I advised that I was using the Scan and Go and his reply was the same as before…I told him the reality was I only needed to weigh my zucchini’s and then I’ll be done. His next reply was “are all the items already scanned?” I looked at my cart, which had all of my items in bags and said “yes” and his reply was a rude sounding “well I didn’t know that, but this is for 15 items or less.” Trying to keep my cool, I looked around for another lane that is not a 15 item or less and didn’t see one, so stated “ok, thank you” and finished my order on the machine I was. I do not mean to hate on this person for attempting to enforce the 15 item limit, because I am of the same opinion that if there’s a limit you shouldn’t violate that, obviously within reason. I also don’t want to hate on this piece if the “experience,” just want to bring to light that there should be a better way of handling this with a customer or have dedicated scan and go registers.

Why didn’t I join the Walmart+ program sooner!! My days are very busy as we run an Adult Foster Care Home and this app and the Walmart+ membership saves me a ton of money and just as important TIME. I don’t have to leave the house to shop for groceries or other items needed to run the house hold. This app allows me to compare prices and it includes the price break down as far as the price per ounce, pound etc. it keeps track of purchases and reminds me of items I may need at the time of check out. The features in this app are too many to even list for me. I’m not the most technically savvy person however this app is so easy to navigate and compared to other website shopping (I have tried and use other grocery stores apps) Walmart has them all beat HANDS DOWN! The delivery process is great, again saving me time and money. If an item is not in stock it is delivered for you in a very timely manner and free of charge with the Walmart+ membership. If any of you are hesitant about joining the Walmart+ membership don’t put it off and join today! You will not regret it, start saving time and money the first time you use it.

I feel as though the subscription is not worth it, you always get refunds at the 10 day mark or LATER. When they say it make take 10 days to process they really mean “I’m going to keep your money as long as possible”. I know it’s not a genuine transfer because when I get checks or refunds they always come around midnight, when you have refunds through Walmart you can tell they wait to give you the refund until the 10th day or later because it will take longer to transfer than if the transfer was actually made on the day they said they made it. A lot of workers are too lazy to properly deliver items as well, usually when this happens they speak another language, they’ll look around for two minutes then immediately cancel. That is actually what happened with my last order, I write my instructions in clear English so they can translate properly to their language but they will still not look or try. It’s gotten really annoying because now I worry every time it’s a different language driver, “are they going to cancel? will they actually contact me? will they be able to read English building numbers? Do I have to Google translate just so they properly deliver to me?” I feel as though if you cannot do the job you should find something better suited for your needs. Honestly just do your grocery shopping on Uber eats or DoorDash it’s cheaper even if it’s just by a couple dollars. And at least you will get your refund a lot faster as well if problems do occur. I recommend Uber eats though because they give you great deals on groceries :)

reviews.t: Purchase History and Receipts not working?!?
reviews.x: I placed an online order for pickup and wanted to add some items. I try through the email they sent and it doesn’t work. Everywhere it tells me to look at the purchase history in my Walmart App. I checked a Reddit post from a year ago and the thread still has reports from this year. As soon as 14 days, 4 days, 1 day ago, and even a post from 14 minutes ago about the same exact issue. This is a long standing issue that has yet to be fixed after over a year or barely working. Walmart needs to fire their whole IT department and get some new people who actually know what they’re doing and how to fix the systems in place. Like seriously for over a YEAR the purchase history has been broken and has yet to be fixed. No wonder people don’t use Walmart pickup or delivery. Because it’s barely functioning and on life support. How can a feature that is required go broken for over a year?! Maybe working for 1 month out of the whole year before it mysteriously breaks again. This is really shady and I’d even go as far as to say that maybe the IT people are using this as a way to facilitate a large theft ring throughout Walmart. No way a feature that is so detrimental just doesn’t work for over a year and Walmart just doesn’t care. I’ve tried literally everything. signing out. Redownloading. Walmart IT tells me to “update” my account but what does that even mean?!?

So I spent the money for Walmart plus. I have no vehicle. Great? Wrong!!! There are so many orders where they say my items aren’t available. They don’t let me pick substitutions, or if they do, the shopper tells me Walmart won’t let them substitute with that item. And most times, they are things I need and don’t need enough to reach the limit of free delivery to reorder on another day by the time I need it. So I have to spend an arm and a leg to go there and get it myself. But wait, there is a full stock of what I ordered earlier that day right where it’s supposed to be. Too many times the shopper doesn’t answer. Today, I got text after text saying more than half my items and substitutions weren’t available, no answer from the shopper. Luckily someone gave me a ride and guess what? Every item but one was right where it was supposed to be. I’ve spent too much money on having to get a way up there for “unavailable” items that were very much available. I paid out for a year of Walmart plus so I wasn’t having to spend it on cabs or Uber. But there is no way other than Walmart chat to get in touch with your shopper and the walmart store said it’s corporate . So I cannot rectify it immediately.

Review (Optional) there should be some reviews taken down because they’re being awfully specific about expectation’s. Walmart, and I say Walmart with stretching confidence, is and always will be, the perfect scapegoat store company that I can ever imagine with all shopping experience’s I’ve had the pleasure to go through. I really don’t remember caring about how customers, especially like or dislike, how they’re being serviced in their ordeal or non-. Being said; if their is employee’s, yes, how empowering to have language skills and literacy skills, that are targeted by others as in criticism’s, well, then you’re not doing anything wrong except you aren’t. You are wronged. I can’t seem to update my app and login now. I hope talk can help. No, this is stupid. I mean it. Tired of loose accusation’s. Accumulated immortality’s. You could only hit a rock with another rock so much. Chosen one’s are chosen. I love Walmart to the extent that I’d give my life’s limitation’s there. I don’t put up pedestal’s. “‘’” True love exists somewhere.

I am a online shopper. On Saturday I had to go buy Father’s Day cards. Unfortunately, did find much of a selection. That’s my fault for waiting to close to the day. I was happy to find two. I paid in the express and requested money back. I received bills on 20’s, but was wanting a $50. So I went to customer service, and encounter Yocelyn. Unfriendly, bad face and was bothered to do her job. She is the reason I shop on line to avoid people like her. She was rude and disrespectful to a gentleman who had to return items. I don’t understand why that would bother her. Does it effect her pay? We don’t know his situation. She grab the receipt and stated the return without asking him anything. And never said thank you. Well, I received the same horrible service. If it wasn’t for my husband, telling me we needed to leave to pick up our daughter. I was have spoken to a Manager. To advise him or her that she has no business being a supervisor. She needs training. A lot of it. Be better. Your representing a big company. A word of advise, if you don’t LOVE your job. You have no business there!!!

I started using Walmart delivery while covid was still a bigger threat, and I continue to use it out of convenience. Sometimes the biggest convenience is when I order large bags of cat and dog food. It’s nice for those items to be brought to my porch, so there is minimal lifting for me. There is a yearly fee, but it’s really not bad considering how much gas I’m saving. Most of the time, the app shows whether an item is in stock, and it allows you to pick substitutions in case it isn’t in stock (or to select “no substitution” if you don’t want the item replaced). There have been a few times the app showed an item in stock and it was not, but that hasn’t been a major issue. Delivery from the Walmart closest to me was a little shaky when it was new, possibly due to the driver for those particular deliveries, but I haven’t had an issue with that since the first couple of times. I put what I think was helpful instructions in the box where you can leave instructions for the driver, and there were no incidents of late deliveries or canceled deliveries after that.

Out of 4+ years I have had only 2 completely missed orders that were fully refunded & when a whole order was missed it takes a lot of time to remove each item & reorder all, instead of a manager that I called, being able to just delete the order & resend it. Other than that, just double check your orders and if an item is missing or beyond damaged they automatically refund your money. Most drivers I tip and are very good & respectful. The only 2 complete missed orders occurred near holidays when they hired anyone to deliver and subsequently a driver stole it and did not deliver the goods, but Walmart replaced it all immediately! The drivers are required to take a picture upon delivery. One of those 2 completely missed, the driver took a picture of a bridge to nowhere 🤣. They do take care of the customer online but check your orders. Produce in season is great. Meat & seafood great. Be careful what you order as if it’s delivered today, in 2 days or 3+ days from outsourcing makes a huge difference! Thanks for sharing reviews.

I used to love this app. I’ve been exclusively purchasing from Walmart online since 2020. Lately I’ve been noticing that on things that I purchase regularly they increase the price dramatically. When you go in the store it isn’t that much. On many things I buy they will say they are unavailable for delivery all of a sudden, even though they’re in stock and I’ve had them delivered many times. Especially toilet paper. I usually buy this great toilet paper, it’s in stock, but it says all of a sudden it’s unavailable for delivery, only cottenelle is available for delivery. Do they have a shady thing going on with that company where they won’t let any toilet paper deliver except for theirs? My children only like this one poptart. My only option to purchase it is if I pay 9.95 shipping fees, even though I’m a member and get free shipping. Sometimes they jack the price up to ship for 50$ for one box. FIFTY dollars!!be careful on your “my items” list. Many times the price has completely changed like the poptarts. You think you’re just re adding to your cart, when in reality it’s $100 or something absurd for a box of cereal. You have to watch your cart carefully. Especially if you just add things to your cart and check out on a different day, when your order is ready to complete. The prices change. Many many of the things I regularly buy day out of stock, but when you go in they are in fact stocked. So many times the price has been cheaper in store vs the app.

I live in Bozeman, Montana, & frequently shop at our local Wal-mart. Recently, I discovered the Time & Tru misses clothing brand in our Wal-Mart, & I’ve made several purchases in the store as well as online. Time & Tru has such cute styles at great prices, & I love cotton & rayon! Nicole Kramer is a Front-End Team Lead who really exemplifies excellence in customer service! On several occasions when I’ve needed help with getting in to a dressing room to try items on to see how they fit, Nicole was there. Just today, I had a return of a beautiful pair of Time & Tru espadrilles, & the customer service desk had already closed. The first associate I spoke with said she was sorry, but it was closed - but Nicole was within earshot, & she turned to us with a smile & said, “Just give me a minute, & I can take care of it.” It wasn’t even a minute before she was scanning my online receipt in my phone & printing me a refund receipt. I mentioned that she’s always in the right place at the right time when I need something, & that I really appreciate her outstanding attitude & excellence in customer service! Thank you, Bozeman Wal-Mart, for having such a great employee who makes shopping at your store fun & hassle-free!

reviews.t: Walmart CEO/CFO team members clean up your act!!😁
reviews.x: Oh my goodness,😘 I was in your Gratiot & 12 mile rd, Roseville, Mi store on yesterday, thank you, thank you for reading & listening to my previous complaints to either clean it up or tear it down, my community deserves better….soon as I walk in, the floors were shining a trillion times over like a proud brand new building, the shelves were well stock, a few employees were just standing around at self check out, but I guest that’s why you pay them to watch over paying customers, a few employee didnot know where things were located, I was looking for a floor length long mirror, she may have been new.. but another employee raise to the occasion and took me to aisle 37…. I felt like I had Saved my Favorite Store, & I don’t have to drive 15 minutes away to go to another city to spend my money @ your very clean Hall Road location. I live going on Hall Road don’t get me wrong, to me & my family, that’s our Rodeo Drive….of Michigan. I have told all my friends & family about your hard work & dedication.🙏🏾🙏🏾😁🤗🌠🌠🌠❤️❤️❤️

reviews.t: Great delivery options! But hallenging to use this app!
reviews.x: I am surprised that after so many years of investment that this app is still so challenging to navigate. When I am looking for specific items, the affinity analysis often puts products ahead of the search terms of of the ones that I am looking for. This has caused some issues on occasion because of dietary restrictions. Like if you were looking for gluten-free, it will just toss in products with gluten randomly into your search results, making it very hard to sort. this could be solved by tagging a products, accurately, and giving users the option to actually filter as opposed to seeing a long list of products that I would never intentionally buy. I would think that a large company like Walmart would do an copious amount of user experience testing, but it’s still hard to shop for products - -compared to another popular online retailer. at this point, I’d rather support Walmart, but when it is hard to see shipping times (3+ days can be 3 days or 3 weeks!), and even tell which items are in stock, I usually get frustrated and go to the other online place…

As always service at Carthage is A+. Sometimes I just think people that go above and beyond with their service should be commended. Recently right before store closing I was grocery shopping and was on the cereal isle perplexed trying to locate a cereal that my food sensitivities would permit me to eat. The guy stocking , tho extremely busy noticed I was not sure where to look to find such . I know those stockers have limited time to get their job done but he took time to notice I needed help and to offer it. He kindly helped me locate exactly what I needed . You don't see that hardly ever. And whether or not the employees realize it .... it says a lot . I appreciated it so much . I would have been standing there forever trying to read one label after another. I don't know his name but when I go in the store again I'm going to c if I can find out. He deserves to be commended for his service. You have a good employee in someone like that. I rarely leave reviews but I have left them before at this store because the service is outstanding. Just wanted to say thank u Walmart and to the guy that helped me .

I’m using this app on an iPad Pro, so hardware capacity shouldn’t be an issue. Nonetheless the app regularly lags out making me retype things, the predictive text is all but unusable for the same reason, and things are generally not well organized. If they’d just a) organized the app like the store and b) fix the performance issues, I’d easily rate this a 5, but with these issues the app is actively painful to use. Organization: just have the navigation bar at the top allow shopping by department, which then prioritizes things in your selected department (and for things that should properly be in multiple, that’s the advantage of using metadata - you can have any item show up in any “department” rather than the physical store challenge of either stocking multiple places or hiding an item from someone that uses the wrong category). You can even use this to allow drilling into the odd options that some departments have (like advertising oil change services at the top of the page under “Automotive” but not otherwise taking up space on every other menu). Then add a new “department” called “Services” where you can put the Walmart+ and similar things that don’t fit into a physical world as easily.

I want to thank this sweet angel, Ladonna Russell who is a cashier at the Alexander City, Alabama Walmart. I was getting some items on my lunch hour today & she was my cashier. She was very nice & friendly but that is not what made her my angel. We were joking around because I told I had just gotten my new renewal Walmart credit card & I had activated it & hoped there were no problems. There weren’t & she & I finished loading my buggy & I left. When I got to my car, I had just opened up the hatchback when I heard someone yelling “Ma’am”, Ma’am” & saw Ladonna running out of the store waving my credit card case & saying I had left the whole case on the counter! I almost dropped to my knees, thinking about identity theft, the hassle of canceling all my cards & putting a credit freeze with all the credit reporting agencies. I thanked her profusely& we gave each other big hugs. I started crying & so did she. It was in my mind all afternoon so when I got off work I went back to Walmart & told her Team Leader & then the Assistant Manager how much I appreciated her honesty & her tracking me down. I wanted them to know what a good employee they had. She was actually still at work so I had her Assistant Manager take our picture. Thank you again Ladonna for your swift action in getting my credit card wallet back to me! I will be posting on the Walmart survey page giving you a glowing recommendation! 🎉🎉 I know most people bash Walmart all the time but I have never had a bad experience in our local Alex City Walmart or others in other towns. From the ladies in the Pharmacy (Ms Pat & Ms Alexis) to even the stockers & cashiers, they are always helpful.

I love this app, don’t get me wrong, but there could be some improvements. I tried to order some organization items from my local Walmart and have them delivered, and the app said they were not available for curbside pick up or delivery. The next day I went into the store to pick up a couple items, and there were over 10 of the item I was looking for. I know one of the people that stocks at that Walmart and that was not something that came in overnight. Infuriating because I needed them immediately, but ordered them because they weren’t available. The app is not very intuitive. When I’m placing an order if I wanted it delivered, I often I can’t tell until it’s in my cart and I’m ready to check out if it’s an item that must be shipped, if it can be delivered or if I can pick it up. I know that there is an indicator when you’re looking at the item, but that has often changed once I got it in my cart online. I will say I have really enjoyed scan and pay. Rather than waiting for an employee to ask me for my receipt I just have my phone out and offer it. One last thing I hope Walmart starts implementing is, do not leave items without a box or a bag scattered across my driveway when they deliver items. I ordered 30 backpacks for children at a shelter, and they were thrown in my driveway, some with no protection, and it rained. While I realize this is not directly related with the app, perhaps an option should be added to the app to have your items bagged or not bagged..

I have been using the Walmart app for a few months now, and I must say it has significantly improved my shopping experience. The app is user-friendly, making it easy to navigate through the vast range of products available. I love the convenience of being able to shop anytime, anywhere, without having to visit the store physically. One of the features I appreciate the most is the ability to easily search for products using the built-in search function. Whether I'm looking for groceries, household items, electronics, or clothing, I can quickly find what I need with just a few taps. The app also remembers my previous purchases, making it convenient to reorder items I frequently buy. Another aspect that I find impressive is the savings opportunities available through the app. I often come across exclusive deals and discounts that help me save money on my purchases. The app also allows me to easily track my orders, view order history, and choose convenient delivery or pickup options. The checkout process is smooth and secure, and I appreciate the various payment methods accepted, including credit/debit cards and Walmart Pay. The app also provides real-time updates on the status of my orders, which gives me peace of mind knowing when to expect my delivery. Overall, the Walmart app has made my shopping experience more convenient and enjoyable. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a seamless shopping experience on the go.

I don’t usually write reviews but I’m really irritated by the amount of the delivery service. I receive government assistance right now due to losing my job because of my disability. I qualify for half price Walmart membership because I get SNAP benefits but I need to sign up for a full year membership. I don’t have the money to pay for food right now so I certainly don’t have the money for a membership. Walmart then charges $9.95 for the delivery. Really??? I don’t know how people can justify charging that much for people who don’t even have money to begin with. I can’t drive right now either because of my physical health issues so I really don’t have any other options. I feel that Walmart is charging people for delivery and they don’t even take into consideration that people are paying for the order with government assistance. They offer a discount for the membership because I have SNAP but when I couldn’t afford the membership they charged me full price to deliver the food. Why didn’t I get any sort of discount for the delivery fee? I shop at Walmart for the cheapest price because I am poor right now but all the savings were taken away for delivery. I was ripped off!!! I don’t have a choice but to pay it and I am really upset about it! Walmart makes money off people who are struggling and I don’t want to support that either! I don’t think I will be shopping with them any longer! I will be happy to support another store that doesn’t offer the lowest prices and robs you in the end anyway! No thank you!!! I will just take my business elsewhere!!

I love the ease of shopping with the app and being able to choose between shipping, delivery and pickup. That said, I do have a couple of complaints/suggestions: 1. Shoppers should take care to pick items they would choose for themselves. I do occassionally get brown cauliflower, very bruised bananas, or lettuce that is already beginning to go bad. Walmart is always willing to refund when that happens but it is an inconvenience to spend the time to get the correction and then have to reorder and not have what I needed. 2. My biggest beef is that the app does not allow you to specify quantities for your chosen substitutions. For example, if you order a half gallon of a product, the replacement you choose may only be available in a quart size. If you NEED half a gallon, there is no way to choose a quantity of 2 so you wind up getting half the amount you need. No way to change it. That has happened to me countless times! Order a bag of onions, squash, tomatoes that are out of stock? There is no way to choose a specific qty of individual.

This is my second go around with the delivery service…I want notifications when an item is out of stock so that I can substitute the item ..and too many items that display in stock when placing my order are then out of stock through a text or email and the picker has closed out my order before I am given the chance to substitute for something else..I am disabled and need this service to work efficiently…yesterday the app malfunctioned and the order I placed was no were to be found..but Walmart found my credit card and charged the 1/3 portion..as I received the text from chase confirming a purchase..I called the store but no one answered in any department (infuriating)..so I called corporate and she was a condescending sickening complacent rep…who told me I had to call and dispute the charge with my institution and acted like Walmart had no part in the problem..she then proceeded to tell me goodbye and have a nice day and then HUNG UP THE PHONE ON ME…

I have been using this app for years and had purchased items in the past costing a few hundred dollars. Last night I had put in an order totaling about $430 for two items. Walmart app charged both my credit and debit cards that were saved on the app. These two cards were from 2 different financial institutions. I would not have known this if both had not sent me a message stating that there was a charge pending. I had went in to cancel the order and had since not been able to put in any order despite Walmart’s email to me stating that I can reorder. I had to call Customer care up for the rep (he said his name is Ahmed) to say I have to wait at least 5 hours to put the reorder in and have to promise him that I will be using a specific card to put the same order through. If you are using this app, i would suggest you use only one card as he stated that it was their system problem. I waited more than 5 hours and tried to put the same order in. It canceled again.

Even tho I always I order shipping, sometimes they will still have the order or part of it delivered by a delivery driver. I do not request delivery. I also do not know if its being delivered until they notify me the day of thats it out for delivery, with no option to tip, or to schedule a time when I will be home. Every time they do do it via delivery there is always an issue as the GPS system they use goes to the back of my building. I live in the center of a busy city, and I've had delivery drivers leave packages outside in the back of my building instead of using the address that is manned 24/7 by concierge. And today, I had a driver mark my order as undeliverable. Never called me to say he was there and having issues, nothing. Customer service said he was at the address for 20 minutes but never thought to contact me or thought to bring the package to the building concierge? Please stop delivering packages on orders that request shipping! After being told by one customer service rep they would redeliver in 2 hours and it never showing I called again. They said they reattempted despite never calling me again nor updating the tracking so I could see. Was told id get a refund, only got it after leaving the customer service rep a bad review. Please also update your gps, as the address drivers are going to is wrong and a completely different address all together.

Hi! I’m elderly, disabled and don’t drive anymore. I love getting my groceries delivered but Walmart has a long way to go to provide good delivery service. Half the time the drivers leave my groceries “ somewhere “ on my 50 apt complex property instead of delivering them to my door. Drivers don’t take time to read my concise instructions and deliver them to wrong apt or bring them back to the store. Every time it happens and I complain, I’m assured it won’t happen again but it keeps happening. It’s been over a year and a half and it’s still happening. Or they deliver it to downstairs to the locked back stairs which is the emergency doors and since I use a walker I can’t get downstairs to get them.. Walmart uses 3 rd party drivers so they can save money but the drivers are not delivering well. Also, depending on what gps they use they are directed to either the park next to property or the gps directs you to my apt bldg. that’s why I have concise instructions to help them find my apt. The Walmart + program needs to improve their delivery service to address this.

It’s Sometimes quite glitchy and Slow , won’t always show when the Tip is Added and or how to adjust it within the app ( which is a big deal)! Also it doesn’t add the Discounts or Links from My Emails from customer service when they give me promo codes to add credits to my orders when I let them know things are missing from my orders and they credit me back $ to use for the next order ! Like today , I tried to add the $10 credit to my order and it wouldn’t apply it ‼️ Every time I use your App ( and yes my Phone is set to auto update on all apps ) your app malfunctions ( only your app ) really ?? What is wrong with your technicians ? Or App Creator ? They seem to be wasting your money !! Unable to streamline it to work with your systems &’ours too‼️ it won’t apply credits or promo codes, links from our emails you provide ! It glitches inside itself , it messes up a lot , removes items we order , won’t add items ordered , and when we go to add an item within the allotted time it rejects it ! I hate your app !

You’d think that with the amount of money this company takes in they could produce an app that doesn’t want to tear your hair out because of bugs. Had to update once to update the second time a minute later. Quit loading up my memory with updates. And too many notifications about my cart and other junk that I’m not interested in. Update: Where to begin. Number one, produce. Their produce is sketchy at best. I’ve received a Cantelope that was so old soft, and had divits of mold & black spots, green spots, and was so past prime ripeness that whoever picked this was probably on their phone playing Candy crush. Later, I received a bag of sweet potatoes that when you pick it up, oozed out this slimy liquid of advanced decay and bacteria that you fear will eat your hand if you come in contact with it. Also, I get delivery and whoever has picked my produce always seems to choose the smallest seediest looking and often it’s at a fixed price no matter the size or what it looks like. The Waltons are some of the richest people on earth, and this is how they get their money. But to their credit getting a refund for their “garbage” has always been easy with the caveat that the item that you ordered and wanted, needed, you don’t have. Knowing that Covid has impacted supplies and staffing in the past three years, Walmart was once lauded during Hurricane Katrina for their ability to obtain supplies. Now they always seem to be short on something in your order. Example: I’ve been waiting for them to get in a new supply of chamomile tea boxes over the last month. Come on Waltonys you can do better especially for what you’re paid.

This comes from my heart/ experience at Walmart stores and customers relations Corporate!!!!!! I’ve never been so unhappy, disappointed in the way you treat your customers!!!!!! I’ve been dealing with this issue since 7/6/23 no one has called me back from corporate support or management in Berea Kentucky. I’ve been a customer for years. I’m deleting my account and closing everything down. I’m done. I’ve begged I got angry because when you try to get the problem solved you are talking to people who can’t help you and they say they can but when you explain your situation over and over and have them say I can’t help you or I can’t transfer you to someone who is higher than them. I was also promised to get a discount on my last on line order and never received it . I’m very disappointed in the customer experience especially from a SO CALLED MANAGER at BEREA WALMART!!!!! His name is KENNY FIELD…. He talked to me like I was a piece of trash….. yes !!!! Yes !!!!! Yes !!!!!! SURE DID. I do not appreciate the fact of him getting bye with this. HE IS NOT MANAGEMENT MATERIAL!!!!!!!!!! HE NEEDS TO BE TRAINED AGAIN!!!!! VERY UNHAPPY PAST CUSTOMER!!!!!! Sincerely CARPENTER!!!!!

reviews.t: App is so bad I considered throwing hands with the machine and the workers.
reviews.x: I wish I could give this app a zero but that's not possible... so I give it a one. I downloaded the app because Walmart doesn't take Apple Pay (which it should... so outdated). I just wanted to buy 4 things but it kept saying payment failed. I tried multiple times but to no avail, it just didn't work. I figured it might've been my card so I took the time to add another card, but again it didn't work. After this, my mom tried her Walmart app, which she had used 3 hours prior, and again it didn't work either. I had 3 workers come and help me but they were of no help. They told me the app sometimes just doesn't work for no apparent reason. All this took about 45 minutes of my life that I will never have back. Why create an app that is so useless, time-consuming, and inoperative when you could just add Apple Pay as a payment method? Overall the app is just super slow and inconvenient. I will be disinstalling this app and start shopping at Target instead. And don't even give me that automated bot message saying you're sorry that I had a bad experience and to contact customer service because I have seen multiple people complain in the reviews having the exact problem. Don't give a response if you don't plan on fixing your defective app.

I’m home delivery is great BUT they will only deliver inside my home IF I pay to install a keyless entry for the workers to unlock even when I am at home!! I can answer the door to let them in or I can leave it unlocked if they prefer to just walk in! I don’t need a keyless entry pad bc I am ALWAYS home!! I’m disabled and am not supposed to bend over to get things off the ground! I’m also not supposed to pick up anything over 5 pounds! Thanks Walmart for being sensitive to the needs of your disabled customers!! I am being sarcastic in case you didn’t notice!! UPDATE: tonight I had Shopper / driver Cindy. They were out of many things I wanted. I LOVE that Walmart has added chat w/ ur shopper, bc I was able to text her and ask her for the replacements I wanted. She was exceptionally kind to me and got EVERYTHING I asked for even though she only had two items left before she was finished shopping! She flew around that store and got the remaining 7 replacements in just a few minutes!!! She finished shopping and delivered them to my house within 15 -20 minutes!! (I live about 10 mins away) What an AHHHHHHMAZING young lady!!! I changed her tip for $20 more than the original!! Fantastic job Cindy!! I appreciate you going ABOVE and BEYOND for me!! You probably don’t think this is much, but I have major back / leg problems, so I can’t do this and I hate it when I don’t get items I need. Cindy is a jewel!!

I want to express my utmost satisfaction with the service provided by Ms. Huggins, the pharmacist at Wal-Mart on Rochembeau in Williamsburg, VA. Ms. Huggins demonstrated exceptional dedication by seamlessly facilitating the transfer of my medications from two different pharmacies. Her precision in handling this process, coupled with a thorough explanation of medication details previously undisclosed to me, highlighted her commitment to patient care. Ms. Huggins exhibited diligence and a high level of engagement in her position, going above and beyond the expected duties of a pharmacist. The comfort we feel entrusting her pharmacy with our medication needs is a testament to her professionalism. She has become an invaluable asset to the community, setting an example for others in the pharmacy business to emulate. In a field where personalized and attentive care is crucial, Ms. Huggins stands out as a beacon of excellence. Her efforts have been a true blessing to our family, and we extend our heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional service she provides. Thank you, Ms. Huggins, for exemplifying the standard of excellence that others in the pharmacy profession should aspire to.

I never seem to be able to get everything the stores don’t seem to have it all in Walmart town of all places and the pickers well I think they’re just young and don’t have much experience with food and cooking but I know they’re hard workers. Lisa was perfect. I did not know from my past experiences I was able to follow her on my phone shopping and she could tell me we don’t have this or that and do you want this. But it wasn’t necessary the store had everything first time thank you Walmart. Lisa picked everything perfectly. She even picked perfect avocados, and she answered me and she was kind and patient. I was wondering what about a few central hubs warehouse that you had everything just a thought for the future I of course I have no idea how it works, but thank you Walmart very much and mostly for Lisa you guys picked a good one there, Walmart she’s a keeper,thank you for this very happy day and the drivers to who carried my water earlier today and every month. I just can’t thank them enough. I wish I could tip them so much more but I can’t thank you again Lisa you’ve made my day and instead of giving up on Wal-Mart Delivery, I think I’ll continue.

I dropped off a car tire to have it repaired and I told them there was something in the tire that was causing it to leak and when I got back from shopping, they said that they had repaired the tire and I asked the lady that checked me out what they did to it and she could not tell me. I asked her multiple times if she could find out and she said the person that repaired it was not there anymore or was at lunch whatever so I took the tire home, placed it back on my vehicle and aired it up because when I got home it only had 20 pounds in it and right on the side of the tire. It says 44 psi and when I got up to the max pressure I could hear it leaking in the exact same spot it was when I took it in and so I took the car back and then they tell me they cannot repair it but they can replace it so I asked for a rebate of my money because they did absolutely nothing put but put air in the tire and that’s not what I needed them to do. I needed them to repair the leak so I asked for a refund on my money and they said they could not give it to me because they repaired a bead leak, which was not the problem, they are a very inept group of individuals that work in that department and I would not recommend ever taking anything there and I knew it before I went. I should’ve never took it there in the first place. Hopefully they can learn to treat customers better and maybe they wouldn’t get reviews like this.

reviews.t: Order I ordered 2 bag of dog chow more than 2 weeks
reviews.x: 2 weeks ago never got them it would say in transit I order a lot of dog bones all that order . I called back and the supposedly supervisor told me. He going to cancel thee order credit my account and I could reorder it again . I told him no I wanted and needed the dog food . Said he was giving me 15 promo off of next order for the inconvenience . I’m done with this Walmart if you go into my account I’ve spent 300 or more easy with Xmas and dog food blankets and heating pads for my dogs . I’ve been treated so wrong and I think I should get than 15 in credit for all the inconvenience. I’m in Texas trying to send the food blankets bones to my sons house for my dogs he taking care of for me. I’m going crazy thinking my items has been delivered or supposedly delivered or not today delay in order . This is the absolutely worst service I’ve ever had or experienced with Walmart. I sure wish y’all would make this right and do the right thing . Marsha Weldon

I am absolutely delighted with the ease of ordering items whether it be pick up, delivery, or shipping. My greatest disgust with this app is that I am only offered certain selected items of a product. For example, Noosa yogurt offers almost a dozen flavors. I can only select a couple of flavors for my online order. That's the same with a number of other items. Also, there are many items available in the store at all times, that I can not order through the app. ◾️It would be wonderful if the app would allow us to give advice on some of the items we choose to buy. Such as with bananas. I should be allowed a couple dozen words to tell the shopper that I want either; large or small and green or ripe bananas. Unfortunately, we are unable to give any description of what type we would like. So I have been displeased with what was selected for me on occasion. I'm not asking for the ability to write a book, just a few short words would be more than adequate, like my example. Thanks for a very streamline process overall! Here's hoping somebody reads this and makes a few simple changes.

I joined the WalMart club a few months ago and let me tell, it has been wonderful! You have OPTIONS! You can have WalMart prepare your grocery list and they will bring it out to your car and put it in for you - just designate an open time. OR, they will prepare the items that you picked online in the Walmart app and bring them to your house!! They give you options for this option, as well. When you click the hyperlink indicating that you want delivery, your options pop up for you to pick one. For instance, today I procrastinated until this afternoon, so I had the option to $5 and they will bring it today; Otherwise, I can pick delivery for in the AM or PM and there’s no extra charge. Check it out. I think Walmart still offers you 30 days trial, so you can check it out for a month. After that free month, you pay and keep it or Indicate that you do not want to keep the service and they will drop it for.

This is my 4th attempt using a different method for each attempt to resolve the issue. AFTER you place an your online order,(pickup,delivery or shipped) the option to “EDIT” or “Change” your order is impossible and will go as far as letting you make all the necessary changes and once you click “Update Order” it has been saying “Sorry,Error Try again at a later.” Or something similar. Even if it’s literally ONLY been 2mins since placing the order and it has available time for “Adding or Editing” items . There’s a couple hours left before the “Order Person” is beginning to complete the order, to have ready for the scheduled time slot . It’s beyond frustrating and I have lost count of how many times I have had to completely cancel my entire order, when it’s only ONE item that needs correcting. Ex; Change order to “Regular milk” instead the “low fat” I accidentally ordered instead. I have successfully made contact with a LIVE Customer Service Chat Agent for assistance in correcting or fixing the issue. Of course this issue is MY FAULT despite the fact I have followed and attempted ALL suggestions to fix it. Please help me/us/anyone who’s struggling with this time consuming issue. Otherwise I will (unfortunately) be forced to go back to the original shopping In-Store method and my nerves or anxiety will suffer greatly from it. Thanks in advance for Whomever is reading this and taking the necessary steps to resolve this issue.

This app has saved me so much money and time. It really is a lifesaver, especially when you can even get your groceries delivered in less than two hours! The cost of the Walmart plus more than pays for itself in one delivery! I don’t have a car so I used to take Uber to and from the grocery store which could get really expensive. Now I just use this app to place my order and have it delivered. I save so much money by not actually being in the store and impulse buying everything in sight. Now I stick to my list and my budget. Bonus points that they take EBT. I love the scan and go feature because I can scan my items as I shop and then just pay at self check out and don’t have to wait in line with the other idiots that are usually at Walmart. Part of the reason I wouldn’t go into the store is because I couldn’t stand waiting in this checkout line, but now I avoid all that with the scan and go. I would give it five stars except it always seems to be out of certain products I need, but I guess that can’t always be helped no matter I will still continue to use this app as long as they have it!

If I could do 0 stars I would! I own a small treat and baking business. And I swear Every time I order with walmart, I receive more than half of my items wrong damaged or missing or most of the times they bring me the wrong item that has nothing to do with what I ordered! It’s sooooo frustrating because I don’t have a working vehicle at the moment so I can’t even go exchange or return the items. And most of the times I need my items asap because my customers place orders with me and sometimes I have to cancel with them because y’all (Walmart employees) can’t bring me the correct items! And when I do call customer service. The people answering the phones are EVEN WORSE! because they can’t ever resolve my problem! They always say that The only thing I can do is dispute the charges with my bank! EXCUSE ME! There’s no way of disputing charges on a EBT FOOD STAMP CARD! then after that they say “sorry there’s nothing else I can do for you”! And then they hang up. This company has employees that are clowns! And that makes me sooo angry to think, because of y’all, I’m LOSING MY CUSTOMERS!!!!!!! And for those reasons I’ll most likely cancel my subscription with Walmart and go with Kroger! WALMART NEEDS TO DO BETTER IN ALL DEPARTMENTS!!!!!

My favorite thing that I miss about the old app is the number one thing that made my shopping go faster and smoother! That my sparky friends was not only the aisle number BUT THE SECTION OF THE AISLE! It made it very specific, by omitting it, I now find myself walking the same aisle, up and down, looking for the item in need. At least with the section number I could turn an aisle and count the sections (and in some cleaner well managed stores actually see the section number labels in the correct locations ) none the less, count the sections! I’m trying to stick with purely “app” reviews but everything goes back to the stores inside! The employees are not helpful at all, undertrained, barely recognizable due to lack of ‘noticeable employee indicators,’ and 9/10 times have ear buds in their ears! After having to repeat yourself multiple times you get the inconvenienced turn around and look that reads, “Are you lost?” and then proceed to say, “HUhh!?” just as they’re pulling their ear buds from their ears! If the app had a more specific location for in store items, as it previously did, it would make for such happier shoppers!

I had to reorder my last order. I placed an order with my kids’ Christmas gifts on 12/4 it said it would be delivered 12/6. I wasn’t in a hurry to get them or anything, I actually thought I had hit Pick Up Order. I got an email and text on 12/6 saying my order would be delivered at 4:07pm. I was worried about my kids seeing the items, so I was waiting for the delivery. At 5pm I look at the app and it says delivery attempted, so I looked at my security cameras, nobody pulled into our drive. So I contacted customer help because I couldn’t track the package. They told me it was going to be delivered either before 10pm on 12/6 or during the day on 12/7. I asked if I could just pick it up from the store and was told no. So today I check and there’s still nothing. I contacted support again and was told that the person that was supposed to bring it has now “opted out” for doing the delivery, so the best thing to do was cancel my order and reorder it. I was then told that it could take up to 10 days to get my refund for the order that had to be cancelled because of someone that works for Walmart. That’s not right. I had to pay immediately for items that I didn’t get, so I should be refunded immediately also. Money is tight for people right now and $100 might not be a lot for some but when that’s budgeted for Christmas presents for kids and now I have to move money around to reorder items that it wasn’t my fault I didn’t get is ridiculous.

reviews.t: Walmart shopping app is more than just a convenience
reviews.x: The Walmart app is very user friendly. I work a lot, on my feet, 12-16 hour midnight shifts, & attend full time college courses, the app is literally my grocery list. Regardless if I’m submitting a grocery pick up or personally shopping for the items on my list, it’s very helpful. While shopping for the items myself the app shows what isle groceries are located. Before completely checking out & submitting a pick up, you can choose which items not to substitute & which items to substitute & choose the substitution. Sometimes things aren’t 100% for a grocery pick up, no one is perfect, I’m still completely satisfied. Some items have to be shipped, it’s not often I have an issue. If any issue occurs for shipping or pick up, I simply use the app to speak to customer service & 99% of the time it’s handled immediately while we chat, including refunds if needed, no fuss. Few times I had to make a phone call to customer service for certain reasons, not a big deal. While attending full time college courses, working full time midnights, 12-16 hour shifts, OT shifts & on my feet so much, my schedule is extremely exhausting, grocery shopping is so hard on me & so time consuming. During a grocery pick up I appreciate the hardworking staff so much. What they do is NOT easy. Though I thank them every time, I don’t know if they really truly understand how much I appreciate their hard work to help me through my crazy heavy loaded college schedule & work schedule. Overall I am very satisfied with the whole app shopping experience as pick up and/or delivery. I personally would like to say thank you to all the hardworking staff for everything y’all do to help people like me & especially for helping the elderly & people who are physically challenged for many different reasons. Also during the craziness of the holiday rush, during all weather conditions, good/bad, hot/cold/freezing, rain, snow, etc…know YOU are so appreciated. Thank you for all you do :)

My order was supposed to be delivered between 7:00-8:00pm. At 10:30 I finally figured out it wasn’t coming at all. So we ate pb&j for dinner at 9:30 instead of the meatloaf I planned. I tried to reach Walmart which is very difficult to say the least as they hardly ever answer their phones. The whole process is pretty bad. I wanted a 1 lb bag of goya pearl barley. I couldn’t buy one 1 pound bag but they were happy to sell me a whole case?! WHAT? I finally got a hold of someone who made an attempt to help but at that point I was beyond frustrated and angry at the extremely poor service. The customer service person I first spoke to first offered me $10 as compensation which I thought was insulting. Then he offered $15. I felt like I was in a game show! I asked to speak to a supervisor so I could tell them why I was so upset. Boy was I sorry!!! He was nasty! Said there would be no compensation at all! I’m really considering canceling the Walmart plus service because it is NOT worth the hassle! Unfortunately for me I can’t shop/walk until I have a knee replacement BUT I can go to another store!!!!! How much worse could it be?! If I could give them -5 stars that would be about right. Terrible!!!!!

reviews.t: Blatant obfuscation so you can’t tell who you’re buying from
reviews.x: the app makes you select the “Retailer” every single time you search for an item and you want to ensure you’re actually viewing items sold by Walmart, and not sold by some third party seller such as “Tammy’s Big Bargain Backpack Emporium”. Looking for a backpack? You have to go change the “Retailer” to Walmart so you don’t end up with a backpack from the aforementioned Tammy’s. Have to edit your search to better find the backpack you want? All you have to do is go add the other keyword, such as waterproof, clear, etc., right? Wrong. You then have to go back to “Retailer” and select Walmart AGAIN, so you don’t end up buying a backpack from the 3rd party seller, because good luck trying to return that. Search “Walmart Market Place return nightmare” for a multitude of examples. The 3rd party sellers are allowed to have different return policies than what Walmart’s return policy is, they’re allowed to charge you restocking fees when Walmart doesn’t, and you’re *supposed* to be able to return items to a store but very often you’ll get pushback from employees in the store because no one has taken the effort to educate and train store employees on the matter.

reviews.t: Lovejoy Online Pickup Manager is TOP NOTCH!
reviews.x: Ms. Shawna is what you call a TRUE manager. Her service is genuinely amazing, she has a heart of gold, and defines servant-hood!! I was having a rough day and made mistakes on my online delivery order. Not only did Ms. Shawna patiently her me out, she went out of her way to resolve my issue to my satisfaction. She pulled her whole team in to execute a resolution while I was on the phone with her. There was never a sense of “this is not my problem” or “I don’t care”. She actually exceeded my expectation and made my drive from Griffin to Lovejoy beyond worth it. Thanks to her service, Lovejoy has won me as a customer. I’m willing to drive the distance for stellar service like what Ms. Shawna gave. You can tell that this is just who she is…CUSTOMER SERVICE! Her kindness turned my day around and gave me some holiday cheer! It is my hope that Walmart values this lady and recognizes her for being an outlier (in the best way possible). She even personally walked my items to my car when I arrived to ensure that I was satisfied! A++ in my book!💙

reviews.t: This app is getting out of control.👎
reviews.x: 1- I have tried to report that twice my purchases have arrived incomplete, they still charge me for the product. I DON'T GET ANSWERS. 2-I have also received small charges on my card but lately they have become frequent and there is no way to see in the application what I am being charged for and why. 3-Now I bought some tires (the closest installation center is more than 5. miles away and with a waiting list of more than a month. I tried to cancel my appointment with the technical service because I found another place, and there is no way to change the delivery address, I have to go get the tires at the service center, I can't make another appointment either, I can't cancel that purchase either because to make matters worse they put my tires on delay!!! I try to report a problem and ask for help. the app crashes. This app should be investigated! These small frequent surcharges are not right! and even less have no idea what they are charging. Well, when you buy, they divide it into several parts, there is no way to know what they are charging and who!

reviews.t: FIX THE EDITING OF THE CART ASAP!!!!!!!
reviews.x: With the update before this one I was finally able to delete some things from my cart and even save some stuff for later, but most of the time I had to select those options at least 2-4 times before it would actually work. With this most recent update however, you guys have reverted back to not being able to remove or save anything for later… WTH!!!! The only good thing about this app is using it to pay for things in the store, so I don’t have to worry about keeping up with, or losing anymore receipts. It has been MANY MONTHS since the app ran smoothly and like it’s supposed to. One thing I myself and I can imagine practically every single other person who uses this app, would love to have would be the ability of MASS DELETION! Where one could easily delete all or as many items from their carts and saved for later as they desire. After months and months of aggregation and flat out disgust over the problems with your app I look forward to the day that an update for the Walmart app actually IMPROVES the app and doesn’t make it WORSE… and future updates afterwards that don’t screw it all up again… 🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬 Sincerely, a very disgruntled customer…

I purchased 4 tires. Paid & drove away. A week or so later after going through switch board on several attempts to get an appointment to fix a flat tire. I got this arranged I had to show up at 7 am cuz tire shop was booked solid. To make a long story shorter, when it came time to put my spare tire in rack thingy under my car I was told spare tire couldn’t be put back so tire loaded back of my SUV. Well after a week of my spare tire rolling over groceries etc I went back to tire center & asked to speak to a supervisor (I got tired of trying to reach one by phone) The supervisor had same employee to put my spare tire back where it belonged. Again was told the rack that holds spare tire was broken. This after supervisor came to help! So I go home with my spare still rolling around the back of my SUV. I complained to a male friend my situation with spare tire in back & smashing groceries etc. my friend asked if he could look at it. When he came back in from “looking at it” told me spare tire was back under my car like it was supposed to be!!! Nothing broken, didn’t have to buy another rack to hold spare, no more smashed groceries! So, if you believe the employees in tire department in Moses Lake are knowledgeable I’m saying that anything more than putting tires on your car is taking a risk. Do you want to drive your family around in a car that employees at WALMART tire center have worked on ? Read the reviews & you can make up your own mind of how knowledgeable they are. I’m just saying…….

reviews.t: I feel scammed every time I order
reviews.x: In theory the app sounds and looks good, in practice the worse of them all. I go through and add and add as I think what else do I need and what else do I want. Once I place the order, never fails where I have to replace just about everything in the list because they “might” not have it. A couple of first times I’m like okay… but the sixth, seventh time?!? And at multiple locations. So I return items or cancel orders and decided to go in to the store and they had enough in stock. I am not sure how that works or if they work from two different systems but they always get me and charge me the most expensive items and they are of a lesser quality. For example, I order a axe loofa, they didn’t have the 2$ one so they charged me the 3$ one that’s equate brand and by the second use it started falling apart. The same with bananas, I order the regular ones, they are out and get me the 10$ organic ones and they go bad within two days. Grapes is the same thing, I keep getting the smooshy ones and end up growing half of them away. Again, not the first time. I know they have good quality they are just not putting the good quality in the online orders.

I recommend to anyone that, has a schedule that’s not perfect. It’s great for people that have kids. It’s convenient for those who want to just get other things done then shopping. I’ve been using the Walmart app for quite a while. I wish the stock was more up-to-date on items sometimes. But especially when I delivery is brought to the house by the time you go drive and do it yourself you’re pretty much paying for the gas that you’d be paying for yourself. So pick up, or delivery. Depending on your preference. These last seven months I’ve been shopping back at Walmart. Obviously because there’s a better selection and things and the prices are cheaper. And Meijer can’t compete with that. Neither can Aldi. Or whatever local grocery chain. Plus, I’m not social in public as it is before Covid. I don’t like being in big crowds, so this is great. Especially when people who get off work late or work a different shift, this app is great for that for those they can get their essential items from the store. But I do recommend they do a better job of again with the stock online with what’s actually available at that store. That’s kind of annoying but other than that it’s great.

Walmart OR WHATEVER company Walmart chooses to place blame on the incompetence of being able to follow specific detailed instructions not just in Spanish or English, I really don’t care! However, I have left very detailed specific instructions that UPON ARRIVAL TO CALL ME! Do they? NOPE! In the instruction box where they ask you to leave instructions on how to deliver your groceries and other items, I have left very specific detailed instructions, and not only in English but in Spanish. Do they follow those instructions? NOPE! Not at all! My instructions are “BEFORE ARRIVAL PLEASE CALL ME”!!!! Do they call? No, but I'm not surprised! Following instructions is to hard for them I guess! I ask that they are to call me so that I could meet the driver outside because this house is very large, and the house has three different entrances, the main house which is in the middle, has a BROWN DOOR, one apartment to the RIGHT, has a BROWN DOOR, and then my apartment is the far LEFT and has a WHITE DOOR! Yet, however, they continue to leave my groceries at the two brown doors even though in the notes, I specifically stayed that I, live at the white door. Apparently the drivers are colorblind! And for those who want to say well, they only speak Spanish. I have left in the notes specifically notes in English and in Spanish, no excuses!

reviews.t: App Changes My Order During Checkout
reviews.x: I first filtered my items based on availability, & being able to have them delivered. I took a screenshot showing there were no issues, that it was for delivery today, in the evening to my door. I click continue to input payment method, & its switched my order from Delivery to curbside pickup with no confirmations or popups with a why.
